analyzed: ambā ādi ghaṭa ādi artha viṣayaka smṛtim prekṣya dṛṣṭvā anubhūya pra śabdena śabda arthayoḥ saṃbandha antara adarśanam saṃketayitṛ puruṣa ajñānam ca vivakṣitam jānanti niścinvanti

original: ayamarthaḥ - bālā hi mātāpitṛprabhṛtibhiḥ śabdārthasaṃbandhabodhanāya pravṛttairambātātamātulādīn ghaṭārdīśca aṅgulyā nirdiśya enamavehi idamavadhāraya iti tattacchabdaistatadartheṣu bahuśaḥ śikṣitāḥ śanaiśśanaistattadartheṣu svātmanāṃ bodhotpattimanubhavanto dhūmavahnyoriva bodhyabodhakabhāvanirvāhakasaṃbandhamākāṅkṣamāṇāḥ
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ bālāḥ hi mātā pitṛ prabhṛtibhiḥ śabda artha saṃbandha bodhanāya pravṛttaiḥ ambā tāta mātula ādīn ghaṭa ardīḥ ca aṅgulyā nirdiśya enam avehi idam avadhāraya iti tad tad śabdaiḥ tad artheṣu bahuśas śikṣitāḥ śanais śanais tad tad artheṣu sva ātmanām bodha utpattim anubhavantaḥ dhūma vahnyoḥ iva bodhya bodhaka bhāva nirvāhaka saṃbandham ākāṅkṣamāṇāḥ

original: tādṛśānugatānatiprasaktasaṃbandhāntaramalabhamānāssaṃketayitṛpuruṣānajānantaśśabdārthayossaṃbandhaṃ śaktimeva niścinvanti iti ||
analyzed: tādṛśa anugata anatiprasakta saṃbandha antaram alabhamānāḥ saṃketayitṛ puruṣān a jānantaḥ śabda arthayoḥ saṃbandham śaktim eva niścinvanti iti

original: atra nirdiśadbhirityādivartamānena, yāvadaṅgulīnirdeśaśabdaprayogasāhacaryadarśanajanitavāsanābhūyastvena svayameva tattadartheṣu tatacchabdān prayoktumarthamātradarśanena śabdaṃ smartuṃ śabdamātraśravaṇena arthaṃ smartuṃ ca śiśavaḥ kṣamā bhavanti tāvaditi sūcyate | pūrvavṛddhairiti, bhramādyabhāvassūcyate | pitrādyairityanupekṣakatvaṃ sūcyate |
analyzed: atra nirdiśadbhiḥ ityādi vartamānena yāvat aṅgulī nirdeśa śabda prayoga sāhacarya darśana janita vāsanā bhūyastvena svayam eva tad tad artheṣu tad tad śabdān prayoktum artha mātra darśanena śabdam smartum śabda mātra śravaṇena artham smartum ca śiśavaḥ kṣamāḥ bhavanti tāvat iti sūcyate pūrva vṛddhaiḥ iti bhrama ādi abhāvaḥ sūcyate pitṛ ādyaiḥ iti anupekṣaka tvam sūcyate

original: (tattaditi) sasaṃbandhiśabdānāmasaṃbandhiśabdavyutpattyapekṣayā vyutpattiprāthamyaṃ ghaṭamukhaśabdena sūcyate | idaṃ ca kaṃcitpratipituranyaṃ pratyatathātvādyādṛcchikavyutpattāvasaṃbhavi | tacchabdamātreti kātsnaryoktyā śikṣiteṣu śabdeṣu na kasyāpyabodhakatvamiti vyajyate | avadhāraṇe vā mātraśabdaḥ śabdādanyenānutpattimāha |
analyzed: tat tat iti sa saṃbandhi śabdānām asaṃbandhi śabda vyutpatti apekṣayā vyutpatti prāthamyam ghaṭa mukha śabdena sūcyate idam ca kaṃcid prati pituḥ anyam prati atathātvāt yādṛcchika vyutpattau asaṃbhavi tat śabda mātrā iti kātsnarya uktyā śikṣiteṣu śabdeṣu na kasya api abodhaka tvam iti vyajyate avadhāraṇe vā mātra śabdaḥ śabdāt anyena anutpattim āha

original: evaṃ ca buddhipūrvakavyutpatterdurapahnavatvātsiddhavastuni śaktiniścayenāpātapratītisaṃbhavādidaṃ śāstramārambhaṇīyamiti tātparyam | stragdharāvṛttam || 7 ||
analyzed: evam ca buddhi pūrvaka vyutpatteḥ durapahnava tvāt siddha vastuni śakti niścayena āpāta pratīti saṃbhavāt idam śāstram ārambhaṇīyam iti tātparyam stragdharā vṛttam 7

original: janmādyadhikaraṇaṃ prastauti - atha janmādyadhikaraṇamiti |
analyzed: janma ādi adhikaraṇam prastauti atha janma ādi adhikaraṇam iti

original: atha janmādyadhikaraṇam |
analyzed: atha janma ādi adhikaraṇam

original: prathamādhikaraṇe vyutpattyabhāvaḥ parihṛtaḥ | atra pratipattidausthyaṃ parihriyate | kāraṇatvasya viśeṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇatve viśeṣyabrahmanānātvaprasaṃgāt, upalakṣaṇatayā tattve copalakṣyākārābhāvājjanmādikāraṇatvaṃ brahmalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavatīti pūrvapakṣe - khaṇḍatāderviruddhaviśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyabhedāpādakatve’pyaviruddhaviśeṣaṇasya
analyzed: prathama adhikaraṇe vyutpatti abhāvaḥ parihṛtaḥ atra pratipatti dausthyam parihriyate kāraṇatvasya viśeṣaṇa tayā lakṣaṇa tve viśeṣya brahma nānātva prasaṃgāt upalakṣaṇa tayā tattve ca upalakṣya ākāra abhāvāt janma ādi kāraṇatvam brahma lakṣaṇam na bhavati iti pūrvapakṣe khaṇḍa tā ādeḥ viruddha viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣya bheda āpādaka tve pi aviruddha viśeṣaṇasya

original: śyāmatāderviśeṣyabhedakatvaviraheṇa viśeṣyanānātvāprasaktyā janmādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇatvaṃ saṃbhavati, niratiśaya brahmatvasyopalakṣyākāratvasaṃbhavādupalakṣaṇatayāpi teṣāṃ lakṣaṇatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti, (lakṣaṇavirahāt) pratipattidausthyaparihārasiddhāntamabhiprayan
analyzed: śyāma tā ādeḥ viśeṣya bhedaka tva viraheṇa viśeṣya nānātva aprasaktyā janma ādīnām viśeṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇatvam saṃbhavati niratiśaya brahma tvasya upalakṣya ākāra tva saṃbhavāt upalakṣaṇatayā api teṣām lakṣaṇatvam saṃbhavati iti lakṣaṇa virahāt pratipatti dausthya parihāra siddhāntam abhiprayan

original: lakṣaṇavākyavyākhyānabhūtajanmādisūtravyākhyānātmakabhāṣyavākyeṣvacintyetyādivistarasya hetuṃ prayojanaṃ ca ślokadvayenāha - bhūtānītyādinā, asyetyuddiśya sautramityādinā ca ||
analyzed: lakṣaṇa vākya vyākhyāna bhūtajanma ādi sūtra vyākhyāna ātmaka bhāṣya vākyeṣu acintyā ityādi vistarasya hetum prayojanam ca śloka dvayena āha bhūtāni ityādinā asya iti uddiśya sautram ityādinā ca

original: bhūtānītyādinā, asyetyuddiśya sautramityādinā ca ||
analyzed: bhūtāni ityādinā asya iti uddiśya sautram ityādinā ca

original: bhṛtānīti padena vastvavagatau satyāmimānīti yadgāyantyāmakhileśvaro’gaṇi jagajjanmādibhirlakṣaṇaiḥ |
analyzed: bhṛtāni iti padena vastu avagatau satyām imāni iti yat gāyantyām akhila īśvara ogaṇi jagat janma ādibhiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ

original: tenādarśi vicitrataiva jagatassṛjyasya tenāpi tatsraṣṭurbrahmaṇa ujjvalā guṇagaṇā jijñāsyatāhetavaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: tena adarśi vicitra tā eva jagataḥ sṛjyasya tena api tad sraṣṭuḥ brahmaṇaḥ ujjvalāḥ guṇa gaṇāḥ jijñāsya tā hetavaḥ 8

original: atra, yato vā imānītyādilakṣaṇavākye ityādiḥ | yato vetyādivākye, vastvavagatau - kāryavargaviṣayakaśābdabodhe | bhūtānīti padena satyāṃ - bhūtānītyanena jāte’pi | imānīti gāyantyām - (midamuktāviti śeṣaḥ | imānīti śrūyamāṇa idaṃśabde) jagajjanmādibhiḥ - ādipadena sthitilayāvucyete | lakṣaṇaiḥ asādhāraṇadharmaiḥ | akhileśvaraḥ -
analyzed: atra yatas vā imāni ityādi lakṣaṇa vākye ityādiḥ yatas vā ityādi vākye vastu avagatau kārya varga viṣayaka śābda bodhe bhūtāni iti padena satyām bhūtāni iti anena jāta ipi imāni iti gāyantyām śeṣaḥ imāni iti śrūyamāṇe idaṃśabde jagat janma ādibhiḥ ādi padena sthiti layau ucyete lakṣaṇaiḥ asādhāraṇa dharmaiḥ akhileśvaraḥ

original: patiṃ viśvasya ityukto bhagavān | agaṇi - alakṣīti yat tena sṛjyasya jagato vicitratā - uccāvacaprakārakatvam | adarśye abodhyataiva | yadvā vicitrataivābodhyata na tvābhāsatā | tenāpītyādi | tena - jagadvaicitryeṇa | tatsraṣṭuḥ - vicitrajagatkāraṇabhūtasya | brahmaṇaḥ |
analyzed: patim viśvasya iti uktaḥ bhagavān agaṇi alakṣi iti yat tena sṛjyasya jagataḥ vicitra tā uccāvaca prakāraka tvam adarśye abodhya tā eva yat vā vicitra tā eva abodhyata na tu ābhāsa tā tena api ityādi tena jagat vaicitryeṇa tad sraṣṭuḥ vicitra jagat kāraṇa bhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ

original: jijñāsyatāyāḥ - upāsyatāprayuktavicāryatāyāḥ, hetavaḥ - tatprayojakaprāpyatopapādanena prayojakāḥ | ujjvalāḥ - sāmānyaviśeṣotsargāpavādopakramanayairniṣedhavākyānāmanyaparatvopapādanena nirvighātatayā śrutiṣu pratīyamānāḥ guṇagaṇāḥ - jñānaśaktayādiguṇānāṃ, gaṇāḥ - samūhāḥ | abodhyanta | anuṣaktasyādarśītyasya bahuvacanāntatayā vipariṇāmaḥ |
analyzed: jijñāsya tāyāḥ upāsya tā prayukta vicārya tāyāḥ hetavaḥ tad prayojaka prāpya tā upapādanena prayojakāḥ ujjvalāḥ sāmānya viśeṣa utsarga apavāda upakrama nayaiḥ niṣedha vākyānām anya paratva upapādanena nirvighāta tayā śrutiṣu pratīyamānāḥ guṇa gaṇāḥ jñānaśaktayā ādi guṇānām gaṇāḥ samūhāḥ abodhyanta anuṣaktasya adarśi ityasya bahuvacana anta tayā vipariṇāmaḥ

original: kāraṇatva śrutyarthāpattyā guṇānāmākṣepāditi bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: kāraṇatva śruti arthāpattyā guṇānām ākṣepāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra vastupadena, śrutigatabhūtapadaṃ bhavanakriyāyogiparaṃ na prāṇimātraparamiti sūcitam | lakṣaṇairiti siddhavannirdeśāt pūrvoktapūrvapakṣasiddhāntāvapi sūcitau | lakṣaṇabhūtairjanmādibhiḥ ityanvayātsamudāyo lakṣaṇamiti sūcitatvānniratiśayabṛhattvasiddhiḥ vicitratā adarśyeva iti yojanayā, atyantāyogavyavacchedaḥ pratīyate |
analyzed: atra vastu padena śruti gata bhūta padam bhavana kriyā yogi param na prāṇi mātra param iti sūcitam lakṣaṇaiḥ iti siddha vat nirdeśāt pūrvokta pūrvapakṣa siddhāntau api sūcitau lakṣaṇa bhūtaiḥ janma ādibhiḥ iti anvayāt samudāyaḥ lakṣaṇam iti sūcita tvāt niratiśaya bṛhat tva siddhiḥ vicitra tā adarśyā iva iti yojanayā atyanta ayoga vyavacchedaḥ pratīyate

original: ayogasya ca prasaktiruddeśyaviśeṣaṇasya (grahādhikaraṇoktanyāyenā) vivakṣitatvānnedaṃpadena vicitratābodhasaṃbhava
analyzed: ayogasya ca prasaktiḥ uddeśya viśeṣaṇasya graha adhikaraṇa ukta nyāyena a vivakṣita tvāt na idaṃpadena vicitra tā bodha saṃbhava

original: iti | tadvyavacchedaśca grahaikatvādeḥ prāpakavākyavirodhinarutyāge’pi tadavirodhino’ṣṭavarṣatvāderna tyāga iti prakṛte
analyzed: iti tad vyavacchedaḥ ca graha ekatva ādeḥ prāpaka vākya virodhi naru tyāge api tad avirodhinā uṣṭa varṣa tva ādeḥ na tyāgaḥ iti prakṛte

original: sṛjyavaicitryasya prāpakavākyasiddhatvānna tattyāga iti | jijñāsyatāhetava iti tu, tadbrahma tadvijijñāsasveti dvitīyatatpadārthaḥ, mumukṣūpāsyatvena prakṛtaṃ hi tacchabdārtha ityuktatvāt | ataḥ vijijñāsasva iti na vicārasya upāsanasya vā vidhiḥ ityanena virodho nāstīti mantavyam | jagata iti, sautraikavacanamanusṛtyoktam |
analyzed: sṛjya vaicitryasya prāpaka vākya siddha tvāt na tad tyāgaḥ iti jijñāsya tā hetavaḥ iti tu tat brahma tat vijijñāsasva iti dvitīya tad padārthaḥ mumukṣu upāsya tvena prakṛtam hi tad śabda arthaḥ iti ukta tvāt atas vijijñāsasva iti na vicārasya upāsanasya vā vidhiḥ iti anena virodhaḥ na asti iti mantavyam jagataḥ iti sautra ekavacanam anusṛtya uktam

original: akhileśvara iti ca, bhṛguvallīsthalakṣaṇavākyaikavākyasatyādivākyasthadvitīyāntānantapadayogarūḍhyarthanirdeśa iti || 8 ||
analyzed: akhila īśvaraḥ iti ca bhṛguvallī stha lakṣaṇa vākya eka vākya satya ādi vākya stha dvitīya anta ananta pada yoga rūḍhi artha nirdeśaḥ iti

original: yato vetyatrasthemānītyasya, tanmūlakasya sautrasyāsyeti padasya ca prayojanakathanārthaṃ (idaṃ) | ayamarthaḥ - bhūtaśabdena kāryavarge’bhihite’pi imānīti padaṃ, kāryavargasya dharmigrāhakapramāṇasiddhākāraviśeṣaparaṃ; na tu jagata ābhāsatāparam | brahmaṇo jijñāsyatānupayogitvāt |
analyzed: yatas vā iti atrastha imāni ityasya tad mūlakasya sautrasya asya iti padasya ca prayojana kathana artham idam ayam arthaḥ bhūta śabdena kārya varge abhihite api imāni iti padam kārya vargasya dharmi grāhaka pramāṇa siddha ākāra viśeṣa param na tu jagataḥ ābhāsa tā param brahmaṇaḥ jijñāsya tā anupayogi tvāt

original: vaicitryaparamimānīti padamīdṛśakāryaniṣpādanānuguṇaguṇotkarṣaṃ brahmeti jñāpanārtham | śrutivākyasthedaṃśabdena nirdiśataḥ sūtrakārasyāpīyameva vivakṣeti bhāṣyasthācintyetyādivistarasyedameva mūlamiti, tadidamāha - asyeti |
analyzed: vaicitrya param imāni iti padam īdṛśa kārya niṣpādana anuguṇa guṇa utkarṣam brahma iti jñāpana artham śruti vākya stha idam śabdena nirdiśataḥ sūtrakārasya api iyam eva vivakṣā iti bhāṣya stha acintyā ityādi vistarasya idam eva mūlam iti tat idam āha asya iti

original: asyetyuddiśya sautraṃ padamatha tadacintyādibhāṣyaṃ vivavre
analyzed: asya iti uddiśya sautram padam atha tat acintya ādi bhāṣyam vivavre

original: tattanmānaprasiddhaṃ jagadabhidadhatī tadvicitratvamāha |
analyzed: tat tat māna prasiddham jagat abhidadhatī tad vicitra tvam āha

original: śrautī sautrīdamuktistviti hṛdi nidadhattatra cācetanāṃśe
analyzed: śrautī sautrī idam uktiḥ tu iti hṛdi nidadhat tatra ca acetana aṃśe

original: vaicitrīmāha pūrvaṃ padamatha niyatetyādikaṃ cetanāṃśe || 9 ||
analyzed: vaicitrīm āha pūrvam padam atha niyata ityādikam cetanā aṃśe

original: te te mānena - pramāṇena prasiddhāḥ - dharmipratītidaśāyāmeva pratīyamānā yasya tattathoktaṃ, dharmigrāhakapramāṇasiddhākāraviśeṣayuktamityarthaḥ | jagat - bhūtaśabdoktakāryavargam| abhidadhatī - śaktyā bodhayantī | jagaddharmigrāhakamānasiddhākārayuktamabhidadhatītyanvayaḥ | śrautī - yato vetyādivākyasthā |
analyzed: te te mānena pramāṇena prasiddhāḥ dharmi pratīti daśāyām eva pratīyamānāḥ yasya tat tathā uktam dharmi grāhaka pramāṇa siddha ākāra viśeṣa yuktam iti arthaḥ jagat bhūta śabda ukta kārya vargam abhidadhatī śaktyā bodhayantī jagat dharmi grāhaka māna siddha ākāra yuktam abhidadhati iti anvayaḥ śrautī yatas vā ityādi vākya sthā

original: sautrī - janmādyasya yata iti sūtrasthā ca | idamuktiḥ tuśabdaścārthako bhinnakrameṇa yojyaḥ, vaiṣamye vā | tuśabdo grahaikatvavyāvṛttamatratyoddeśyaviśeṣaṇamāha | idamuktiḥ - imānīti asyeti ca idaṃśabdaḥ, tasya - jagato vicitratvamāheti hṛdi nidadhadacintyādibhāṣyam, asyeti sautraṃ padamuddiśya - vyākhyeyatayopādāya tadvivavre - vyācakhyau |
analyzed: sautrī janma ādyasya yatas iti sūtra sthā ca idam uktiḥ tuśabdaḥ ca arthakaḥ bhinnakrameṇa yojyaḥ vaiṣamye vā tuśabdaḥ graha ekatva vyāvṛttam atratya uddeśya viśeṣaṇam āha idam uktiḥ imāni iti asya iti ca idaṃśabdaḥ tasya jagataḥ vicitra tvam āha iti hṛdi nidadhat acintya ādi bhāṣyam asya iti sautram padam uddiśya vyākhyeya tayā upādāya tat vivavre vyācakhyau

original: tatra - bhāṣye, acintyavividhavicitraracanasya niyatadeśakālaphalabhogabrahmādistambaparyantakṣetrajñamiśrasya iti
analyzed: tatra bhāṣye acintya vividha vicitra racanasya niyata deśa kāla phala bhoga brahma ādi stamba paryanta kṣetrajña miśrasya iti

original: bhāṣyavākya ityarthaḥ | pūrvaṃ padaṃ - acintyavividhavicitraracanasyeti padam | acetanāṃśe - kāryavargaikadeśeṣvacetaneṣu vaicitrīmāha | atha - anantaram | niyatetyādikaṃ - niyatadeśakālaphalabhogabrahmādistambaparyantakṣetrajñamiśrasyeti padam | cetanāṃśe - kāryavargaikadeśeṣu cetaneṣu vaicitrīmāha |
analyzed: bhāṣya vākye iti arthaḥ pūrvam padam acintya vividha vicitra racanasya iti padam acetana aṃśe kārya varga eka deśeṣu acetaneṣu vaicitrīm āha atha anantaram niyata ityādikam niyata deśa kāla phala bhoga brahma ādi stamba paryanta kṣetrajña miśrasya iti padam cetana aṃśe kārya varga eka deśeṣu cetaneṣu vaicitrīm āha

original: tadidamāhuḥ vyāsapādāḥ tatrācidaṃśavaicitryamāha acintyetyādinā, atha cidvaicitryamāha niyateti iti || 9 ||
analyzed: tat idam āhuḥ vyāsa pādāḥ tatra acit aṃśa vaicitryam āha acintya ityādinā atha cit vaicitryam āha niyata iti iti

original: śāstrayonitvādhikaraṇaṃ prastauti - atha śāstrayonitveti |
analyzed: śāstra yoni tva adhikaraṇam prastauti atha śāstra yoni tva iti

original: atha śāstrayonitvādhikaraṇam |

original: praśāstiṃ - praśāsanam | bāhulakācchāseśśāstiḥ rājadaṇḍa iti vaiyākaraṇāḥ | yamo vaivasvato rājā iti bhagavanniyamanamapi hi rājadaṇḍaḥ | na prakaṭayati | kuta ityatrāha - ghañanta iti | idaṃ ca hetvarthagarbham | tadāha - no kartarīti | ghañpratyayaḥ kartari nāsti akartari ca ityukteḥ | ghañkarmaṇyagaṇi - karmārthe vihitaḥ kāraka ityukteḥ |
analyzed: praśāstim praśāsanam bāhulakāt śāseḥ śāstiḥ rāja daṇḍaḥ iti vaiyākaraṇāḥ yamaḥ vaivasvataḥ rājā iti bhagavat niyamanam api hi rāja daṇḍaḥ na prakaṭayati kutas iti atra āha ghañ ante iti idam ca hetvartha garbham tat āha no kartari iti ghañ pratyayaḥ kartari na asti akartari ca iti ukteḥ ghañ karmaṇi a gaṇi karma arthe vihitaḥ kārakaḥ iti ukteḥ

original: yadyapi saṃjñāyāmityukteḥ karmaṇyasaṃjñāyāṃ ghañdurlabhaḥ; tathāpi bahulagrahaṇādasaṃjñāyāmapi ghañ sulabhaḥ | ko bhavatā lābho labdhaḥ | aparaṃ lābhaṃ svābhidheyāpekṣāvidhiniyamassaṃbandhamanuvartiṣyate ekaḥ pākaḥ puṭapākapratīkāśa ityādiprayogāt | iha - buddhisthabhavatpakṣe | sat - sacchabdavācyaṃ brahma | śāstau - śāsane | kartṛsyāt -
analyzed: yadi api saṃjñāyām iti ukteḥ karmaṇi asaṃjñāyām ghañ durlabhaḥ tathā api bahula grahaṇāt asaṃjñāyām api ghañ sulabhaḥ kaḥ bhavatā lābhaḥ labdhaḥ aparam lābham sva abhidheya apekṣā vidhi niyamaḥ saṃbandham anuvartiṣyate ekaḥ pākaḥ puṭapāka pratīkāśaḥ ityādi prayogāt iha buddhi stha bhavat pakṣe sat sat śabda vācyam brahma śāstau śāsane kartṛ syāt

original: kartṛtvārham | karma na syāt - karmatvānarham | na tasyeśe kutaścana iti śruterityarthaḥ | tat - tasmāt | āṅupasṛṣṭadiśate upadeśe’pi prayogāt, ghañaḥ karmaṇi prayogaprācuryāt praśāsanārthakatve brahmaṇaḥ praśāsanakarmatvavirahāt, ghañpratyayasya ca kartari vidhānābhāvādupadeśyatvasya ca brahmaṇyupapatteścetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: kartṛ tva arham karma na syāt karma tva anarham na tasya īśe kutaścana iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ tat tasmāt āṅ upasṛṣṭa diśate upadeśe api prayogāt ghañaḥ karmaṇi prayoga prācuryāt praśāsana arthaka tve brahmaṇaḥ praśāsana karmatva virahāt ghañ pratyayasya ca kartari vidhāna abhāvāt upadeśya tvasya ca brahmaṇi upapatteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: idaṃ - sacchabdavācyaṃ brahma | ādeśavācā tamādeśam ityādeśaśabdena | upadeśyamuditaṃ - upadeśyatvenoktamiti kecidāhuriti pūrveṇānvayaḥ ||
analyzed: idam sat śabda vācyam brahma ādeśa vācā tam ādeśam iti ādeśa śabdena upadeśyam uditam upadeśya tvena uktam iti kecid āhuḥ iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ

original: tamimamarthaṃ pratikṣipan svābhimatārthamāha -

analyzed: śābda uktam kārakāṇām nanu karaṇatayā kartari syāt vivakṣā

original: (atretyādi) atra brūmaḥ - asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhāntaṃ brūmaḥ | kimityatrāha praśāstimityādi | āṅmukhaḥ - āṅpūrvakaḥ | asau diśiḥ - diśidhātuḥ | praśāstiṃ - praśāsanam, ājñām | vadati - pratipādayati | āsāvāṅpūrvo diśidhātuḥ, upadeśaṃ na vadati - upadeśaṃ na bodhayati | kuta ityatrāha - śāstau so’tiprasiddha iti |
analyzed: atra ityādi atra brūmaḥ asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhāntam brūmaḥ kim iti atra āha praśāstim ityādi āṅmukhaḥ āṅ pūrvakaḥ asau diśiḥ diśi dhātuḥ praśāstim praśāsanam ājñām vadati pratipādayati ā asau āṅ pūrvaḥ diśi dhātuḥ upadeśam na vadati upadeśam na bodhayati kutas iti atra āha śāstau saḥ ūti prasiddhaḥ iti

original: sa āṅpūrvo diśiḥ praśāsane atiprasiddha ityarthaḥ | āṅpūrvo diśiḥ niyoktṛprayojanavacanaḥ, upapūrvastu niyojyaprayojanavacanaḥ iti nyāsakāroktiḥ | ādiṣṭo’smi adiṣṭā raghupuṅgavena ityādiprayogāccetyāśayaḥ | na hi para iti | pare - upadeśe saḥ - ādeśaśabdaḥ, na hi prasiddhaḥ | (tasyopadeśatvaprasiddhiḥ prasiddhetyarthaḥ) eṣa ādeśa eṣa upadeśaḥ iti
analyzed: saḥ āṅ pūrvaḥ diśiḥ praśāsane ati prasiddhaḥ iti arthaḥ āṅ pūrvaḥ diśiḥ niyoktṛ prayojana vacanaḥ upapūrvaḥ tu niyojya prayojana vacanaḥ iti nyāsa kāra uktiḥ ādiṣṭaḥ asmi adiṣṭā raghu puṅgavena ityādi prayogāt ca iti āśayaḥ na hi paraḥ iti pare upadeśe saḥ ādeśa śabdaḥ na hi prasiddhaḥ tasya upadeśa tva prasiddhiḥ prasiddhā iti arthaḥ eṣaḥ ādeśaḥ eṣaḥ upadeśaḥ iti

original: pṛthaṅnardeśāditi bhāvaḥ | kiṃ ca iha - praśāsitṛtvārthakatve | apekṣitārthaprasaṃgaḥ - ekavijñānena sarva - vijñānapratijñāsiddhyarthaṃ nimittāntaravyudāsāyopādānasyaiva nimittatvābhidhānam apekṣitamityapekṣitārthasiddhirbhavati |
analyzed: pṛthak nardeśāt iti bhāvaḥ kim ca iha praśāsitṛ tva arthaka tve apekṣita artha prasaṃgaḥ eka vijñānena sarva vijñāna pratijñā siddhi artham nimitta antara vyudāsāya upādānasya eva nimitta tva abhidhānam apekṣitam iti apekṣita artha siddhiḥ bhavati

original: asādhāraṇasya - paramātmāsādhāraṇasya praśāsitṛtvasya, uktyā - pratipādanenāyamādeśaśabdaḥ praśāsane yukto bhavati | praṣṭavyatvoktayaivārthādupadeśyatvaṃ siddhamiti taduktiranapekṣitakathanaṃ syāt; saṃsāranivṛttibrahmatadupāsanānāmupadeśyatvaṃ sādhāraṇamiti taduktissādhāraṇoktiścasyāditi bhāvaḥ | karaṇe’pi, ghañ - ghañpratyayaḥ |
analyzed: asādhāraṇasya paramātma asādhāraṇasya praśāsitṛ tvasya uktyā pratipādanena ayam ādeśa śabdaḥ praśāsane yuktaḥ bhavati praṣṭavya tva uktayā eva arthāt upadeśya tvam siddham iti tad uktiḥ anapekṣita kathanam syāt saṃsāra nivṛtti brahma tad upāsanānām upadeśya tvam sādhāraṇam iti tad uktiḥ sādhāraṇa uktiḥ ca syāt iti bhāvaḥ karaṇe pi ghañ ghañ pratyayaḥ

original: agaṇi - vihitaḥ | upadeśe’janunāsikaḥ ityatra halaśca ityasaṃjñāyāmapi bahulagrahaṇātkaraṇe ghañ iti mahābhāṣyokteriti bhāvaḥ | kārakāṇāṃ - karmādīnām | vaivakṣikatvaṃ - vivakṣādhīnatattatkārakabhāvam | śābdaiḥ - vaiyākaraṇaiḥ, uktam | vivakṣātaḥkārakavibhaktayo nānābhavanti iti tairukteriti bhāvaḥ | nanvi tyavadhāraṇe |
analyzed: vihitaḥ upadeśe i c anunāsikaḥ iti atra ha laḥ ca iti asaṃjñāyām api bahula grahaṇāt karaṇe ghañ iti mahābhāṣya ukteḥ iti bhāvaḥ kārakāṇām karma ādīnām vaivakṣika tvam vivakṣā adhīna tad tad kāraka bhāvam śābdaiḥ vaiyākaraṇaiḥ uktam vivakṣātaḥ kāraka vibhaktayaḥ nānā bhavanti iti taiḥ ukteḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu iti avadhāraṇe

original: kartari karaṇatayā vivakṣā kāraṇatvaprakārakabodhanecchā | syādeva | akartarīti paryudāsastukartṛtvaprakārakabodhatātparye ghajpratyayasya asādhutvabodhanārtha iti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: kartari karaṇatayā vivakṣā kāraṇatva prakāraka bodhana icchā syāt eva a kartari iti paryudāsaḥ tu kartṛ tva prakāraka bodha tātparye ghac pratyayasya asādhu tva bodhana arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tadāhurvyāsapādāḥ upadeśapakṣe prakṛtyarthāsvārasyaṃ pratyayasvārasyaṃ ca | praśāsanapakṣetu pratyayāsvārasyaṃ pradhānabhūtaprakṛtyarthasvārasyamarthaucityaṃ ceti vaiṣamyam; ataḥ praśāsitaivādeśaśabdābhidheya iti svīkartuṃ yukta iti |
analyzed: tat āhuḥ vyāsa pādāḥ upadeśa pakṣe prakṛti artha asvārasyam pratyaya svārasyam ca praśāsana pakṣe tu pratyaya asvārasyam pradhāna bhūta prakṛti artha svārasyam artha aucityam ca iti vaiṣamyam atas praśāsitā eva ādeśa śabda abhidheyaḥ iti svīkartum yuktaḥ iti

original: atra vastutaḥ kartaryeva kartṛtvasya sādhakatamatvarūpakaraṇatvasya ca sattvāt kartṛtvāvivakṣayā karaṇatvamātravivakṣāyāṃ tatpratyayaḥ sulabhaḥ | yathā ghaṭādau ghaṭatvadravyatvādeḥ vivakṣānusāreṇa ghaṭādipadaprayogaḥ tadvaditi, vivakṣātaḥ kārakavibhaktayaḥ ityatrāropaprasaktyabhāvānnātra tatparihārāya ghañaḥ kartari lakṣaṇā |
analyzed: atra vastutas kartari eva kartṛ tvasya sādhakatamatva rūpa karaṇatvasya ca sattvāt kartṛ tva avivakṣayā karaṇatva mātra vivakṣāyām tad pratyayaḥ sulabhaḥ yathā ghaṭa ādau ghaṭa tva dravya tva ādeḥ vivakṣā anusāreṇa ghaṭa ādi pada prayogaḥ tadvat iti vivakṣātaḥ kāraka vibhaktayaḥ iti atra āropa prasakti abhāvāt na atra tad parihārāya ghañaḥ kartari lakṣaṇā

original: karaṇādeḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāpi nāroparūpeti samabhivyāhṛtatatkriyākārakāntarānadhīnatatkriyānukūlavyāpāravattvaṃ svātantryamiti pariṣkurvadbhistāntrikairuktam | na caivaṃ pratyayāsvārasyābhyupagamavirodha iti vācyam |
analyzed: karaṇa ādeḥ kartṛ tva vivakṣā api na āropa rūpā iti samabhivyāhṛta tad kriyā kāraka antara anadhīna tad kriyā anukūla vyāpāravat tvam svātantryam iti pariṣkurvadbhiḥ tāntrikaiḥ uktam na ca evam pratyaya asvārasya abhyupagama virodhaḥ iti vācyam

original: praśāsanopadeśayoḥ prayoge satyapi prasiddhiprācuryāt praśāsane svārasyaṃ tadvirahāccopadeśe prakṛterasvārasyamitivat ghañaḥ karmakaraṇayoḥ prayoge’pi karmaṇi prasiddhiprācuryātsvārasyaṃ, karaṇe tu tadvirahādasvārasyamityadoṣāt | na capraśāsanakaraṇatvasya paramātmatadjñānasādhāraṇyānnāsādhāraṇyamiti vācyam |
analyzed: praśāsana upadeśayoḥ prayoge sati api prasiddhi prācuryāt praśāsane svārasyam tad virahāt ca upadeśe prakṛteḥ asvārasyam iti vat ghañaḥ karma karaṇayoḥ prayoge api karmaṇi prasiddhi prācuryāt svārasyam karaṇe tu tad virahāt asvārasyam iti adoṣāt na ca praśāsana karaṇa tvasya paramātma tad jñāna sādhāraṇyāt na asādhāraṇyam iti vācyam

original: tathāpyupadeśyatvāpekṣayā syāsādhāraṇyāt karaṇāntaranairapekṣyeṇa praśāsanakartṛtve sati praśāsanakaraṇatvasyāsādhāraṇyākṣateśca | yadyapi karmaṇyapi ghañdurlabhaḥ tadvidhau saṃjñāyām imityukteḥ; tathā copadeśapakṣe’pi
analyzed: tathā api upadeśya tva apekṣayā sya asādhāraṇyāt karaṇa antara nairapekṣyeṇa praśāsana kartṛ tve sati praśāsana karaṇa tvasya asādhāraṇya akṣateḥ ca yadi api karmaṇi api ghañ durlabhaḥ tad vidhau saṃjñāyām im iti ukteḥ tathā ca upadeśa pakṣe pi

original: pratyayasvārasyābhāvastulyaḥ; tathāpi prasiddhiprācuryatadvirahābhyāṃ svārasyāsvārasye nirbādhe | na caivaṃ bāhulakātkartaryeva ghañāśrīyatāmiti vācyam | karmakaraṇayoḥ saṃjñāyāmapi bahulagrahaṇāt, ghañupapādanavat kartari ghaño bāhulakatayā mahābhāṣyakārairanupapādanāt |
analyzed: pratyaya svārasya abhāvaḥ tulyaḥ tathā api prasiddhi prācurya tad virahābhyām svārasya asvārasye nirbādhe na ca evam bāhulakāt kartari eva ghañ āśrīyatām iti vācyam karma karaṇayoḥ saṃjñāyām api bahula grahaṇāt ghañ upapādana vat kartari ghañaḥ bāhulaka tayā mahābhāṣya kāraiḥ anupapādanāt

original: na ca kārakāntarāṇāṃ kartṛtvavivakṣocitā, na tu kartuḥ kārakāntaravivakṣeti vācyam | ātmānamātmanā vetsi sṛjasyātmānamātmanā ityādau kartuḥ karaṇatvavivakṣetyuktatvāt, lūyate kedāraḥ svayam ityādau karmakarturapi karaṇatvavivakṣākathanāt, preṣite ca kilāyaṃ kriyāmakriyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā iti bhāṣyavyākhyāne kartuṃradhikaraṇatvavivakṣayā saptamīti
analyzed: na ca kāraka antarāṇām kartṛ tva vivakṣā ucitā na tu kartuḥ kāraka antara vivakṣā iti vācyam ātmānam ātmanā vetsi sṛjasi ātmānam ātmanā ityādau kartuḥ karaṇa tva vivakṣā iti ukta tvāt lūyate kedāraḥ svayam ityādau karma kartuḥ api karaṇa tva vivakṣā kathanāt preṣite ca kila ayam kriyām akriyām ca dṛṣṭvā iti bhāṣya vyākhyāne kartuṃr adhikaraṇa tva vivakṣayā saptamī iti

original: kaiyaṭenoktatvācca ||17 ||
analyzed: kaiyaṭena ukta tvāt ca 17

analyzed: ānanda maya adhikaraṇe puccha brahmaṇaḥ prādhānyam para uktam anuvadati

original: ṣaṣṭhyānyatvamavedi nainamavadacchaloko na cājñātatā

original: jñātasyāsya tathāpi nāvayavitā tasyānya ātmā śrutaḥ |
analyzed: jñātasya asya tathā api na avayavitā tasya anyaḥ ātmā śrutaḥ

original: śodhyatvaṃ ca vikāravācakavacastadbrahmapucchaṃ bhavennatvānandamayaḥ sa cānnamayavat kośo bahiḥ kathyate || 18 ||
analyzed: śodhya tvam ca vikāra vācaka vacaḥ tat brahmapuccham bhavet natvā ānanda mayaḥ sa ca anna maya vat kośaḥ bahis kathyate 18

original: asya - ānandamayasya | ṣaṣṭhyā - tasya puccham iti ṣaṣṭhyā | anyatvaṃ - brahmānyatvam | avedi - śrotṛbhirajñāyi, vyatirekaṣaṣṭhīsvārasyāditi bhāvaḥ | enaṃ - pūrvaṃ brahmānyatva (pratiyogitve) nopāttamimamānandamayam |
analyzed: asya ānanda mayasya ṣaṣṭhyā tasya puccham iti ṣaṣṭhyā anya tvam brahma anya tvam avedi śrotṛbhiḥ ajñāyi vyatireka ṣaṣṭhī svārasyāt iti bhāvaḥ enam pūrvam brahma anya tva pratiyogi tve na upāttam imam ānanda mayam

original: ślokaḥ - asanneva sa bhavati iti brahmaviṣayaślokaḥ | nāvadat - na pratipādayāmāsa, api tu pucchatayoktaṃ brahmaivāvadadityarthaḥ | jñātasya - priyamodādirūpeṇa lokaviditasyānandamayasya, asya | ajñātatā - (sadbhāvāsadbhāva - jñānāṃśakau prayojakamajñātatvaṃ na - na bhavatītyarthaḥ | tathāpi - yathākathaṃcidajñātatvopapādane’pi |
analyzed: ślokaḥ asan eva sa bhavati iti brahma viṣaya ślokaḥ na avadat na pratipādayāmāsa api tu pucchatayā uktam brahma eva avadat iti arthaḥ jñātasya priyamoda ādi rūpeṇa loka viditasya ānanda mayasya asya ajñātatā sadbhāva asadbhāva jñāna aṃśakau prayojakam ajñāta tvam na na bhavati iti arthaḥ tathā api yathā kathaṃcid ajñāta tva upapādane pi

original: tasya - niravayavasyaparamātmanaḥ | avayavitā - śiraḥpucchādyavayavavattā | na - na bhavatītyarthaḥ | tathā ca jñāto’vayavī ca ānandamayo na paramātmetyarthaḥ | tasya ānandamayasya anya ātmā śrutaḥ - tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā ityātmāntaraṃ śrutam | paramātmano’pyā (hyā)tmāntarāsaṃbhavādātmāntaravānānandamayo na paramātmetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasya niravayavasya paramātmanaḥ avayavi tā śiraḥ puccha ādi avayavavat tā na na bhavati iti arthaḥ tathā ca jñāta avayavī ca ānanda mayaḥ na paramātmā iti arthaḥ tasya ānanda mayasya anyaḥ ātmā śrutaḥ tasya eṣaḥ eva śārīraḥ ātmā iti ātma antaram śrutam paramātmanā upyā hi ātma antara asaṃbhavāt ātma antaravān ānanda mayaḥ na paramātmā iti arthaḥ

original: asya - ānandamayasya | śodhyatvaṃ śrutaṃ - ānandamayo me śudhyantām iti vākyāvagatamityarthaḥ | śruta ityanuṣaktasya liṅgavipariṇāmaḥ | nityaśuddhe paramātmani śodhyatvānupapatteḥ, śodhyatvena pratīta ānandamayo na paramātmetyarthaḥ |

analyzed: asya ayam arthaḥ gāyatrī vai idam sarve bhūtam iti gāyatrī śabdaḥ catuṣpād brahma paraḥ sarva bhūta śabdaḥ ātma paraḥ ātma vargasya tad pāda tvam sāmānādhikaraṇyena uktam tasya eva brahmaṇaḥ gāna trāṇa ādibhiḥ ṣāḍvidhyam ca vivakṣuḥ śrutiḥ gāna trāṇa upapādanāya vāc rūpa tvam āha vāc vai gāyatrī iti

original: gāyatrīśabdavācyaṃ catuṣpādbrahma vāgrūpaviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ raso’hamapsu kaunteya ityārabhyocyate śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu iti | tathā bhagavatparāśaravacanam śabdamūrtidharasyaitadrūpaṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ iti | tataḥ kiṃ vivakṣitaṣāḍvidhyasyetyatrāha vāgvā idaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ gāyati ca trāyate ceti | vāgviśiṣṭaṃ paraṃ brahma sarvabhūtaṃ gāyati
analyzed: gāyatrī śabda vācyam catuṣpād brahma vāc rūpa viśiṣṭam iti arthaḥ rasaḥ ham apsu kaunteyaḥ iti ārabhya ucyate śabdaḥ khe pauruṣam nṛṣu iti tathā bhagavat parāśara vacanam śabda mūrti dharasya etat rūpam viṣṇoḥ mahātmanaḥ iti tatas kim vivakṣita ṣāḍvidhyasya iti atra āha vāc vai idam sarvam bhūtam gāyati ca trāyate ca iti vāc viśiṣṭam param brahma sarva bhūtam gāyati

original: abhidhatte; hitāhitavidhiniṣedhamukhena trāyate cetyarthaḥ | evamekaḥ pādo gānatrāṇarūpaṃ vidhādvayaṃ coktam | tadanuvādapūrvakaṃ dvitīyaṃ pādaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyenāha - yā vai sā gāyatrī iyaṃ vāva seyaṃ pṛthivī iti uktākāraviśiṣṭaprakṛtadharmiparau yattacchabdau | yā sā sarvabhūtarūpaikapādā gāyatrī gāyatryākhyaṃ brahma, tadeva pṛthivītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: abhidhatte hita ahita vidhi niṣedha mukhena trāyate ca iti arthaḥ evam ekaḥ pādaḥ gāna trāṇa rūpam vidhā dvayam ca uktam tad anuvāda pūrvakam dvitīyam pādam sāmānādhikaraṇyena āha yā vai sā gāyatrī iyam vāva sā iyam pṛthivī iti ukta ākāra viśiṣṭa prakṛta dharmi parau yad tad śabdau yā sā sarva bhūta rūpa eka pādā gāyatrī gāyatrī ākhyam brahma tat eva pṛthivī iti arthaḥ

original: kathaṃ pṛthivyā brahmātmakatvamityatrāha - asyāṃ hīti | brahmātmakatvādeva hi sarvabhūtapratiṣṭhātvam | na hi kevalapṛthivyāḥ sarvabhūtadhāraṇaśaktirityarthaḥ | pratiṣṭhātvaṃ ca niyatamityāha - etāmeva nātiśīyata iti | pṛthirvī bhūtajātirnātivartate | karmavaśyātmanāṃ niyamena pratiṣṭhātvādaśakyātikramaṇetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: katham pṛthivyāḥ brahma ātmaka tvam iti atra āha asyām hi iti brahma ātmaka tvāt eva hi sarva bhūta pratiṣṭhā tvam na hi kevala pṛthivyāḥ sarva bhūta dhāraṇa śaktiḥ iti arthaḥ pratiṣṭhā tvam ca niyatam iti āha etām eva na atiśīyate iti pṛthirvī bhūta jātiḥ na ativartate karma vaśya ātmanām niyamena pratiṣṭhā tvāt aśakya atikramaṇā iti arthaḥ

original: pṛthivīmayabrahmāṇḍodare hi bhoktṛvargaḥ parivartate |
analyzed: pṛthivī maya brahmāṇḍa udare hi bhoktṛ vargaḥ parivartate

original: evaṃ dvitīyaḥ pādo bhūtapratiṣṭhātvatadanativartyatvarūpaṃ vidhādvayaṃ coktam | atha tṛtīyaṃ pādamāha - yāvai sā pṛthivī iyaṃ vāva sā yadidamasmin puruṣe śarīramiti | puruṣaśabdaḥ śarīraviśiṣṭajīvaparaḥ (pṛthivī) pṛthivīrūpapādaviśiṣṭā yā, (sā) gāyatrī gāyatryākhyaṃ brahma, sā śarīraṃ, śarīrākhyapādaviśiṣṭetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ bhūta pratiṣṭhā tva tad anativartya tva rūpam vidhā dvayam ca uktam atha tṛtīyam pādam āha yā vai sā pṛthivī iyam vāva sā yat idam asmin puruṣe śarīram iti puruṣa śabdaḥ śarīra viśiṣṭa jīva paraḥ pṛthivī pṛthivī rūpa pāda viśiṣṭā yā sā gāyatrī gāyatrī ākhyam brahma sā śarīram śarīra ākhya pāda viśiṣṭā iti arthaḥ

original: bhūtapṛthivyorgāyatrīsāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdiṣṭatayā (pṛthivīśabdasya) brahmaparyantatvena tadupasthāpanakṣamatvāt āgryaprāyanyāyādatrāpi (pādāntarasya tatsāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeṣṭuṃ yuktatvācca) śarīrasya brahmātmakatvaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhātvatadanativartyatvābhyāmupapādayati - asmin hīme prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ etadeva nātiśīyanta iti |
analyzed: bhūta pṛthivyoḥ gāyatrī sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdiṣṭatayā pṛthivī śabdasya brahma paryanta tvena tad upasthāpana kṣamatvāt āgrya prāya nyāyāt atra api pāda antarasya tad sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeṣṭum yukta tvāt ca śarīrasya brahma ātmaka tvam prāṇa pratiṣṭhā tva tad anativartya tvābhyām upapādayati asmin hi ime prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ etat eva na atiśīyante iti

original: caturthaṃ pādamāha - yadvai tatpuruṣe śarīraṃ idaṃ vāva tat yadidamasminnantaḥ puruṣe hṛdayam iti | śarīrākhyapādaviśiṣṭaṃ yadgāyatryākhyaṃ brahma tadeva (hṛdayam) ityarthaḥ | pūrvavat brahmātmakatvamupapādayati - asmin hīme prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ etadeva nātiśīyanta iti | prāṇāḥ prāṇāpānādayaḥ indriyāṇi vā |
analyzed: caturtham pādam āha yat vai tatpuruṣe śarīram idam vāva tat yat idam asmin antar puruṣe hṛdayam iti śarīra ākhya pāda viśiṣṭam yat gāyatrī ākhyam brahma tat eva hṛdayam iti arthaḥ pūrvavat brahma ātmaka tvam upapādayati asmin hi ime prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ etat eva na atiśīyante iti prāṇāḥ prāṇa apāna ādayaḥ indriyāṇi vā

original: teṣāṃ hṛdayasaṃbandhināḍīdvārā hṛdayapratiṣṭhitatvam | evaṃ tṛtīyacaturthau pādau prāṇapratiṣṭhātvatadanativartyatvarūpaṃ vidhādvayaṃ coktam | uktaṃ catuṣpāttvaṃ ṣājhvidhyaṃ ca nigamayati - saiṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā gāyatrīti | eṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā sā gāyatrītyanvayaḥ | etadbrahma catuṣpadatvena ṣaḍvidhatvena ca prasiddhā gāyatrītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: teṣām hṛdaya saṃbandhi nāḍī dvārā hṛdaya pratiṣṭhita tvam evam tṛtīya caturthau pādau prāṇa pratiṣṭhā tva tad anativartya tva rūpam vidhā dvayam ca uktam uktam catuṣpād tvam ṣājhvidhyam ca nigamayati sā eṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā gāyatrī iti eṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā sā gāyatrī iti anvayaḥ etat brahma catuṣpada tvena ṣaḍvidha tvena ca prasiddhā gāyatrī iti arthaḥ

original: vidheyānusārāt strīliṅganirdeśaḥ | indraśśacīpatiḥ | balena pīḍitaḥ | duścyavano vṛṣā | samitsusāsahiḥ iti catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā ca gāyatrī prasiddhā | tasyāśca ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ tatpādasya ṣaḍakṣaratvāt | catuṣpadeti gāyatrīpādasyaiva nirdeśaḥ | tasya padasyargvācakatvābhāve ṭābṛci iti vihitaṭābanupapatteḥ |
analyzed: vidheya anusārāt strī liṅga nirdeśaḥ indraḥ śacīpatiḥ balena pīḍitaḥ duścyavanaḥ vṛṣā samidh susāsahiḥ iti catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā ca gāyatrī prasiddhā tasyāḥ ca ṣaḍvidha tvam tad pādasya ṣaṣ akṣara tvāt catuṣpadā iti gāyatrī pādasya eva nirdeśaḥ tasya padasya ṛc vācaka tva abhāve ṭāp ṛci iti vihita ṭāp anupapatteḥ

original: ataścatuṣpadeti padaṃ, gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāmityatra gabhīrapadavat gāyatrīpadamukhyārthaṃ viśinaṣṭi - ṣaḍvidheti padamapi tatsamabhivyāhārāttadviśeṣaṇameva | evaṃ ca brahmaṇi gāyatryāṃ catuṣpāttvaṣāḍvidhyokterbrahmaṇi gāyatrī sādṛśye tātparyamavagamyata iti tamimaṃ śrutyarthamāha gāyatrī nāmeti |
analyzed: atas catuṣpadā iti padam gabhīrāyām nadyām iti atra gabhīra pada vat gāyatrī pada mukhya artham viśinaṣṭi ṣaḍvidhā iti padam api tad samabhivyāhārāt tad viśeṣaṇam eva evam ca brahmaṇi gāyatryām catuṣpād tva ṣāḍvidhya ukteḥ brahmaṇi gāyatrī sādṛśye tātparyam avagamyate iti tam imam śruti artham āha gāyatrī nāma iti

original: sāmaśrutiśirasi - chāndogye | bhūtakṣititanuhṛdayaiḥ - bhoktṛvargapṛthivīśarīrahṛdayaiḥ | sidhyatparyavasyat, catvāraḥ pādā yasya tat catuṣpāt, tasya bhāvaḥ cātuṣpadyam; brāhmaṇāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ṣyañ; pādasya padādeśaḥ, catuṣpādityatra ca pādasya lopaḥ ityantyalopaḥ; catuṣpāttvamityarthaḥ; paryavasyaccātuṣpadyaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: sāma śruti śirasi chāndogye bhūta kṣiti tanu hṛdayaiḥ bhoktṛ varga pṛthivī śarīra hṛdayaiḥ sidhyat paryavasyat catvāraḥ pādāḥ yasya tat catuṣpād tasya bhāvaḥ cātuṣpadyam brāhmaṇa ādeḥ ākṛti gaṇa tvāt pādasya pada ādeśaḥ catuṣpād iti atra ca pādasya lopaḥ iti antya lopaḥ catuṣpād tvam iti arthaḥ paryavasyat cātuṣpadyam yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: gānatrāṇādikābhiḥ - gānatrāṇabhūtapratiṣṭhātvatadanativartyatvarūpābhiḥ | tasya - catuṣpāttvasya, vidhābhiḥ -
analyzed: gāna trāṇa ādikābhiḥ gāna trāṇa bhūta pratiṣṭhā tva tad an ativartya tva rūpābhiḥ tasya catuṣpād tvasya vidhābhiḥ

original: tadupapādakaprakāraiḥ | ṣaḍvidhaṃ sidhyat ṣāḍvidhyakam | paraṃ jyotiḥ - atha yadataḥ paro divo jyotiḥ ityuktaṃ paraṃ brahma | gāyatrī nāma - catuṣpāttvaṣaḍvidhatvābhyāṃ prasiddhagāyatrīsadṛśatvena | adhyāyi - adhītamityarthaḥ | vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅoḥ iti gāṅādeśābhāvaḥ | nātra gāyatryāṃ brahmadṛṣṭiḥ |
analyzed: tad upapādaka prakāraiḥ ṣaḍvidham sidhyat ṣāḍvidhyakam param jyotiḥ atha yat atas paras divaḥ jyotiḥ iti uktam param brahma gāyatrī nāma catuṣpād tva ṣaḍvidha tvābhyām prasiddha gāyatrī sadṛśa tvena adhyāyi adhītam iti arthaḥ vibhāṣā luṅ lṛṅoḥ iti gāṅa ādeśa abhāvaḥ na atra gāyatryām brahma dṛṣṭiḥ

original: pūrṇāmapravartinī śriyaṃ labhate iti mokṣaphalaśravaṇāt | nāpyākāśādhikaraṇanyāyena gāyatrīśarīrakabrahmavedanam | brahmaṇaścatuṣpāttvādyuktivaiyarthyāt | ato brahmaṇi gāyatrīsādṛśyānusandhānameva vidhīyata iti bhāvaḥ | atra sidhyatpadena - pādo’sya viśvā bhūtāni ityanantaramantre kaṇṭhoktacatuṣpāttvavyāvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: śriyam labhate iti mokṣa phala śravaṇāt na api ākāśa adhikaraṇa nyāyena gāyatrī śarīraka brahma vedanam brahmaṇaḥ catuṣpād tva ādi ukti vaiyarthyāt atas brahmaṇi gāyatrī sādṛśya anusandhānam eva vidhīyate iti bhāvaḥ atra sidhyat padena pādaḥ usya viśvā bhūtāni iti anantara mantre kaṇṭha ukta catuṣpād tva vyāvṛttiḥ

original: tuśabdena - vāk pādaḥ prāṇaḥ pādaḥ ityuktasya, agniḥ pādo vāyuḥ pādaḥ ityuktasya ca catuṣpāttvasya vyudāsaḥ | bhūtapṛthivyādīnāṃ kīrtanānantaraṃ catuṣpadeti nigamanasvārasyāt bhūtapṛthivyādīnāṃ pādatvaṃ pratīyata iti, idaṃ catuṣpāttvaṃ na kaṇṭhoktam; kintu paryavasānagatyā siddham |
analyzed: tuśabdena vāc pādaḥ prāṇaḥ pādaḥ iti uktasya agniḥ pādaḥ vāyuḥ pādaḥ iti uktasya ca catuṣpād tvasya vyudāsaḥ bhūta pṛthivī ādīnām kīrtana anantaram catuṣpada iti nigamana svārasyāt bhūta pṛthivī ādīnām pāda tvam pratīyate iti idam catuṣpād tvam na kaṇṭha uktam kintu paryavasāna gatyā siddham

original: śrutigatavacanavyaktibhedāt - yā vai sā gāyatrī iyaṃ vāva sā idaṃ vāva tat iti śrutiśailīvailakṣaṇyāt | vāgvai gāyatrī asmin hīme prāṇāḥ ityetadrūpācchailīviśeṣāddhetoḥ | vākprāṇoktiḥ parārthā - gānatrāṇaprāṇapratiṣṭhātvādyupapādanārthā | natu bhūtādipadaṣaṭkapratipādanārthā |
analyzed: śruti gata vacana vyakti bhedāt yā vai sā gāyatrī iyam vāva sā idam vāva tat iti śruti śailī vailakṣaṇyāt vāc vai gāyatrī asmin hi ime prāṇāḥ iti etad rūpāt śailī viśeṣāt hetoḥ vāc prāṇa uktiḥ para arthā gāna trāṇa prāṇa pratiṣṭhā tva ādi upapādana arthā na tu bhūta ādi pada ṣaṭka pratipādana arthā

original: tadetat - pūrvoktaṃ, catuṣpāttvaṣaḍvidhatvābhyāṃ brahmaṇi gāyatrīsādṛśyānusandhānam | svarasaṃ - svataḥ pratītatvalakṣaṇarasayuktaṃ, nigamanaṃ - kīrtitopasaṃhārarūpaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathoktā śrutiḥ - saiṣā catuṣpadeti śrutiḥ tadadhīnaṃ - tatpramāṇakamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tat etat pūrva uktam catuṣpād tva ṣaḍvidha tvābhyām brahmaṇi gāyatrī sādṛśya anusandhānam svarasam svatas pratīta tva lakṣaṇa rasa yuktam nigamanam kīrtita upasaṃhāra rūpam yasyām sā tathā uktā śrutiḥ sā eṣā catuṣpadā iti śrutiḥ tad adhīnam tad pramāṇakam iti arthaḥ

original: atra śrutigatavacanavyaktibhedāt svarasanigamanaśrutyadhīnamityābhyāmasyāḥ śruteḥ paroktārtho’nupapanna iti sphoritam |
analyzed: atra śruti gata vacana vyakti bhedāt svarasa nigamana śruti adhīnam iti ābhyām asyāḥ śruteḥ parokta arthaḥ anupapannaḥ iti sphoritam

original: yādavaprakāśairasyā hyayamartha uktaḥ - gāyatrī vā idaṃ sarvam iti brāhmaṇaṃ na catuṣpāttvaparam, kintu sarvabhūtavākpṛthivīśarīrahṛdayaprāṇarūpavidhāṣaṭkaparam | saiṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā iti vākyaṃ ca ṣāḍvidhyānuvādena catuṣpāttvavidhānaparam | catuṣpāttvaṃ ca pādo’sya iti mantravarṇapratipādyamiti |
analyzed: yādavaprakāśaiḥ asyāḥ hi ayam arthaḥ uktaḥ gāyatrī vai idam sarvam iti brāhmaṇam na catuṣpād tva param kintu sarva bhūta vāc pṛthivī śarīra hṛdaya prāṇa rūpa vidhā ṣaṭka param sā eṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā iti vākyam ca ṣāḍvidhya anuvādena catuṣpād tva vidhāna param catuṣpād tvam ca pādaḥ usyaḥ iti mantra varṇa pratipādyam iti

original: ayamanupapannaḥ - saiṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhetyubhayāṃśe nigamanapratīteḥ svārasikatvādekāṃśe’nuvādatvam, itarāṃśe vidhāyakatvamiti vairūpyāyogāt | vākprāṇayorgānatrāṇādivadanyārthatayā bhūtapṛthivyādivat prādhānyataḥ pratipādyatvābhāvena padārthaṣaṭkāsiddheśceti || 27 ||
analyzed: ayam anupapannaḥ sā eṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā iti ubhaya aṃśe nigamana pratīteḥ svārasika tvāt eka aṃśe nuvāda tvam itara aṃśe vidhāyaka tvam iti vairūpya ayogāt vāc prāṇayoḥ gāna trāṇa ādi vat anya artha tayā bhūta pṛthivī ādi vat prādhānyataḥ pratipādya tva abhāvena padārtha ṣaṭka asiddheḥ ca iti

original: atha antaryāmyadhikaraṇam -

analyzed: antaryāmi adhikaraṇa viṣaya bhūte intaryāmibrāhmaṇe yasya tamaḥ śarīram iti atra

original: vākyārthānadhyavasāyaḥ; yasya cetanasya yaddravyam iti śarīralakṣaṇasya dravya tvaghaṭitatvāt tamasaśca dravyādravyatvayorvādivākyasaṃmohādatrāha -

analyzed: atas kalpyaḥ hetuḥ pramitiḥ api śābdī vijayate

original: nirālokaṃ cakṣuḥ prathayati hi tadṛrśanavaśāt || 28 ||
analyzed: nirālokam cakṣuḥ prathayati hi tad dṛrśana vaśāt

original: bahulaṃ ca tadviralaṃ ceti vigrahe (khaṃjakubjādivat) samāsaḥ | bahulaṃ - sāndraṃ, viralaṃ - sāntarālam | ekavyaktau sāndratvādyabhāvādavayavasaghātātmakatvamuktaṃ bhavati | anena sāvayavatvamuktam | mecakaṃ - nīlaṃ calaṃ calanavat | pūrvavatsamāsaḥ | ābhyāṃ guṇakriyāvattvaṃ uktaṃṭabhavati | tamo nāma dvitīyāntamidaṃ, nāma prasiddhau |
analyzed: bahulam ca tat viralam ca iti vigrahe khaṃja kubja ādi vat samāsaḥ bahulam sāndram viralam sa antarālam eka vyaktau sāndra tva ādi abhāvāt avayava saghāta ātmaka tvam uktam bhavati anena sāvayavatvam uktam mecakam nīlam calam calana vat pūrvavat samāsaḥ ābhyām guṇa kriyāvattvam tamaḥ nāma dvitīya antam idam nāma prasiddhau

original: anena bhāvarūpeṇa bhāsamānatvamuktaṃ bhavati | dravyaṃ pratīmaḥ dravyatvena pratyakṣayāmaḥ | anuminuma iti vā | tamo dravyaṃ sāvayavatvāddhaṭavat; tamo dravyaṃ guṇakriyāśrayatvāt ghaṭavat; tamo na tejo’bhāvarūpaṃ vidhi rūpeṇa pratīyamānatvāt ghaṭavat; tamo na guṇaḥ guṇāśrayatvena pratīyamānatvāt, ghaṭavat;
analyzed: anena bhāva rūpeṇa bhāsamāna tvam uktam bhavati dravyam pratīmaḥ dravya tvena pratyakṣayāmaḥ anuminumaḥ iti vā tamaḥ dravyam sa avayava tvāt dhaṭa vat tamaḥ dravyam guṇa kriyā āśraya tvāt ghaṭa vat tamaḥ na tejaḥ bhāva rūpam vidhi rūpeṇa pratīyamāna tvāt ghaṭa vat tamaḥ na guṇaḥ guṇa āśraya tvena pratīyamāna tvāt ghaṭa vat

original: tamo na rūpapratītyabhāvaḥ vidhi rūpeṇa pratīyamānatvāt ghaṭavat; (vadi ityanumānatvāt ghaṭa) ityanumānāni vivakṣitāni | atra mecakamityanena viyadvyāptapārthivaparamāṇugatanailyapratītirevāndhakārapratītiriti pakṣaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ | tathā sati hi nailyamityeva tamoviṣayakadhīḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tamaḥ na rūpa pratīti abhāvaḥ rūpeṇa pratīyamāna tvāt ghaṭa vat vadi iti anumāna tvāt ghaṭaḥ iti anumānāni vivakṣitāni atra mecakam iti anena viyat vyāpta pārthiva paramāṇu gata nailya pratītiḥ eva andhakāra pratītiḥ iti pakṣaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ tathā sati hi nailyam iti eva tamaḥ viṣayaka dhīḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tama iti bhāvarūpeṇa pratīyamānatvādityanena tejassaṃsargābhāvo rūpapratītyabhāvo vā tama iti pakṣau pratikṣiptau | hetvasidiṃdha pariharati - kenāpītyādinā | kenāpi | puruṣeṇeti śeṣaḥ | kvacidapī tyapiśabdena kadāpīti samuccīyate | bādhaḥ - rūpādiniṣedhadhīḥ | na dadṛśe - na dṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ | dṛśeḥ karmaṇi liṭ |
analyzed: tamaḥ iti bhāva rūpeṇa pratīyamāna tvāt iti anena tejaḥ saṃsarga abhāvaḥ rūpa pratīti abhāvaḥ vā tamaḥ iti pakṣau pratikṣiptau pariharati kena api ityādinā kena api puruṣeṇa iti śeṣaḥ kvacid api iti apiśabdena kadāpi iti samuccīyate bādhaḥ rūpa ādi niṣedha dhīḥ na dadṛśe na dṛṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ dṛśeḥ karmaṇi liṭ

original: bādhaśceti cakāreṇa kāraṇadoṣaḥ samuccīyate | tathā ca kāraṇadoṣabādhakapratyayavirahāttamasi rūpādipratītirna bhrāntirūpeti na hetvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | tamasi rūpādipratīterbhrāntitvaniyāmako doṣo na dṛśyate | tamasi rūpādipratīteḥ sarvānubhavasiddhatvena sarvatra tatkalpanaṃ ca gauravaparāhatam | ataḥ kāraṇadoṣo durvaca iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: bādhaḥ ca iti cakāreṇa kāraṇa doṣaḥ samuccīyate tathā ca kāraṇa doṣa bādhaka pratyaya virahāt tamasi rūpa ādi pratītiḥ na bhrānti rūpā iti na hetu asiddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ tamasi rūpa ādi pratīteḥ bhrānti tva niyāmakaḥ doṣaḥ na dṛśyate tamasi rūpa ādi pratīteḥ sarva anubhava siddha tvena sarvatra tad kalpanam ca gaurava parāhatam atas kāraṇa doṣaḥ durvacaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu (tamasaḥ kāraṇanirūpaṇāttamo na dravyam) tathā hi tamaso rūpavattvānna tadrahitāni vāyvādīni tatkāraṇāni| sparśagandhavirahānnānyānyapi tatkāraṇāni | (kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa hi kārye vaiśeṣikaguṇārambha ityatrāha) - ataḥ kalpyo heturiti | tamasi rūpādipratīterabādhitatvāt dravyatvasiddhau tatkāraṇaṃ kalpyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu tamasaḥ kāraṇa nirūpaṇāt tamaḥ na dravyam tathā hi tamasaḥ rūpavat tvāt na tad rahitāni vāyu ādīni tad kāraṇāni sparśa gandha virahāt na anyāni api tad kāraṇāni kāraṇa guṇa prakrameṇa hi kārye vaiśeṣika guṇa ārambhaḥ iti atra āha atas kalpyaḥ hetuḥ iti tamasi rūpa ādi pratīteḥ abādhita tvāt dravya tva siddhau tat kāraṇam kalpyam iti arthaḥ

original: loke kāryaṃ hi pratītaṃ kāraṇakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam na punaḥ sphuṭāvadhāritaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇanirūpaṇāyāpahnavamarhati iti nyāyāt | abādhitapratyayasiddhasya tamasaḥ kāraṇaṃ kalpyam | tatra svacchadravyatvādākāśakāryaṃ tamaḥ | rūpavattvaṃ tu pañcīkaraṇādupapadyate | yadvā tejaḥkāryaṃ tamaḥ rūpavattvāt; sparśānupalambhastu svacchatvāt iti vyāsapādāḥ |
analyzed: loke kāryam hi pratītam kāraṇa kalpanāyām pramāṇam na punar sphuṭa avadhāritam kāryam kāraṇa nirūpaṇāya apahnavam arhati iti nyāyāt abādhita pratyaya siddhasya tamasaḥ kāraṇam kalpyam tatra svaccha dravya tvāt ākāśa kāryam tamaḥ rūpavat tvam tu pañcīkaraṇāt upapadyate yat vā tejaḥ kāryam tamaḥ rūpavat tvāt sparśa anupalambhaḥ tu svaccha tvāt iti vyāsa pādāḥ

original: prabhāprabhāvadrūpeṇa tejodravyavat, pṛthivyeva tamorūpeṇa tadāśrayarūpeṇa ca sthitā | pṛthivīcchāyaiva tama iti meghanādārisūrayaḥ | nyāyasiddhāñjane’pi pṛthivīviṣaye tamaḥ parigaṇitam | ataḥ kāraṇaṃ kalpanīyam |
analyzed: prabhā prabhāvat rūpeṇa tejaḥ dravya vat pṛthivī eva tamaḥ rūpeṇa tad āśraya rūpeṇa ca sthitā pṛthivī chāyā eva tamaḥ iti meghanāda ari sūrayaḥ nyāyasiddhāñjane api pṛthivī viṣaye tamaḥ parigaṇitam atas kāraṇam kalpanīyam

original: nanu rūpopalabdhivelāyāṃ tamaso’nupalabdheḥ, tadanupalabdhikāle tadupalabdhirnimīlanavadapi saṃbhavatīti śaṅkitaṃ pratyakṣamityatrāha - pramitirapi śābdī vijayata iti | śāstrajanyaṃ pramātmakaṃ jñānamuktaśaṅkānirāsakamityarthaḥ | vijayo hi pratipakṣanirasanam | tamaḥ sasarja bhagavān ityādikamiha vivakṣitam |
analyzed: nanu rūpa upalabdhi velāyām tamasaḥ anupalabdheḥ tad anupalabdhi kāle tad upalabdhiḥ nimīlana vat api saṃbhavati iti śaṅkitam pratyakṣam iti atra āha pramitiḥ api śābdī vijayataḥ iti śāstra janyam pramā ātmakam jñānam ukta śaṅkā nirāsakam iti arthaḥ vijayaḥ hi pratipakṣa nirasanam tamaḥ sasarja bhagavān iti ādikam iha vivakṣitam

original: (apiśabdena yuktirapi saṃgṛhyate | ulūkādīnāmasmadādirūpopalabdhivelāyāṃ rūpānupalabdhyā asmadādīnāṃ tadrūpopalabdhikāle tadanupalabdhyā tayoḥ śaṅkitatvaprasaṅgāttamasi rūpapratītirna bhrāntirityarthaḥ) nanu tamo na dravyaṃ tasya grāhakābhāvāt | ālokānanugṛhītatvāt cakṣurna grāhakam ||
analyzed: apiśabdena yuktiḥ api saṃgṛhyate ulūka ādīnām asmat ādi rūpa upalabdhi velāyām rūpa anupalabdhyā asmat ādīnām tad rūpa upalabdhi kāle tad anupalabdhyā tayoḥ śaṅkita tva prasaṅgāt tamasi rūpa pratītiḥ na bhrāntiḥ iti arthaḥ nanu tamaḥ na dravyam tasya grāhaka abhāvāt āloka ananugṛhīta tvāt cakṣuḥ na grāhakam

original: (ālokasannidhāvanavasthānāṃ nāsyāgrāhyatvamato rūpapratītirbhrāntireva) nimīlane nīlapratibhāsavadityatrāha - nirālokamityādi | nirālokaṃ - ālokāsahakṛtam | cakṣuḥ - kartṛ | tat - tamaḥ | prathayati - prakāśayati | kuta ityatrāha - darśanavaśāt - ulūkāderasmadādeśca rūpatejo’bhāvagrahaṇe cakṣuṣa ālokanirapekṣatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: āloka sannidhau anavasthānām na asya agrāhya tvam atas rūpa pratītiḥ bhrāntiḥ eva nimīlane nīla pratibhāsa vat iti atra āha nirālokam ityādi nirālokam āloka asahakṛtam cakṣuḥ kartṛ tat tamaḥ prathayati prakāśayati kutas iti atra āha darśana vaśāt ulūka ādeḥ asmat ādeḥ ca rūpa tejaḥ bhāva grahaṇe cakṣuṣaḥ āloka nirapekṣa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: ālokābhāvabhinnaviṣayakacākṣuṣatvenālokasaṃyogatvena kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ paramate | asmanmate tu ālokābhāvabhinnasthāne tamobhinnatvaṃ niveśya kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | rūpapratīterbhramatvakalpanaṃ tvadhikaṃ paramata iti bhāvaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: āloka abhāva bhinna viṣayaka cākṣuṣa tvena āloka saṃyoga tvena kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ para mate asmad mate tu āloka abhāva bhinna sthāne tamaḥ bhinna tvam niveśya kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ rūpa pratīteḥ bhrama tva kalpanam tu adhikam para mate iti bhāvaḥ

original: bhūmādhikaraṇasiddhāntamāha -
analyzed: bhūma adhikaraṇa siddhāntam āha

original: bhūmākhyaḥ pūruṣottamo yadadhikaṃ brahmeha satyāhvayaṃ
analyzed: bhūma ākhyaḥ pūruṣottamaḥ yat adhikam brahma iha satya āhvayam

original: prāṇākhyādavarātmanastu balatastajadjñādhikassatyavit |
analyzed: prāṇa ākhyāt avara ātmanaḥ tu balataḥ tad jad jña adhikaḥ satya vid

original: yaḥ satyaṃ vadatīti vāggamayituṃ na hyagnihotryantaraṃ
analyzed: yaḥ satyam vadati iti vāc gamayitum na hi agnihotrī antaram

original: śaknoti prakṛtāgnihotryavagamādbhaṅgastu śabdaśriyaḥ || 29 ||
analyzed: śaknoti prakṛta agnihotrī avagamāt bhaṅgaḥ tu śabda śriyaḥ 29

original: chandogāḥ samāmananti - yatra nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti sa bhūmā | atha yatrānyatpaśyatyanyacchṛṇotyanyadvijānāti tadalpam iti | ayaṃ bhūmaśabdo (vaipulyaviśiṣṭavācaka) bahuśabdādimanici niṣpanno, yadyapi vaipulyavāci; tathāpi (alpa)pratiyoginirdeśatvādvaipulyāśrayaparaḥ; tathā ca bhūmā vipula ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: chandogāḥ samāmananti yatra na anyat paśyati na anyat śṛṇoti na anyat vijānāti sa bhūmā atha yatra anyat paśyati anyat śṛṇoti anyat vijānāti tat alpam iti ayam bhūma śabdaḥ vaipulya viśiṣṭa vācaka niṣpannaḥ yadi api vaipulya vāci tathā api alpa pratiyogi nirdeśa tvāt vaipulya āśraya paraḥ tathā ca bhūmā vipulaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: bhūmaśabdārthaviśeṣyaścātmā; tarati śokamātmavit iti prakramya, bhūmānamupadiśya, ātmaivedaṃ sarvam ityupasaṃhārāt | tatra kimayaṃ bhūmaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ pratyagātmā paramātmā veti saṃśayaḥ |
analyzed: bhūma śabda artha viśeṣyaḥ ca ātmā tarati śokam ātma vid iti prakramya bhūmānam upadiśya ātmā eva idam sarvam iti upasaṃhārāt tatra kim ayam bhūma guṇa viśiṣṭaḥ pratyagātmā paramātmā vā iti saṃśayaḥ

original: pratyagātmā bhūmeti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | ātmajijñāsave nāradāya prāṇopadeśānantaramanyānupadeśena prāṇaśabditajīva eva ātmopadeśasamāptipratīteḥ | pratyagātmano’pyavidyāmuktasya sukharūpatvamupapadyate |
analyzed: pratyagātmā bhūmā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ ātma jijñāsave nāradāya prāṇa upadeśa anantaram anya anupadeśena prāṇa śabdita jīvaḥ eva ātma upadeśa samāpti pratīteḥ pratyagātmanā upi avidyā muktasya sukha rūpatvam upapadyate

original: na ca eṣa tu vā ativadati yaḥ satyenātivadati iti tuśabdena prāṇātivādinamapekṣya satyātivādino’nyatvapratīteḥ prāṇaśabdoktajīvādadhike satyanāmani brahmaṇi ātmopadeśasamāptyavagamena bhūmā paramātmeti vācyam | sa vā eṣa evaṃ paśyan iti prakṛtaprāṇātivādinaḥ pratyabhijñānena tasya, eṣa tu vā ativadati iti satyavadanamaṅgaṃ vidhīyate |
analyzed: na ca eṣa tu vai ativadati yaḥ satyena ativadati iti tuśabdena prāṇa ativādinam apekṣya satya ativādinaḥ anyatva pratīteḥ prāṇa śabda ukta jīvāt adhike satya nāmani brahmaṇi ātma upadeśa samāpti avagamena bhūmā paramātmā iti vācyam sa vai eṣaḥ evam paśyan iti prakṛta prāṇa ativādinaḥ pratyabhijñānena tasya eṣa tu vai ativadati iti satya vadanam aṅgam vidhīyate

original: yathā eṣa tu vā agnī hotrī yaḥ satyaṃ vadati iti prakṛtāgnihotriṇaḥ satyavadanaṃ vidhīyate; tadvaditi |
analyzed: yathā eṣa tu vai agniḥ hotrī yaḥ satyam vadati iti prakṛta agnihotriṇaḥ satya vadanam vidhīyate tadvat iti

original: siddhāntastu - paramātmaiva bhūmā eṣa tu vā iti prāṇātivādyanyatvapratīteḥ | na ca eṣa tu vā agnihotrī iti vākyanyāyāvatāraḥ | tatra hi dravyadevatāntarābhāvenāgnihotrāntarāpratīteragatyā tuśabdasvārasyabhaṅgaḥ | iha tu - prakṛtātivādanimittaprāṇātiriktasatyaśabdoktaparamātmarūpātivādanimittāntarasaṃbhavātkimiti tuśabdasvārasyabhaṅgaḥ kāryaḥ |
analyzed: siddhāntaḥ tu paramātmā eva bhūmā eṣa tu vā iti prāṇa ativādi anyatva pratīteḥ na ca eṣa tu vā agnihotrī iti vākya nyāya avatāraḥ tatra hi dravya devatā antara abhāvena agnihotra antara apratīteḥ agatyā tuśabda svārasya bhaṅgaḥ iha tu prakṛta ativāda nimitta prāṇa atirikta satya śabda ukta paramātma rūpa ativāda nimitta antara saṃbhavāt kim iti tuśabda svārasya bhaṅgaḥ kāryaḥ

original: satyaśabdo hi paramātmavācakaḥ | chāndogya eva tasya brahmaṇo nāma satyam iti śravaṇāt | ataḥ satyaśabdokte paramātmani ātmaśabdaparyavasānādbhūmā paramātmeti |
analyzed: satya śabdaḥ hi paramātma vācakaḥ chāndogye eva tasya brahmaṇaḥ nāma satyam iti śravaṇāt atas satya śabda ukte paramātmani ātma śabda paryavasānāt bhūmā paramātmā iti

original: tamimaṃ siddhāntamāha - bhūmākhya ityādinā | bhūmā niratiśayasukhalakṣaṇatayā vede bhūmaśabdanirdiṣṭaḥ puruṣāṇāmuttamo nārāyaṇa eva | kuta ityatrāha - yaditi | yat - yasmāt |
analyzed: tam imam siddhāntam āha bhūma ākhyaḥ ityādinā bhūmā niratiśaya sukha lakṣaṇatayā vede bhūma śabda nirdiṣṭaḥ puruṣāṇām uttamaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ eva kutas iti atra āha yat iti yat yasmāt

original: iha - bhūmavidyāyām | prāṇākhyāt - prāṇasahacāreṇa prāṇaśabdopacaritādavarātmanaḥ | ārāgramātro hyavaro’pi dṛṣṭaḥ iti paramātmāpekṣayāpakṛṣṭājjīvāt | adhikaṃ - atiriktam | brahma, satyāhvayaṃ - satyaśabdābhihitaṃbhavati | tataḥ paramātmanyātmaśabdopadeśaparyavasānādbhūmā puruṣottama ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: iha bhūmavidyāyām prāṇa ākhyāt prāṇa sahacāreṇa prāṇa śabda upacaritāt avara ātmanaḥ ārā agra mātraḥ hi avaraḥ api dṛṣṭaḥ iti paramātma apekṣayā apakṛṣṭāt jīvāt adhikam atiriktam brahma satya āhvayam satya śabda abhihitam bhavati tatas paramātmani ātma śabda upadeśa paryavasānāt bhūmā puruṣottamaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: puruṣaṃ satyam iti satyaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyena puruṣaśabdanirdeśā tpuruṣottama iti sādhyanirdeśaḥ | saṃprasādādadhyupadeśāt iti sūtrānusāreṇādhikamiti nirdeśaḥ | nanu eṣa tu vā ativadati iti prāṇātivādinaḥ satyavadanaṃ vidhīyata ityatrāha - tubalata iti | satyavit -
analyzed: puruṣam satyam iti satya śabda sāmānādhikaraṇyena puruṣa śabda nirdeśāt puruṣottamaḥ iti sādhya nirdeśaḥ saṃprasādāt adhi upadeśāt iti sūtra anusāreṇa adhikam iti nirdeśaḥ nanu eṣa tu vai ativadati iti prāṇa ativādinaḥ satya vadanam vidhīyate iti atra āha iti satya vid

original: satyanāmakabrahmanimittakātivādahetusatyavedanavān tubalataḥ - tubalena | tatjñādhikaḥ - prāṇavedyadhikaḥ | tuśabdo hi pūrvoktādarthāntare svarasaḥ | ataḥ prāṇātivādino’nyaḥ satyavādī kaściducyate | prāṇātivādinamapekṣya satyātivādinaḥ
analyzed: satya nāmaka brahma nimittaka ativāda hetu satya vedanavān tubalataḥ tubalena tad jña adhikaḥ prāṇa vedi adhikaḥ tuśabdaḥ hi pūrva uktāt artha antare svarasaḥ atas prāṇa ativādinaḥ anyaḥ satya vādī kaścid ucyate prāṇa ativādinam apekṣya satya ativādinaḥ

original: prakarṣaśca, tadvedyaprāṇādetadvedyasatyaprakarṣanibandhana iti satyaśabdokte prakṛtātmopadeśaparyavasānāt bhūmā puruṣottama ityarthaḥ | eṣa tu vā agnihotrī iti vākyavaiṣamyamāha - ya iti | yaḥ satyaṃ vadatīti vāk - eṣa tu vā agnihotrī yaḥ satyaṃ vadati iti vākyam |

original: rakṣohāgamaladhvasandehāḥ prayojanam ityatra tu padasaṃskārapakṣāśrayaṇādantaraṅgatvāt prathamamupajāyamānetaretarayogadvandvaprayuktaṃ bahutvaṃ padāntarasambandhanimittakena bahiraṅgeṇaikavadbhāvena bādhituṃ na śakyamiti bahuvacanopapattiḥ | padavākyasaṃskārapakṣayośca lakṣyānurodhitvāt |

original: kvacidvākyasaṃskārapakṣāśrayaṇena vyākaraṇamadhijigāṃsamānebhyaḥ prayojanamanvākhyāyata ityatra samānādhikaraṇatiṅantasyaikavacanāntatvaṃkṛtamityupadarśitavyāsapādasūkternirvāhāntarāṇi tu pārāśaryavijaye mahācāryairanugṛhītāni tatraiva draṣṭavyāni || 30 ||

original: devatārahiteṣu keṣucidapūrvasyāvaśyakatvānnārthavādikaprasādādaraḥ | ato’śarīrāṇāmacetanānāṃ devatānāmanadhikaro brahmopāsaneṣviti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
analyzed: devatā rahiteṣu keṣucid apūrvasya āvaśyaka tvāt na ārthavādika prasāda ādaraḥ atas śarīrāṇām acetanānām devatānām anadhikaraḥ brahma upāsaneṣu iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ

original: siddhāntastu - sāmavidhibrāhmaṇe, mayi varca ityetena kalpena catvāri varṣāṇi prayuñjānastrayāṇāṃ lokānāmādhipatyaṃ gacchati iti indrapadasya phalatvaśravaṇāt, anyatrāpi marudādidevatāpadaprāptermadhuvidyāphalatvokteḥ, devatāvaśīkārasya ca tatra tatra phalatvokteḥ, phale ca tātparyāvaśyaṃbhāvāt, upāsanaprakaraṇasthairapi tau ha prajāpatim
analyzed: siddhāntaḥ tu sāma vidhi brāhmaṇe mayi varcaḥ iti etena kalpena catvāri varṣāṇi prayuñjānaḥ trayāṇām lokānām ādhipatyam gacchati iti indra padasya phala tva śravaṇāt anyatra api marut ādi devatā pada prāpteḥ madhu vidyā phala tva ukteḥ devatā vaśīkārasya ca tatra tatra phala tva ukteḥ phale ca tātparya avaśyaṃbhāvāt upāsana prakaraṇa sthaiḥ api tau ha prajāpatim

original: ityādibhiḥ karmavidhiśeṣabhūtaiśca vajrahastaḥ ityādibhirdevatānāṃ caitanyādisiddhiḥ | ata eva cārthavādikaprasādādarāvaśyaṃbhāvaḥ | devatārahiteṣu ca bhagavata eva svaprasādadvārā phalapradatvam |
analyzed: ityādibhiḥ karma vidhi śeṣa bhūtaiḥ ca vajrahastaḥ ityādibhiḥ devatānām caitanya ādi siddhiḥ atas eva ca ārthavādika prasāda ādara avaśyaṃbhāvaḥ devatā rahiteṣu ca bhagavataḥ eva sva prasāda dvārā phala prada tvam

original: mantrārthavādayośca vidhivadevāpauruṣeyatvādisāmyāt prāmāṇyam | smṛtistutī ca nirālambane na prasidhyataḥ | asatkīrtanena ca na prarocanā saṃbhavati | vedānteṣu devādicaturvidhasṛṣṭirāmnāyate | ato devatāvigrahādisadbhāvāt brahmavidyāyāmastyevādhikāro devatānāmiti | tamimamāha - paṭutareti |
analyzed: mantra arthavādayoḥ ca vidhivat eva apauruṣeya tva ādi sāmyāt prāmāṇyam smṛti stutī ca nirālambane na prasidhyataḥ asat kīrtanena ca na prarocanā saṃbhavati vedānteṣu deva ādi caturvidha sṛṣṭiḥ āmnāyate atas devatā vigraha ādi sadbhāvāt brahmavidyāyām asti eva adhikāraḥ devatānām iti tam imam āha paṭutara iti

original: paṭutaraṃ ca tat vigrahādi ceti vigrahe karmadhārayaḥ | ādipadena veda parigrahaḥ | brahma bṛhaspatiḥ ityādinā devānāṃ brāhmaṇyā dyavagamādbhavāntarādhigatavedāpramoṣeṇa vā tatsiddhiḥ | vigrahasya paṭutaratvaṃ jātaputraḥ ityuktāvasthāviśeṣarūpaṃ, viṣṇukramaṇādau yogyatārūpaṃ, apaṅgutvādikaṃ ca vivakṣitam |
analyzed: paṭutaram ca tat vigraha ādi ca iti vigrahe karmadhārayaḥ ādi padena veda parigrahaḥ brahma bṛhaspatiḥ ityādinā devānām brāhmaṇyā ādi avagamāt bhava antara adhigata veda apramoṣeṇa vā tad siddhiḥ vigrahasya paṭutara tvam jāta putraḥ iti ukta avasthā viśeṣa rūpam viṣṇu kramaṇa ādau yogyatā rūpam apaṅgu tva ādikam ca vivakṣitam

original: vidyāyāḥ paṭutaratvaṃ ca upadeṣṭṛnairapekṣyādirūpaṃ vivakṣitam | vigrahādīti dvitīyāntaṃ, sāmānye klībam | vahatāṃ - bhāratayā bibhratām | anena durapahnavatvaṃ vyajyate | bhavatāpavatāṃ - saṃsāratāpāturāṇām | atiśāyane matup | gajasyāpi svānurūpo vātaroga itivaditi bhāvaḥ | ābhyāmarthī samartho vidvāṃścetyuktamadhikāratrayamuktam |
analyzed: vidyāyāḥ paṭutara tvam ca upadeṣṭṛ nairapekṣya ādi rūpam vivakṣitam vigraha ādi iti dvitīyā antam sāmānye klībam vahatām bhāratayā bibhratām anena durapahnava tvam vyajyate bhava tāpavatām saṃsāra tāpa āturāṇām atiśāyane matup gajasya api sva anurūpaḥ vāta rogaḥ iti vat iti bhāvaḥ ābhyām arthī samarthaḥ vidvān ca iti uktam adhikāra trayam uktam

original: tathāvidhānāṃ diviṣadāmapi devatānāmapi | etadapekṣayā prakṛṣṭaviṣṭapasthatve’pi nityavibhūtyapekṣayā nirayasthatvātteṣāmupāsanecchā saṃbhavatīti sūcyate | bhagavataḥ - heyapratibhaṭakalyāṇaguṇākarasya anena upāyopeyatvaupayikaguṇaviśeṣā abhipretāḥ | upāsanaṃ - asakṛdāvṛttacintanam | saṃbhavati - prāmāṇikamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathāvidhānām diviṣadām api devatānām api etad apekṣayā prakṛṣṭa viṣṭapa sthatve pi nitya vibhūti apekṣayā niraya sthatvāt teṣām upāsana icchā saṃbhavati iti sūcyate bhagavataḥ heya pratibhaṭa kalyāṇa guṇa ākarasya anena upāya upeya tva aupayika guṇa viśeṣāḥ abhipretāḥ upāsanam asakṛt āvṛtta cintanam saṃbhavati prāmāṇikam iti arthaḥ

original: atropāsanamityanena taduparyapi bādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt iti sūtrasthatacchabdārtha uktaḥ | diviṣadāmityupariśabdārthaḥ | manuṣyādhikāratvāditi pūrvasūtraprastutamanuṣyādhikārastatrātra ca, apinā samuccīyate | paṭutaretyādinā saṃbhavāditi śabdasyārtha
analyzed: atra upāsanam iti anena tad upari api bādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt iti sūtra stha tad śabda arthaḥ uktaḥ diviṣadām iti upari śabda arthaḥ manuṣya adhikāra tvāt iti pūrva sūtra prastuta manuṣya adhikāraḥ tatra atra ca apinā samuccīyate paṭutara ityādinā saṃbhavāt iti śabdasya arthaḥ

original: uktaḥ | arthavādavacasāṃ - vajrahastaḥ ityādīnāṃ | atha taddhobhaye devāsurāḥ ityādīnāṃ ca karmopāsanavidhiśeṣabhūtārthavādavākyānām | mantragirāṃ - devatāstutyanuṣṭheyaprakāśanaparamantravarṇānām | apiśabdena devatāpadaprāpti sādhanakarmavidhayo gṛhyante |
analyzed: uktaḥ arthavāda vacasām vajrahastaḥ ityādīnām atha tat ha ubhaye deva asurāḥ ityādīnām ca karma upāsana vidhi śeṣa bhūta arthavāda vākyānām mantra girām devatā stuti anuṣṭheya prakāśana para mantra varṇānām api śabdena devatā pada prāpti sādhana karma vidhayaḥ gṛhyante

original: śataṃ ānantyaparam (idaṃ vināpi mānāntaravirodhaṃ) bhūyasāṃ balīyastvaṃ na bādhitavyamiti bhāvaḥ | pramāṇam - abādhitārthapratipādakam (iti yojanā) | tatkathaṃbhūtamityatrāha - apadoṣamiti nirdoṣam (pauruṣeyaṃ ca) apuṃprabhavaṃ - apauruṣeyaṃ ca) vidhivat - vidhivākyavat pramāṇameva | nanvityavadhāraṇe |
analyzed: śatam ānantya param idam vinā api māna antara virodham bhūyasām balīyaḥ tvam na bādhitavyam iti bhāvaḥ pramāṇam abādhita artha pratipādakam iti yojanā tat kathaṃbhūtam iti atra āha apadoṣam iti nirdoṣam pauruṣeyam ca a puṃprabhavam apauruṣeyam ca vidhivat vidhi vākya vat pramāṇam eva nanu iti avadhāraṇe

original: nirdoṣāpauruṣeyatvasāmyāt, mānāntaravirodhavirahācca arthavādādervidhivadeva prāmāṇyāt devatāvigrahādisiddherarthitvādisaṃbhavādastyeva brahmavidyādhikāro devānāmiti, mantrārthavādayorvidhivatprāmāṇyasthāpanasaṃrambheṇa kaṇṭhoktiḥ | vidhiśeṣāṇāṃ tu
analyzed: nirdoṣa apauruṣeya tva sāmyāt māna antara virodha virahāt ca arthavāda ādeḥ vidhivat eva prāmāṇyāt devatā vigraha ādi siddheḥ arthi tva ādi saṃbhavāt asti eva brahma vidyā adhikāraḥ devānām iti mantra arthavādayoḥ vidhivat prāmāṇya sthāpana saṃrambheṇa kaṇṭhoktiḥ vidhi śeṣāṇām tu

original: pratiyogyabhyupagamādapiśabdena sūcanamiti dhyeyam || 31 ||
analyzed: pratiyogi abhyupagamāt apiśabdena sūcanam iti dhyeyam

original: uktameva vistṛṇīte -
analyzed: uktam eva vistṛṇīte

original: stutiparamādyamatra nijasādhyavidheyaruciprajananasiddhaye svavacanīyaguṇādakhat |
analyzed: stuti parama ādyam atra nija sādhya vidheya ruci prajanana siddhaye sva vacanīya guṇāt akhat

original: taditarathā na sidhyati vidhiṣviva tattvavidāṃ
analyzed: tat itarathā na sidhyati vidhiṣu iva tattva vidām

original: kathamasatā guṇena kathitena nutirbhavati || 32 ||
analyzed: katham asatā guṇena kathitena nutiḥ bhavati

original: stutiparaṃ - guṇābhidhānaparam | atra - vidhiśeṣabhūtārthavādamantrasamudāye | ādyaṃ arthavādātmakaṃ kartṛ | nijasādhyāyāḥ svakāryabhūtāyāḥ; vidheyeṣu - yāgādiṣu ruceḥ icchāviśeṣasya, prajananasya siddhaye rucyutpattisiddhyartham | svavacanīyaguṇeṣu svapratipādyakṣepiṣṭhatvādiguṇeṣu ādaravat - tātparyavadityarthaḥ |
analyzed: stuti param guṇa abhidhāna param atra vidhi śeṣa bhūta arthavāda mantra samudāye ādyam arthavāda ātmakam kartṛ nija sādhyāyāḥ sva kārya bhūtāyāḥ vidheyeṣu yāga ādiṣu ruceḥ icchā viśeṣasya prajananasya siddhaye ruci utpatti siddhi artham sva vacanīya guṇeṣu sva pratipādya kṣepiṣṭha tva ādi guṇeṣu ādaravat tātparyavat iti arthaḥ

original: stutiparamiti codyabījameva parihārabījatayā kathamasatetyādinocyate | prajananeti praśabdena kalpitastutiśaktikanirarthavādavidhisthalavyāvṛttirvivakṣitā | uktārthamarthāpatyā draḍhayati - tadityādinā | tat - vidhyapekṣitaṃ stutiparatvaṃ kartṛ | itarathā - guṇatātparyeṇa vinā | na sidhyati - na saṃbhavati |
analyzed: stuti param iti codya bījam eva parihāra bīja tayā katham asatā ityādinā ucyate prajanana iti pra śabdena kalpita stuti śaktika nirartha vāda vidhi sthala vyāvṛttiḥ vivakṣitā ukta artham arthāpatyā draḍhayati tat ityādinā tat vidhi apekṣitam stuti paratvam kartṛ itarathā guṇa tātparyeṇa vinā na sidhyati na saṃbhavati

original: vidhiṣviva iti pūrvānvayī, yathā vidherguṇatātparyavirahānna stāvakatvaṃ tadvadarthavādasyāpi guṇatātparyavirahānna stāvakatvamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā yathā vidhiṣu svārthatātparyeṇa vinā na pravartakatvasiddhistathārthavādeṣvapi svārthatātparyeṇa vinā na stāvakatvasiddhirityarthaḥ | atha vā vidhiṣviva ityuttarānvayī |
analyzed: vidhiṣu iva iti pūrva anvayī yathā vidheḥ guṇa tātparya virahāt na stāvaka tvam tadvat arthavādasya api guṇa tātparya virahāt na stāvaka tvam iti bhāvaḥ yat vā yathā vidhiṣu svārtha tātparyeṇa vinā na pravartaka tva siddhiḥ tathā arthavādeṣu api svārtha tātparyeṇa vinā na stāvaka tva siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ atha vā vidhiṣu iva iti uttara anvayī

original: tattvavidāṃ - pratipipādayiṣitārthaviparītaviṣayakapramātmakaviśeṣadarśanavatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ | vidhiṣviva kaṣāyaṃ piba śikhā te vardhiṣyate ityādyupacchandanavākyeṣviva tatpratipādyālīkasādhyasādhanabhāveneva | kathitena - arthavādabodhitenāpi | asatā - niścitālīkabhāvena |
analyzed: tattva vidām puruṣāṇām vidhiṣu iva kaṣāyam piba śikhā te vardhiṣyate ityādi upacchandana vākyeṣu iva tad pratipādya alīka sādhya sādhana bhāvena iva kathitena arthavāda bodhitena api asatā niścita alīka bhāvena

original: guṇena, nutiḥ - stutiḥ (ruciḥ pūrvapravṛttiḥ) kathaṃ bhavati - na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: guṇena nutiḥ stutiḥ ruciḥ pūrva pravṛttiḥ katham bhavati na bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: (tadidaṃ bhāṣitaṃ bhagavatā - na cāsatā guṇena kathitena prarocanā jāyate iti |) satāmeva guṇānāṃ kīrtanaṃ stutirnāsatām | tasminneva stutiśabdasya prayogaprācuryāt | nānṛtaṃ vadet iti niṣedhasya stutivyatiriktaviṣayakatvakalpane gauravācca |
analyzed: tat idam bhāṣitam bhagavatā na ca asatā guṇena kathitena prarocanā jāyate iti satām eva guṇānām kīrtanam stutiḥ na asatām tasmin eva stuti śabdasya prayoga prācuryāt na anṛtam vadet iti niṣedhasya stuti vyatirikta viṣayaka tva kalpane gauravāt ca

original: (kiṃ caivaṃ tulyanyāyatayā nindāpavādāderasaddoṣakathanatvāpattāvapavādi harerdoṣamityādyasvārasyaṃ spaṣṭam) | bhūtārthe katamā
analyzed: kim ca evam tulya nyāyatayā nindā apavāda ādeḥ asat doṣa kathana tva āpattau apavādi hareḥ doṣam iti ādi asvārasyam spaṣṭam bhūtārthe katamā

original: stutiḥ ityetatūpakramagatavākyaśeṣānusārādyāvadartho vaktuṃ na śakyata ityetadarthakamiti bhagavadguṇadarpaṇe spaṣṭam | ata eva kavibhirapi, (arthavāda eṣa doṣaḥ tu kiṃcitkathayeti mithyābhiśastirūpavastusaddoṣakathanapratiyogitayā’rthavādo nirdiṣṭaḥ) |
analyzed: stutiḥ iti etat tu upakrama gata vākyaśeṣa anusārāt yāvat arthaḥ vaktum na śakyate iti etad arthakam iti bhagavat guṇa darpaṇe spaṣṭam atas eva kavibhiḥ api arthavādaḥ eṣa doṣaḥ tu kiṃcid kathaya iti mithyā abhiśasti rūpa vastu sat doṣa kathana pratiyogitayā arthavādaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ

original: anyathā hi vāstavaṃ tu kiṃcitkathayeti syāt | guṇābhidhānamātraṃ stotramityāśrayaṇe’pi nārthavādānāṃ svārthatātparye kiṃcidbādhakam, asatastu na prarocakatvamityabhyupagamāt | vedāntācāryāstu - stotravyākhyāne stoṣyāmīti - paramārthaguṇavarṇanena seviṣya ityarthaḥ tathā ca dramiḍabhāṣyam nāsatā stutirupapadyate iti āhuśca varadācāryāḥ -
analyzed: anyathā hi vāstavam tu kiṃcid kathaya iti syāt guṇa abhidhāna mātram stotram iti āśrayaṇe api na arthavādānām svārtha tātparye kiṃcid bādhakam asataḥ tu na prarocaka tvam iti abhyupagamāt vedānta ācāryāḥ tu stotra vyākhyāne stoṣyāmi iti paramārtha guṇa varṇanena seviṣye iti arthaḥ tathā ca dramiḍa bhāṣyam na asatā stutiḥ upapadyate iti āhuḥ ca varada ācāryāḥ

original: kathamasatā guṇena kathitena nutirbhavati iti prāhuḥ||
analyzed: katham asatā guṇena kathitena nutiḥ bhavati iti prāhuḥ

original: teṣāmayamartho’sya ślokasyābhipretaḥ | atra arthavādamantrātmakabhāgadvaye, prathamaṃ arthavādarūpaṃ nijasādhyavidheyaruciprajananasiddhaye stutiparaṃ sat, rucisiddhyarthastutiparatākaṃ sat, - svapratipādyaguṇeṣu satyatvatātparyarūpādarayuktaṃ, bhavati | tat - stutiparatvam | itarathā - guṇasatyatvatātparyavirahe | na sidhyati |
analyzed: teṣām ayam arthaḥ ślokasya abhipretaḥ atra arthavāda mantra ātmaka bhāga dvaye prathamam arthavāda rūpam nija sādhya vidheya ruci prajanana siddhaye stuti param sat ruci siddhi artha stuti para tākam sat sva pratipādya guṇeṣu satya tva tātparya rūpa ādara yuktam bhavati tat stuti para tvam itarathā guṇa satya tva tātparya virahe na sidhyati

original: stutitvasya paramārthaguṇavarṇanatvavyāpyatvādvyāpakābhāve vyāpyābhāvādityarthaḥ | tattvavidāṃ - yathārthadarśinām |
analyzed: stuti tvasya paramārtha guṇa varṇana tva vyāpya tvāt vyāpaka abhāve vyāpya abhāvāt iti arthaḥ tattva vidām yathārtha darśinām

original: vidhiṣviva - upacchandanavākyeṣviva | kathitenāsatā guṇena, nutiḥ, kathaṃ bhavati - na kathamapītyarthaḥ | paramārthaguṇavarṇanaṃ hi stutiḥ | tatra guṇānāṃ ghaṭakatayā hetutvavivakṣayā tṛtīyā | na cāsatā guṇena kathitena prarocanā jāyate iti bhāṣye, prarocanāśabdaḥ stutiparaḥ |
analyzed: vidhiṣu iva upacchandana vākyeṣu iva kathitena asatā guṇena nutiḥ katham bhavati na katham api iti arthaḥ paramārtha guṇa varṇanam hi stutiḥ tatra guṇānām ghaṭaka tayā hetutva vivakṣayā tṛtīyā na ca asatā guṇena kathitena prarocanā jāyate iti bhāṣye prarocanā śabdaḥ stuti paraḥ

original: stutyaṃ stutibhirarthyābhiḥ ityatra tu guṇavarṇanamātre stutiśabdo gauṇaḥ | āśāsanāṃśeṣvarthopadhāyakatvaṃ vā arthyābhirityatrābhipretam vācamartho’nuvartate iti nyāyāditi || 32 ||
analyzed: stutyam stutibhiḥ arthyābhiḥ iti atra tu guṇa varṇana mātre stuti śabdaḥ gauṇaḥ āśāsana aṃśeṣu artha upadhāyaka tvam vā arthyābhiḥ iti atra abhipretam vācam arthaḥ nuvartate iti nyāyāt iti

original: (vidhyarthavādamantrāṇāmiti kramānusāriṇī) arthavādavacasāṃ mantragirāmiti krame prathamanirdiṣṭasyārthavādasya svārthe (svapakṣe) prāmāṇyamupapādyānantaranirdiṣṭamantrāṇāṃ tadupapādayati
analyzed: vidhi arthavāda mantrāṇām iti krama anusāriṇī arthavāda vacasām mantra girām iti krame prathama nirdiṣṭasya arthavādasya sva arthe sva pakṣe prāmāṇyam upapādya anantara nirdiṣṭa mantrāṇām tat upapādayati

original: atha manavo vidheyaparibodhanakāryamukhādvidhimupakurvate hi diviṣadvapurādidhiyam |
analyzed: atha manavaḥ vidheya paribodhana kārya mukhāt vidhim upakurvate hi diviṣad vapuḥ ādi dhiyam

original: upajanayanta enamupakartumalaṃ khalu te
analyzed: upajanayantaḥ enam upakartum alam khalu te

original: kathamiva devatādhiyamupaiti vapurvidhurā || 33 ||
analyzed: katham iva devatā dhiyam upaiti vapuḥ vidhurā

original: atha - anantaranirdiṣṭāḥ; yadvā arthavādaiḥ prarocanāyāṃ

analyzed: yat madhurāyām gṛhītam anyasmin ca anyasmin ca rūpa sāmānyāt tat eva idam iti bhavati iti uktam kaiyaṭena ca vyakti nirdeśe pi bheda aparāmarśena loka vat abheda vyavahāraḥ usti iti siddham iṣṭam vyakti vyatiriktam tu sāmānyam bhavatu vā mā vā bhūt sarvathā lokaḥ iva śāstre vyavahāraḥ iti uktam

original: kaustubhe’pi ihoccāritokārādiḥ susadṛśīḥ ṣaḍvyaktīḥ sādṛśyākhyasaṃbandhena upasthāpayati ityuktam | ataḥ sādṛśyasya vyaktyantarasaṃgrāhakatvaṃ sāmānyakāryadhurīṇatvaṃ ca sarvasaṃmatam | tadidamabhipretya taddhi tādṛkṣamaikṣī tyuktam ||
analyzed: kaustubhe api iha uccārita ukāra ādiḥ su sadṛśīḥ ṣaḍ vyaktīḥ sādṛśya ākhya saṃbandhena upasthāpayati iti uktam atas sādṛśyasya vyakti antara saṃgrāhaka tvam sāmānya kārya dhurīṇa tvam ca sarva saṃmatam tat idam abhipretya tat hi tādṛkṣam aikṣī iti uktam

original: anuvṛttavyavahārādau vyāvṛttasaṃsthānasya kathaṃ prayojakatvamityāśaṅkya, jātiṣu jātyantaravirahe’pi jātivyavahārasya yathātiriktajātivāde sausādṛśyenopapattiḥ; tadvat saṃsthānajātivāde’pi saṃsthānasausādṛśyenopapattiriti parihārābhiprāyeṇāha -
analyzed: anuvṛtta vyavahāra ādau vyāvṛtta saṃsthānasya katham prayojaka tvam iti āśaṅkya jātiṣu jāti antara virahe pi jāti vyavahārasya yathā atirikta jāti vāde sausādṛśyena upapattiḥ tadvat saṃsthāna jāti vāde api saṃsthāna sausādṛśyena upapattiḥ iti parihāra abhiprāyeṇa āha

original: gotvā’jatvā’śvatādiṣviti | anekāsu gotvādijātiṣu |

original: atiriktajātipakṣe | ūce kiṃ - svīkṛtam kim ? | kṣepavācī kiṃśabdaḥ; | na svīkṛtaṃ hītyarthaḥ | tathā ca tadvadeva gavādiśabdānāmapi vyutpattiḥ sausādṛśyenaiva upapadyata iti bhāvaḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: atirikta jāti pakṣe ūce kim svīkṛtam kim kṣepa vācī kiṃśabdaḥ na svīkṛtam hi iti arthaḥ tathā ca tadvat eva go ādi śabdānām api vyutpattiḥ sausādṛśyena eva upapadyate iti bhāvaḥ 38

original: anyasyādarśanena vyavahṛtighaṭanasyānyathaivopapattyā

original: gvyutpattyarhaiva yādṛkparasamayamatāmākṛtiṃ sā vyanakti || 39 ||

original: vyā - anyasya - saṃsthānātiriktasya jātyākhyasya | adarśanena, anena darśanaṃ netyuktam | kalpanaṃ vyudasyati - vyavahṛtīti | vyavahṛtighaṭanasya - vyavahārānugamasya | anyathaivopapattyā - ubhayābhyupetasaṃsthānasausādṛśyenaivopapattyā | yaḥ kalpyatvāsaṃbhavaḥ tenāpītyarthaḥ | darśanābhāvādanumeyatvāsaṃbhavāccetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: anyasya saṃsthāna atiriktasya jāti ākhyasya adarśanena anena darśanam na iti uktam kalpanam vyudasyati vyavahṛti iti vyavahṛti ghaṭanasya vyavahāra anugamasya anyathā eva upapattyā ubhaya abhyupeta saṃsthāna sausādṛśyena eva upapattyā yaḥ kalpya tva asaṃbhavaḥ tena api iti arthaḥ darśana abhāvāt anumeya tva asaṃbhavāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: jātyādiśabdaḥ - gavādiśabdaḥ | ādinā śuklādiśabdaparigrahaḥ jātyajātisādhāraṇaṃ hi saṃsthānaṃ niruktam | ubhayasamayasaṃgītasaṃsthāvalambī yuktaḥ - saṃsthānajātivādātiriktajātivādātmakapakṣadvayābhyupagatasusadṛśasaṃsthānakṛtānugamakaḥ sannupapanna ityarthaḥ | jātyādīnāṃ śabda iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ | ato gavādiśabdalābhaḥ |

original: ihetyādi - iha - saṃsthānajātivāde | mithaḥ - anyonyam | susadṛk - sausādṛśyavatī | saṃsthā, saṃsthānam | anusyūtadhīvāgvyutpattyarhaiva - anugatapratītivyavahāraśaktigrahajananādiyogyaiva | bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | hīti prasiddhau | yādṛksā - yatsausādṛśyaviśiṣṭaṃsaṃsthānam; kartṛ | parasamayamatāṃ - paramatasvīkṛtām | ākṛtiṃ - saṃsthānātiriktajātim |
analyzed: iha ityādi iha saṃsthāna jāti vāde mithas anyonyam su sadṛś sausādṛśyavatī saṃsthā saṃsthānam anusyūta dhī vāc vyutpatti arhā eva anugata pratīti vyavahāra śakti graha janana ādi yogyā eva bhavati iti śeṣaḥ hi iti prasiddhau yādṛś sā yat sausādṛśya viśiṣṭam saṃsthānam kartṛ para samaya matām para mata svīkṛtām ākṛtim saṃsthāna atirikta jātim

original: vyanakti - vyañjayati | tādṛksaṃsthānam anusyūtadhīvāgvyutpattyarhamiti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | sausādṛśyaviśiṣṭasaṃsthānasya paramate jātivyañjakatvavat asmatpakṣe’nugatabuddhyādihetutvaṃ saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vyanakti vyañjayati tādṛś saṃsthānam anusyūta dhī vāc vyutpatti arham iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ sausādṛśya viśiṣṭa saṃsthānasya para mate jāti vyañjaka tva vat asmat pakṣa inugata buddhi ādi hetutvam saṃbhavati iti arthaḥ

original: susadṛśāvayavasaṃyogaviśeṣarūpasaṃsthānasya jātyabhivyañjakatvaṃ hi parairapyāstheyam | taduktaṃ meghanādārisūribhiḥ - abhivyaṅgyatvapakṣe’pyayaṃ parihāraḥ samaḥ | gavayādau na kathaṃ gotvāderabhivyaktiriti codite; tatrābhivyañjakāvayavābhāvādityuttare datte; kathaṃ tatra tadabhivyañjakāvayavābhāva iti punaścodite;
analyzed: su sadṛśa avayava saṃyoga viśeṣa rūpa saṃsthānasya jāti abhivyañjaka tvam hi paraiḥ api āstheyam tat uktam meghanāda ari sūribhiḥ abhivyaṅgya tva pakṣe pi ayam parihāraḥ samaḥ gavaya ādau na katham go tva ādeḥ abhivyaktiḥ iti codite tatra abhivyañjaka avayava abhāvāt iti uttare datte katham tatra tad abhivyañjaka avayava abhāvaḥ iti punar codite

original: susadṛśāvayavābhāvādityevottaraṃ syāditi
analyzed: su sadṛśa avayava abhāvāt iti eva uttaram syāt iti

original: ākṛtigrahaṇā jātiḥ anugatasaṃsthānavyaṅgyetyarthaḥ iti ca tāntrikairuktam | atassausādṛśyaviśiṣṭasaṃsthānasya jātyabhivyañjakatvavadanugatapratītyādinirvāhakatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | sādṛśyasya klṛptapadārtheṣu antarbhavo bahirbhāvo vā’stu | sarvathāpi klṛptasādṛśyenopapattau atiriktajātikalpanaṃ gauravaparāhatamiti hṛdayam |
analyzed: ākṛti grahaṇā jātiḥ anugata saṃsthāna vyaṅgyā iti arthaḥ iti ca tāntrikaiḥ uktam atas sausādṛśya viśiṣṭa saṃsthānasya jāti abhivyañjaka tva vat anugata pratīti ādi nirvāhaka tvam saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ sādṛśyasya klṛpta padārtheṣu antarbhavaḥ bahirbhāvaḥ vā astu sarvathā api klṛpta sādṛśyena upapattau atirikta jāti kalpanam gaurava parāhatam iti hṛdayam

original: siddhānte tu sādṛśyaṃ nātiriktam | adravyaṃ, sattvarajastamaśśabdasparśarūparasagaṃdhasaṃyogaśaktibhedāt daśaive tyuktatvāt | meghanādārisūribhistu - śaktisaṅkhyāsādṛśyāni guṇe’ntarbhūtāni ityuktam | tathā śaktisādṛśyaparimāṇapṛthaktvasaṃyogavibhāgaparatvāparatvāśrayāśrayibhāvādayaḥ, cidacitsādhāraṇā guṇā tairevoktam |
analyzed: siddhānte tu sādṛśyam na atiriktam adravyam sattva rajaḥ tamaḥ śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gaṃdha saṃyoga śakti bhedāt daśa eva iti ukta tvāt meghanādāri sūribhiḥ tu śakti saṅkhyā sādṛśyāni guṇe antarbhūtāni iti uktam tathā śakti sādṛśya parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga para tva apara tva āśraya āśrayi bhāva ādayaḥ cit acit sādhāraṇāḥ guṇāḥ taiḥ eva uktam

original: tadgatabhūyodharmavattvaṃ sādṛśyamiti pakṣe’pi, sādṛśyabhūtā ye bhūyāṃso dharmāḥ tadatiriktaṃ tadatiriktavastvabhivyaṅgyaṃ jātyākhyaṃ vastvaṅgīkriyata iti gauravam | asmākaṃ tu taireva dharmairanugatavyavahārasidhyāśrayaṇāt lāghavam |
analyzed: tad gata bhūyaḥ dharmavat tvam sādṛśyam iti pakṣe api sādṛśya bhūtāḥ ye bhūyāṃsaḥ dharmāḥ tad atiriktam tad atirikta vastu abhivyaṅgyam jāti ākhyam vastu aṅgīkriyate iti gauravam asmākam tu taiḥ eva dharmaiḥ anugata vyavahāra sidhi āśrayaṇāt lāghavam

original: tadgatadharmeṣu sādṛśyaṃ, sadṛśāvayaveṣu vyañjakatvaṃ, vyaktiṣu jātiriti trayāṇāṃ vṛttivikalpādeḥ pratītiśaraṇatayā parihāraḥ paramate |
analyzed: tad gata dharmeṣu sādṛśyam sadṛśa avayaveṣu vyañjaka tvam vyaktiṣu jātiḥ iti trayāṇām vṛtti vikalpa ādeḥ pratīti śaraṇa tayā parihāraḥ para mate

original: asmanmate tu tadgateṣu dharmeṣu sādṛśyaṃ, sādṛśyavadavayaveṣu anugatavyavahāraprayojakatvaṃ ceti dvayoreva vṛttivikalpādeḥ pratītiśaraṇatayā parihāra iti lāghavam sādṛśyaṃ guṇa iti pakṣe’pi, sādṛśyasyāvayaveṣu, sadṛśāvayaveṣu anugatapratītiprayojakatvasya ceti dvayoreva pratītibalena tatparihāra iti lāghavamastyeva |
analyzed: asmad mate tu tad gateṣu dharmeṣu sādṛśyam sādṛśya vat avayaveṣu anugata vyavahāra prayojaka tvam ca iti dvayoḥ eva vṛtti vikalpa ādeḥ pratīti śaraṇa tayā parihāraḥ iti lāghavam sādṛśyam guṇaḥ iti pakṣe pi sādṛśyasya avayaveṣu sadṛśa avayaveṣu anugata pratīti prayojaka tvasya ca iti dvayoḥ eva pratīti balena tad parihāraḥ iti lāghavam asti eva

original: yadyapi sādṛśyaṃ prativyakti vyāvṛttam; tathāpi vyāvṛttasyāpi tasyānuvṛttadhīhetutvaṃ svabhāvādevopapadyate; yathā paramate vyāvṛttānāmanuvṛttajātivyañjakatvaṃ tadvat | taduktaṃ jātipratītyabhāvānnābhivyañjakatvamiti keṣāṃcitsaṃsthānānāmeva gotvādyabhivyañjakatvaṃ svabhāva iti vā |
analyzed: yadi api sādṛśyam prativyakti vyāvṛttam tathā api vyāvṛttasya api tasya anuvṛtta dhī hetutvam svabhāvāt eva upapadyate yathā para mate vyāvṛttānām anuvṛtta jāti vyañjaka tvam tadvat tat uktam jāti pratīti abhāvāt na abhivyañjaka tvam iti keṣāṃcid saṃsthānānām eva go tva ādi abhivyañjaka tvam svabhāvaḥ iti vā

original: evamatrāpi gavayādau tatsaṃsthānādgotvādyapratītissvabhāvādeveti || 39 ||

original: prathamasūtrabhāṣye ato vastusaṃsthānarūpajātyādilakṣaṇabhedaviśiṣṭaviṣayameva pratyakṣam iti vākye
analyzed: prathama sūtra bhāṣye atas vastu saṃsthāna rūpa jāti ādi lakṣaṇa bheda viśiṣṭa viṣayam eva pratyakṣam iti vākye

original: arthadvayamuktam; vastusaṃsthānarūpā jātiḥ; jātireva bheda iti ca | tatra saṃsthānameva jātirityayamarthaḥ saṃsthānātirekiṇaḥ ityādibhāṣyeṇopapāditaḥ | jātireva, bheda ityayamarthaśca jātigrahaṇenaiva bhinna iti vyavahārasaṃbhavāt ityādibhāṣyeṇopapāditaḥ |
analyzed: artha dvayam uktam vastu saṃsthāna rūpā jātiḥ jātiḥ eva bhedaḥ iti ca tatra saṃsthānam eva jātiḥ iti ayam arthaḥ saṃsthāna atirekiṇaḥ ityādi bhāṣyeṇa upapāditaḥ jātiḥ eva bhedaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ ca jāti grahaṇena eva bhinnaḥ iti vyavahāra saṃbhavāt ityādi bhāṣyeṇa upapāditaḥ

original: tatra gotvādivyatiriktabhedamaṅgīkurvatā pareṇāpi abhāvābhāve, pratiyoginirapekṣabhāvarūpapadārthasyaiva pratiyogisāpekṣābhāvatvamaṅgīkṛtam | anyathānavasthānādanupalambhācca | tadvadbhedasyāpi pratiyoginirapekṣabhāvarūpagotvādirūpatvaṃ saṃbhavatītyuktam | tatra tulyanyāyatayā saṃsargābhāvasyāpi bhāvarūpatvamabhipretam |
analyzed: tatra go tva ādi vyatirikta bhedam aṅgīkurvatā pareṇa api abhāva abhāve pratiyogi nirapekṣa bhāva rūpa padārthasya eva pratiyogi sāpekṣa abhāva tvam aṅgīkṛtam anyathā anavasthānāt anupalambhāt ca tadvat bhedasya api pratiyogi nirapekṣa bhāva rūpa go tva ādi rūpa tvam saṃbhavati iti uktam tatra tulya nyāyatayā saṃsarga abhāvasya api bhāva rūpa tvam abhipretam

original: tadidaṃ saṃsthānajātinirūpaṇaprasaṃgādāha dvābhyām -

original: abhāvasyābhāvo bhavati khalu bhāvaḥ paramate

original: ghaṭāderapyevaṃ kathaya kimabhāvo na bhavati |
