original: abhāvasyetyādi | paramate - neyāyikādimate | abhāvasyābhāvaḥ - ghaṭābhāvābhāvaḥ bhāvo bhavati khalu - bhāvarūpaghaṭātmakaḥ abhyupagataḥ kila | anyathānavasthānādanupalambhācceti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ - ghaṭābhāvābhāvasya ghaṭātmakatvavat | ghaṭāderabhāvo’pi bhāvaḥ - bhūtalarūpādiviśeṣarūpaḥ | kiṃ na bhavati - kuto na bhavati, bhavatyevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: abhāvasya ityādi para mate neyāyika ādi mate abhāvasya abhāvaḥ ghaṭa abhāva abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ bhavati khalu bhāva rūpa ghaṭa ātmakaḥ abhyupagataḥ kila anyathā anavasthānāt anupalambhāt ca iti bhāvaḥ evam ghaṭa abhāva abhāvasya ghaṭa ātmaka tva vat ghaṭa ādeḥ abhāvaḥ api bhāvaḥ bhū tala rūpa ādi viśeṣa rūpaḥ kim na bhavati kutas na bhavati bhavati eva iti arthaḥ

original: pratiyogisāpekṣasyābhāvasya pratiyoginirapekṣabhāvarūpatvamanupapannamityanupapattirhi tenātiriktābhāve hetukartavyā | sā ghaṭābhāvābhāvasya ghaṭātmakatvaṃ vadatā tenaiva nirākṛteti kalpakābhāvānnātiriktābhāvaklṛptiriti bhāvaḥ | ghaṭasyetyādi | satkāryavādābhyupagamāt, ghaṭadhvaṃsaḥ kapālatvāvasthārūpaḥ | aparastvabhāvaḥ - ghaṭaprāgabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogi sāpekṣasya abhāvasya pratiyogi nirapekṣa bhāva rūpatvam anupapannam iti anupapattiḥ hi tena atirikta abhāve hetu kartavyā sā ghaṭa abhāva abhāvasya ghaṭa ātmaka tvam vadatā tena eva nirākṛtā iti kalpaka abhāvān na atirikta abhāva klṛptiḥ iti bhāvaḥ ghaṭasya ityādi satkārya vāda abhyupagamāt ghaṭa dhvaṃsaḥ kapāla tva avasthā rūpaḥ aparaḥ tu abhāvaḥ ghaṭa prāgabhāvaḥ

original: piṇḍatvāvasthārūpaḥ | hiśabdaḥ prasiddhau | ghaṭaprāgabhāvadhvaṃsasya ghaṭasattākāle ghaṭarūpatvaṃ tenāṅgīkṛtam | tathā ghaṭadhvaṃsaprāgabhāvasya ghaṭasattākāle ghaṭarūpatvaṃ ca tenāṅgīkṛtam | tasmāt dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvayorapi bhāvarūpatvamupapannamiti bhāvaḥ | tarhi darśanabalāttatsiddhirityatrāha - kimiha dadṛśe kiṃcidaparam |
analyzed: piṇḍatva avasthā rūpaḥ hi śabdaḥ prasiddhau ghaṭa prāgabhāva dhvaṃsasya ghaṭa sattā kāle ghaṭa rūpa tvam tena aṅgīkṛtam tathā ghaṭa dhvaṃsa prāgabhāvasya ghaṭa sattā kāle ghaṭa rūpa tvam ca tena aṅgīkṛtam tasmāt dhvaṃsa prāgabhāvayoḥ api bhāva rūpa tvam upapannam iti bhāvaḥ tarhi darśana balāt tad siddhiḥ iti atra āha kim iha dadṛśe kiṃcid aparam

original: iha - bhūtalakapālapiṇḍeṣu | aparaṃ kiṃcit - bhūtalarūpādiviśeṣādyatiriktaṃ saṃsargābhāvarūpaṃ vastu | dadṛśe kiṃ - kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, na dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ | tathā copalambhā nupapattyorabhāvānnātiriktābhāvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: iha bhū tala kapāla piṇḍeṣu aparam kiṃcid bhū tala rūpa ādi viśeṣa ādi atiriktam saṃsarga abhāva rūpam vastu dadṛśe kim kim dṛṣṭam na dṛṣṭam iti arthaḥ tathā ca upalambha anupapattyoḥ abhāvāt na atirikta abhāva siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ghaṭābhāvasya bhūtalarūpādyātmakatve ghaṭasannidhikāle bhūtalarūpasya nāśāpasaraṇayorabhāvenābhāvapratyayaḥ syādityāśaṅkyātiriktābhāvavāde’pi tadā nityasya niṣkriyasya tasya nāśāpasaraṇayorabhāvādabhāvapratītissyāt, yadi ghaṭasattākālāvacchinnabhūtalasyābhāvīyaviśeṣaṇatāsaṃsargavirahānna tadgraha ityupeyate;
analyzed: nanu ghaṭa abhāvasya bhū tala rūpa ādi ātmaka tve ghaṭa sannidhi kāle bhū tala rūpasya nāśa apasaraṇayoḥ abhāvena abhāva pratyayaḥ syāt iti āśaṅkya atirikta abhāva vāde pi tadā nityasya niṣkriyasya tasya nāśa apasaraṇayoḥ abhāvāt abhāva pratītiḥ syāt yadi ghaṭa sattā kāla avacchinna bhū talasya abhāvīya viśeṣaṇatā saṃsarga virahāt na tad grahaḥ iti upeyate

original: tarhi tatkālāvacchinnabhūtalarūpādeḥ ghaṭābhāvānātmakatvopagamānnānupapattirityāha -
analyzed: tarhi tad kāla avacchinna bhū tala rūpa ādeḥ ghaṭa abhāva anātmaka tva upagamāt na anupapattiḥ iti āha

original: saṃsargābhāvamevaṃ viduriha sudhiyo bhāvameva tvabhāvaṃ
analyzed: saṃsarga abhāvam evam viduḥ iha sudhiyaḥ bhāvam eva tu abhāvam

original: manvānāḥ kumbhavadbhūtalata itarabhūbhāgabhedastvabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: manvānāḥ kumbha vat bhū talataḥ itara bhū bhāga bhedaḥ tu abhāvaḥ

original: yastattatkālabhedavyatikaritagṛhaprāṅgaṇādipradeśaḥ
analyzed: yaḥ tat tat kāla bheda vyatikarita gṛha prāṅgaṇa ādi pradeśaḥ

original: kumbhābhāvāśrayo’nyairagaṇi sa iha naḥ kvādhikasyopalambhaḥ || 41 ||
analyzed: kumbha abhāva āśrayaḥ saḥ iha naḥ kva adhikasya upalambhaḥ

original: bhāvameva tvabhāvaṃ manvānāḥ sudhiyaḥ - ubhayābhyupagatabhūtalarūpādirūpameva ghaṭābhāvaṃ prāmāṇikatvena niścinvānāḥ, paramapuruṣakaṭākṣādhīnasamīcīnaprajñāyuktā asmadācāryāḥ | iha - abhāvasya bhūtalarūpādirūpatve ghaṭasattādaśāyāmapi ghaṭābhāvaḥ pratīyeteti śaṅkāyām | saṃsargābhāvaṃ, evaṃ viduḥ - vakṣyamāṇaprakāraviśiṣṭaṃ svīkurvanti |
analyzed: bhāvam eva tu abhāvam manvānāḥ sudhiyaḥ ubhaya abhyupagata bhū tala rūpa ādi rūpam eva ghaṭa abhāvam prāmāṇika tvena niścinvānāḥ parama puruṣa kaṭākṣa adhīna samīcīna prajñā yuktāḥ asmad ācāryāḥ iha abhāvasya bhū tala rūpa ādi rūpa tve ghaṭa sattā daśāyām api ghaṭa abhāvaḥ pratīyeta iti śaṅkāyām saṃsarga abhāvam evam viduḥ vakṣyamāṇa prakāra viśiṣṭam svīkurvanti

original: tuśabdaḥ klṛptatvadṛṣṭatvarūpavaiṣamyadyotakaḥ | evakāreṇa abhāveṣu kasyacidbhāvarūpatvam anyasya tvabhāvarūpatvamiti parābhyupagatamardhajaratīyaṃ vyāvartyate | vakṣyamāṇaprakāraḥ ka ityatrāha - kumbhavadbhūtaleti | (dhaṭādhikaraṇabhūtalādikabhūbhāgabheda itarabhūtalagataviśeṣaḥ) | tuśabdaḥ evakārārthaḥ | abhāvaḥ - kumbhābhāva ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tuśabdaḥ klṛpta tva dṛṣṭa tva rūpa vaiṣamya dyotakaḥ evakāreṇa abhāveṣu kasyacid bhāva rūpatvam anyasya tu abhāva rūpatvam iti para abhyupagatam ardhajaratīyam vyāvartyate vakṣyamāṇa prakāraḥ kaḥ iti atra āha kumbha vat bhū tala iti dhaṭa adhikaraṇa bhū tala ādika bhū bhāga bhedaḥ itara bhū tala gata viśeṣaḥ tuśabdaḥ evakāra arthaḥ abhāvaḥ kumbha abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ghaṭādhikaraṇabhūtalabhinnabhūtalarūpādirūpo ghaṭābhāva ityarthaḥ | atra paramataṃ dṛṣṭāntayati - ya ityādi | anyaiḥ - atiriktābhāvavādibhiḥ | yaḥ, tattatkālabhedena - ghaṭānadhikaraṇakālaviśeṣeṇa, vyatikaritaḥ avacchinnaḥ, gṛhaprāṅgaṇādipradeśaḥ aṅgaṇaṃ - catvaram |
analyzed: ghaṭa adhikaraṇa bhū tala bhinna bhū tala rūpa ādi rūpaḥ ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ atra para matam dṛṣṭāntayati yaḥ ityādi anyaiḥ atirikta abhāva vādibhiḥ yaḥ tat tat kāla bhedena ghaṭa anadhikaraṇa kāla viśeṣeṇa vyatikaritaḥ avacchinnaḥ gṛha prāṅgaṇa ādi pradeśaḥ aṅgaṇam catvaram

original: kumbhābhāvāśrayo’gaṇi - ghaṭābhāvādhikaraṇatvena svīkṛtaḥ | ghaṭānadhikaraṇakālāvacchinnabhūtalasyaiva ghaṭābhāvasaṃsargatvāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ | saḥ - taddeśakālavarttī ghaṭānadhikaraṇakālāvīcchannagṛhāṅgaṇarūpādireva | naḥ - asmākam | iha - abhāvasthāne | atra bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | sa hi sa na iti pāṭhe sa hi - pradeśaḥ | naḥ - asmākaṃ mate |
analyzed: kumbha abhāva āśrayaḥ ghaṭa abhāva adhikaraṇa tvena svīkṛtaḥ ghaṭa anadhikaraṇa kāla avacchinna bhū talasya eva ghaṭa abhāva saṃsarga tva aṅgīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ saḥ tad deśa kāla varttī naḥ asmākam iha abhāva sthāne atra bhavati iti śeṣaḥ sa hi sa naḥ iti pāṭhe sa hi pradeśaḥ naḥ asmākam mate

original: saḥ - kuṃbhābhāva ityarthaḥ | hiśabdo dārḍhye | taddeśavarttī rūpādirevāsmākaṃ ghaṭābhāva ityarthaḥ | adhikasya - atiriktasyābhāvasya | upalambhaḥ kva - na kvāpīti bhāvaḥ | prābhākaramate adhikaraṇasyaivābhāvatvāṅgīkārāt bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti ādhārādheyabhāvapratīterbhrāntitvam |
analyzed: saḥ kuṃbha abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ hi śabdaḥ dārḍhye tad deśa varttī rūpa ādiḥ eva asmākam ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ adhikasya atiriktasya abhāvasya upalambhaḥ kva na kvāpi iti bhāvaḥ prābhākara mate adhikaraṇasya eva abhāva tva aṅgīkārāt bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti ādhāra ādheya bhāva pratīteḥ bhrānti tvam

original: asmākaṃ tu bhūtalādivṛttirūpādyātmakatvasya ghaṭābhāve’bhyupagamāttatpratīteḥ pramātvamiti dhyeyam | itarabhūbhāgaśabda itarabhūvartiparaḥ | sa iti ca tadvartipara iti kapālatvaṃ piṇḍatvamiti pūrvānusārādjñāyate | tatrāpi kapāle ghaṭo dhvastaḥ iha mṛtpiṇḍe ghaṭo bhaviṣyati iti pratītyoḥ pramātvamityabhipretam || 41 ||
analyzed: asmākam tu bhū tala ādi vṛtti rūpa ādi ātmaka tvasya ghaṭa abhāva abhyupagamāt tad pratīteḥ pramā tvam iti dhyeyam itara bhū bhāga śabdaḥ itara bhū varti paraḥ saḥ iti ca tad varti paraḥ iti kapāla tvam piṇḍa tvam iti pūrva anusārāt jñāyate tatra api kapāle ghaṭaḥ dhvastaḥ iha mṛd piṇḍe ghaṭaḥ bhaviṣyati iti pratītyoḥ pramā tvam iti abhipretam 41

original: jātiguṇavācipadayorvyaktiguṇiparyantābhidhānamākṛtyadhikaraṇasiddham | jātyādimātraśaktatvaṃ tu na sūtrārūḍham | kiṃ tvarvācīnavyākhyātṛbhiruktam | atra śarīravāciśabdānāmākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyaviṣayatānirūpaṇaparāṇi - avasthiteriti kāśakṛtsnaḥ aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt carācaravyapāśrayastu ityādīni sūtrāṇi |
analyzed: jāti guṇa vāci padayoḥ vyakti guṇi paryanta abhidhānam ākṛti adhikaraṇa siddham jāti ādi mātra śakta tvam tu na sūtra ārūḍham kim tu arvācīna vyākhyātṛbhiḥ uktam atra śarīra vāci śabdānām ākṛti adhikaraṇa nyāya viṣaya tā nirūpaṇa parāṇi avasthiteḥ iti kāśakṛtsnaḥ aṃśaḥ nānā vyapadeśāt carācara vyapāśrayaḥ tu ityādīni sūtrāṇi

original: atra tattvamasi sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma ityādiṣu cidacitprakāritvaṃ prātipadikabodhyam | ( carācaravyapāśrayaḥ aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt ityādibhirullāpitādākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyā) tatra samānavibhaktyā tvavasthādvayaviśiṣṭavastvaikatvamucyate aruṇādhikaraṇanayāditi siddhāntaḥ | atra pūrvaślokeṣu ākṛtiśabdārtho nirūpitaḥ |
analyzed: atra tat tvam asi sarvam khalu idam brahma ityādiṣu cit acit prakāri tvam prātipadika bodhyam carācara vyapāśrayaḥ aṃśaḥ nānā vyapadeśāt ityādibhiḥ ullāpitāt ākṛti adhikaraṇa nyāyā tatra samāna vibhaktyā tu avasthā dvaya viśiṣṭa vastu aikatvam ucyate aruṇa adhikaraṇa nayāt iti siddhāntaḥ atra pūrva ślokeṣu ākṛti śabda arthaḥ nirūpitaḥ

original: asmin śloke ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyaḥ śarīravāciṣu pravartate, carācaretyādisūtrādityucyate | uparitaneṣu triṣu ślokeṣu aruṇādhikaraṇanayādviśiṣṭavastvaikyaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyārtha iti ucyate | (avasthiterityaṃśo nānetyādisūtrāti ucyata iti śeṣaḥ) ||
analyzed: asmin śloke ākṛti adhikaraṇa nyāyaḥ śarīra vāciṣu pravartate carācara ityādi sūtrāt iti ucyate uparitaneṣu triṣu ślokeṣu aruṇa adhikaraṇa nayāt viśiṣṭa vastu aikyam sāmānādhikaraṇya arthaḥ iti ucyate avasthiteḥ iti aṃśaḥ ucyate iti śeṣaḥ

original: sacca tyacceti sṛṣṭvā viśasi cidacitau tena cokto’si viśvaṃ
analyzed: sat ca tyad ca iti sṛṣṭvā viśasi cit acitau tena ca uktaḥ usi viśvam

original: tvajjatvāttvallayatvāttvamiti ca nikhilaṃ tvaccharīraṃ kileti |
analyzed: tvad ja tvāt tvad laya tvāt tvam iti ca nikhilam tvad śarīram kila iti

original: taistaiśśāstrairabhedavyavahṛtihṛdayaṃ vistṛṇānairnirastā
analyzed: taiḥ taiḥ śāstraiḥ abheda vyavahṛti hṛdayam vistṛṇānaiḥ nirastā

original: bhedābhedāvabhedaṃ bhramamapi bhagavan kāraṇaṃ kalpayantaḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: bheda abheda avabhedam bhramam api bhagavan kāraṇam kalpayantaḥ

original: he bhagavan - nirdoṣakalyāṇaguṇākara, puruṣottameti saṃbuddhiḥ | pūrvaṃ brāhyasaṃsmaraṇena vākyamuktam | atra bhagavatsaṃbodhanena vākyamucyate | avalokya mukhaṃ teṣāmādityamavalokayet iti smṛtyartho’trānuṣṭhito bhavati | acyutabhānunā ityuktamādityatvamatra bhagavacchabdoktadoṣapratibhaṭatvena vyajyate |
analyzed: he bhagavat nirdoṣa kalyāṇa guṇa ākara puruṣottama iti saṃbuddhiḥ pūrvam brāhya saṃsmaraṇena vākyam uktam atra bhagavat saṃbodhanena vākyam ucyate avalokya mukham teṣām ādityam avalokayet iti smṛti arthaḥ utra anuṣṭhitaḥ bhavati acyuta bhānunā iti uktam āditya tvam atra bhagavat śabda ukta doṣa pratibhaṭa tvena vyajyate

original: atra bhakārādyarthabhartṛtvasraṣṭṛtvādikamapi vivakṣitam | cidacitau - cetanān prakṛtivikārāṃśca | sṛṣṭvā - utpādya | viśasi - praviśasi | tatsṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśat anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi ityādiśrutyartho’trābhipretaḥ | tena - svasṛṣṭacetanācetanānupraveśena |
analyzed: atra bhakāra ādi artha bhartṛ tva sraṣṭṛ tva ādikam api vivakṣitam cit acitau cetanān prakṛti vikārān ca sṛṣṭvā utpādya viśasi praviśasi tat sṛṣṭvā tat eva anuprāviśat anena jīvena ātmanā anupraviśya nāma rūpe vyākaravāṇi ityādi śruti arthaḥ ūtra abhipretaḥ tena sva sṛṣṭa cetana acetana anupraveśena

original: sacca tyacceti viśvamukto’si - sacca tyaccābhavat tatteja aikṣata tā āpaḥ tato’si sarvaḥ ityādinā viśvatvena bodhito’si; viśvaśarīrakatvena viśvavācakaśabdairabhihito’sītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sat ca tyad ca iti viśvam uktaḥ usi sat ca tyad ca abhavat tat tejaḥ aikṣata tāḥ āpaḥ tatas usi sarvaḥ ityādinā viśva tvena bodhitaḥ usi viśva śarīraka tvena viśva vācaka śabdaiḥ abhihitaḥ usi iti arthaḥ

original: sacca tyaccābhavaditi tattacchabdavācyamabhavadityarthaṃ ityuktam | pitrādiva nanupraviṣṭena nāmarūpavyākaraṇasaṃbhavādanupraveśena tanorvyākaraṇaṃ tayoḥ svaparyantatvasiddhyartham | tatra nāmnaḥ svaparyantatvaṃ - svamukhyaviśeṣyakabodhajanakatvam | rūpasya tu
analyzed: sat ca tyad ca abhavat iti tat tad śabda vācyam abhavat iti artham iti uktam pitrāt iva nanu praviṣṭena nāma rūpa vyākaraṇa saṃbhavāt anupraveśena tanoḥ vyākaraṇam tayoḥ sva paryanta tva siddhi artham tatra nāmnaḥ sva paryanta tvam sva mukhya viśeṣyaka bodha janaka tvam rūpasya tu

original: svāpṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇatvamityevaṃ sāmarthyasiddho’rthaḥ | kaṇṭhato’pyuktaḥ - tadanupraviśya sacca tyaccābhavat iti | tadidamuktaṃ - tena cokto’si viśvam iti | castvityarthakaḥ | tasya hṛdaye’nvayaḥ | aṃśo nānā ityatra cetanācetanayorbrahmaśarīratayā tadapṛthaksiddhaviśeṇatvaṃ nirṇītam |
analyzed: sva apṛthak siddha viśeṣaṇatvam iti evam sāmarthya siddhaḥ ūrthaḥ kaṇṭhatas api uktaḥ tat anupraviśya sat ca tyad ca bhavat iti tat idam uktam tena ca uktaḥ usi viśvam iti caḥ tu iti arthakaḥ tasya hṛdaya invayaḥ aṃśaḥ nānā iti atra cetana acetanayoḥ brahma śarīra tayā tad apṛthak siddha viśeṇatvam nirṇītam

original: carācaravyapāśrayaḥ ityatra loke cetanācetanaparyavasitatayā gṛhītaśabdānāṃ tatprakārakabrahmaparyantatvaṃ nirṇītam | ato na lakṣaṇā śaktyantaraṃ veti; tadatroktam | sarvaṃ khalu iti śrutyartha ucyate - tvajjatvāt ityādinā |
analyzed: carācara vyapāśrayaḥ iti atra loke cetana acetana paryavasita tayā gṛhīta śabdānām tad prakāraka brahma paryanta tvam nirṇītam atas na lakṣaṇā śakti antaram vā iti tat atra uktam sarvam khalu iti śruti arthaḥ ucyate tvad ja tvāt ityādinā

original: sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma tajjalāniti śāntaḥ ityatrāyamarthaḥ - tajjalānidaṃ sarvaṃ brahma khalvityanvayaḥ | jāyata iti jaṃ, līyata iti lam | anyebhyo’pi dṛśyate ityubhayatrāpi ḍapratyayaḥ | anityatra tu ana prāṇana ityasmādvicpratyayaḥ | jalāniti ca nimnonnatādivatsamāsaḥ |

original: paṭasya śukla ityādiṣu asamānavibhaktinirdeśastadapavāda iti prayojakadvayamiti lāghavam | tathā cāsmanmate pūrvapakṣe siddhānte cāruṇāpadasya dravyaparyantatvam ||
analyzed: paṭasya śuklaḥ ityādiṣu asamāna vibhakti nirdeśaḥ tad apavādaḥ iti prayojaka dvayam iti lāghavam tathā ca asmad mate pūrvapakṣe siddhānte ca aruṇā padasya dravya paryanta tvam

original: tadihāyaṃ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ - aruṇāpadaṃ dravyaparyantameva; ākṛtyadhikaraṇanayāt | athāpi aruṇayetyasya ekahāyanyanvayo na saṃbhavati | sa hi sākṣādvā krayānvayadvārā vā vaktavyaḥ | tatra na sākṣādanvayaḥ | kārakavibhaktitvavirodhāt; kārakāṇāṃ kriyānvayaniyamāt | nāpi krayānvayadvārā;
analyzed: tat iha ayam pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ aruṇā padam dravya paryantam eva ākṛti adhikaraṇa nayāt atha api aruṇayā iti asya eka hāyanī anvayaḥ na saṃbhavati sa hi sākṣāt vā kraya anvaya dvārā vā vaktavyaḥ tatra na sākṣāt anvayaḥ kāraka vibhakti tva virodhāt kārakāṇām kriyā anvaya niyamāt na api kraya anvaya dvārā

original: prāptakrayānuvādenāruṇādravyaikahāyanīdravyayorubhayorvidhāne vākyabhedāpatteḥ | caśabdādyabhāvena yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca ityatreva samudāyavidhānaśaṅkāyā apyayogāt, aruṇayetyatra dravyaviśeṣāpratītyā viśeṣarūpeṇopasthitaikahāyanīdravyasya jhaṭiti krayānvayena guṇāvarodhanyāyena ekahāyanyavaruddhe āruṇyānanvayāt |
analyzed: prāpta kraya anuvādena aruṇā dravya ekahāyanī dravyayoḥ ubhayoḥ vidhāne vākya bheda āpatteḥ caśabda ādi abhāvena yat agnaye ca prajāpataye ca iti atra iva samudāya vidhāna śaṅkāyāḥ api ayogāt aruṇayā iti atra dravya viśeṣa apratītyā viśeṣa rūpeṇa upasthita ekahāyanī dravyasya jhaṭiti kraya anvayena guṇa avarodha nyāyena ekahāyanī avaruddhe āruṇya ananvayāt

original: nāpyekahāyanyā krīṇāti tayā cāruṇayā bhavitavyamiti vākyārthaḥ saṃbhavati | kraye ekahāyanyā ekahāyanyāmāruṇyasya ca vidhāne vākyabhedāpatteḥ | ata āruṇyasya prākaraṇikasarvadravyānvayānnaikahāyanyanvayaniyama iti ||
analyzed: na api ekahāyanyā krīṇāti tayā ca aruṇayā bhavitavyam iti vākya arthaḥ saṃbhavati kraye ekahāyanyā ekahāyanyām āruṇyasya ca vidhāne vākya bheda āpatteḥ atas āruṇyasya prākaraṇika sarva dravya anvayāt na ekahāyanī anvaya niyamaḥ iti

original: siddhāntastu - āruṇyasya ekahāyanyāmevānvayaḥ | samānavibhakteḥ padadvayārthaikyaparatvāt | na ca kārakavibhaktivirodhaḥ | kriyanvayikārakabodhakatvasyākṣateḥ | na ca kriyayaivānvayaniyamaḥ | vibhaktyarthaikatvasya kārakānvayābhāvapraṃsagāt | na caikavacanatvena ekatvabodhakatvānna kārakavibhaktitvena tadbodhakatvamiti vācyam |
analyzed: siddhāntaḥ tu āruṇyasya ekahāyanyām eva anvayaḥ samāna vibhakteḥ pada dvaya artha aikya paratvāt na ca kāraka vibhakti virodhaḥ kriyā anvayi kāraka bodhaka tvasya akṣateḥ na ca kriyayā eva anvaya niyamaḥ vibhakti artha ekatvasya kāraka anvaya abhāva praṃsagāt na ca eka vacana tvena ekatva bodhaka tvāt na kāraka vibhakti tvena tad bodhaka tvam iti vācyam

original: samānavibhaktitvenaikyabodhakatve’pi virodhābhāvat | tadihāruṇyādiviśiṣṭatvaṃ prātipadikāvaseyam | padadvaya pravṛttinimittabhūtadharmadvayāśrayavastvaikyaṃ samānavibhaktivācyam | kriyākārakasaṃbandhastu vākyāvaseya iti na vākyabheda iti ||
analyzed: samāna vibhakti tvena aikya bodhaka tve api virodha abhāvat tat iha aruṇya ādi viśiṣṭa tvam prātipadika avaseyam pada dvaya pravṛtti nimitta bhūta dharma dvaya āśraya vastu aikyam samāna vibhakti vācyam kriyā kāraka saṃbandhaḥ tu vākya avaseyaḥ iti na vākya bhedaḥ iti

original: tamimaṃ siddhāntamāha - upātte’pītyādinā | dravye - ekahāyanīdravye | upātte’pi - nirdiṣṭe’pi | apiśabdena paroktapūrvapakṣe dravyanirdeśavadvākyasthatvameva nāstīti, tatsiddhānte ca yadyapi tadasti, tathāpi tasya guṇamātravācakatāprayojakatvaṃ paṭaḥśukla ityatra tadabhāvāditi ca sūcyate |
analyzed: tam imam siddhāntam āha upātte ipi ityādinā dravye eka hāyanī dravye upātte api nirdiṣṭe api apiśabdena para ukta pūrvapakṣe dravya nirdeśa vat vākya stha tvam eva na asti iti tad siddhānte ca yadi api tat asti tathā api tasya guṇa mātra vācakatā prayojakatvam paṭaḥ śuklaḥ iti atra tad abhāvāt iti ca sūcyate

original: visadṛśavibhaktivyapagamāt - asamānavibhaktinirdeśavirahāt | apṛthaksiddhaguṇavācitvarūpotsargasyāpavādābhāvādityarthaḥ | prakṛtyāsamānavibhaktiprakṛtibhūtāruṇāpadādinā ākṛtinayāt - ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyāt | vaiśiṣṭyam - guṇayuktatvam | pariṇamati khalu - śābdabodhaviṣayībhavati | padayoḥ - aruṇayaikahāyanyeti padayoḥ |
analyzed: visadṛśa vibhakti vyapagamāt asamāna vibhakti nirdeśa virahāt apṛthak siddha guṇa vāci tva rūpa utsargasya apavāda abhāvāt iti arthaḥ prakṛtyā asamāna vibhakti prakṛti bhūta aruṇā pada ādinā ākṛti nayāt ākṛti adhikaraṇa nyāyāt vaiśiṣṭyam guṇa yuktatvam pariṇamati khalu śābda bodha viṣayībhavati padayoḥ aruṇayā ekahāyanyā iti padayoḥ

original: samānā vibhaktiḥ, padayorarthaikyaṃ - tadīyaśaktigrahajanyopasthitiviśeṣyaikyam | kathayatyeva pratipādayatyeva | ayamevādhikaraṇārtha ityevakāreṇa bodhyate | tuśabdaśca ākṛtyadhikaraṇāt prayojanabhedadyotanārthaḥ | trirūpā - kārakavibhaktitva - ekavacanatvasamānavibhaktitvarūpākāratrayayuktā | sā - vibhaktiḥ |
analyzed: samānā vibhaktiḥ padayoḥ artha aikyam tadīya śakti graha janya upasthiti viśeṣya aikyam kathayati eva pratipādayati eva ayam eva adhikaraṇa arthaḥ iti evakāreṇa bodhyate tuśabdaḥ ca ākṛti adhikaraṇāt prayojana bheda dyotana arthaḥ trirūpā kāraka vibhakti tve eka vacana tva samāna vibhakti tva rūpa ākāra traya yuktā sā vibhaktiḥ

original: saṃkhyānvayamiva - ekatvādiprakārakabodhamiva | kārakadhiyaṃ - karaṇādiviṣayakabodham | diśet - dadyāt | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ padadvayārthaikyaṃ diśedityapi draṣṭavyam | trirūpetyukteḥ | yadvā saṅkhyānvaya iva diśediti pāṭhaḥ | saṅkhyānvaya iti - saptamyantam | ekatvādibodhakatāyāmivārthaikyabodhakatāyāmapi kārakabodho nānupapanna ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: saṃkhyā anvayam iva ekatva ādi prakāraka bodham iva kāraka dhiyam karaṇa ādi viṣayaka bodham diśet dadyāt idam upalakṣaṇam pada dvaya artha aikyam diśet iti api draṣṭavyam trirūpa iti ukteḥ yat vā saṅkhyā anvaye iva diśet iti pāṭhaḥ saṅkhyā anvaye iti saptamī antam ekatva ādi bodhakatāyām iva artha aikya bodhakatāyām api kāraka bodhaḥ na anupapannaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: diśediti śaki liṅ | tathā ca ekasyā api śaktatāvacchedakabhedācchaktitrayaṃ saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: diśet iti śaki tathā ca ekasyāḥ api śakta tā avacchedaka bhedāt śakti trayam saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: uciteyamiti pūrvaśloka uktam | tasyāyamāśayaḥ - aruṇāpadasya guṇaviśiṣṭavācitvādeva na guṇe śuklādayaḥ puṃsi ityanuśāsanavirodhaḥ | ata eva guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni ityanuśāsanamapi svarasam | amūrtasya krayānvayānabhyupagamādeva nāyogyatāniścayavirahadaśāpratīkṣaṇamapi |
analyzed: ucitā iyam iti pūrva śloke uktam tasya ayam āśayaḥ aruṇā padasya guṇa viśiṣṭa vāci tvāt eva na guṇe śukla ādayaḥ puṃsi iti anuśāsana virodhaḥ atas eva guṇa vacanānām āśrayataḥ liṅga vacanāni iti anuśāsanam api svarasam amūrtasya kraya anvaya anabhyupagamāt eva na ayogya tā niścaya viraha daśā pratīkṣaṇam api

original: samānavibhaktyaikyabodhakenaikahānīdravyameva krayoddeśena vidhīyata iti na vākyabhedadoṣo’pi | ata eva daśabhiri ti na daśadravyānuvādavirodhaḥ | ata eva ca vijātīyakrayasādhanatvenārthikaikahāyanyanvayāśrayaṇakleśo’pi na | guṇāt krayabhedaścāprāmāṇikaḥ | daśabhiḥ krīṇāti ityasya ca krayāṃśe vidhāyakatvaṃ svarasam |
analyzed: samāna vibhakti aikya bodhakena eka hānī dravyam eva kraya uddeśena vidhīyate iti na vākya bheda doṣaḥ api atas eva daśabhiḥ iti na daśa dravya anuvāda virodhaḥ atas eva ca vijātīya kraya sādhana tvena ārthika ekahāyanī anvaya āśrayaṇa kleśaḥ api na guṇāt krayabhedaḥ ca aprāmāṇikaḥ daśabhiḥ krīṇāti iti asya ca kraya aṃśe vidhāyaka tvam svarasam

original: daśabhiriti ca tattadvākyaprāptadaśatvānuvādaḥ krayadravyasamuccayārthaḥ | samānavibhaktiḥ padadvayārthaikatvabodhinīti na guṇāvarodhanyāyavirodhaḥ | viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya ityādau ananaivāruṇādhikaraṇanyāyena kārakavibhaktyantayormitho’nvayānna vairūpyam |
analyzed: daśabhiḥ iti ca tad tad vākya prāpta daśatva anuvādaḥ kraya dravya samuccaya arthaḥ samāna vibhaktiḥ pada dvaya artha ekatva bodhinī iti na guṇa avarodha nyāya virodhaḥ viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya ityādau ananaivāruṇa adhikaraṇa nyāyena kāraka vibhakti antayoḥ mithas nvayāt na vairūpyam

original: saṅkhyāmuṣṭyādhikaraṇe ca - parimāṇaviśiṣṭavācakapadasamabhivyāhṛtasaṅkhyāviśiṣṭavācakapadārthasaṅkhyāviśiṣṭasya padārthaikadeśe’pi parimāṇa evābhedānvayo na parimite, vyutpattivaicitryāt | anyathā dve prasthe vrīhayaḥ iti vrīhīṇāṃ bhūyastvena bādhāpatteḥ | tathā ca caturo muṣṭīn ityatra parimitadravyaviśeṣaṇasyāpi muṣṭiparimāṇasya
analyzed: saṅkhyā muṣṭi adhikaraṇe ca parimāṇa viśiṣṭa vācaka pada samabhivyāhṛta saṅkhyā viśiṣṭa vācaka padārtha saṅkhyā viśiṣṭasya padārtha eka deśe api parimāṇe eva abheda anvayaḥ na parimite vyutpatti vaicitryāt anyathā dve prasthe vrīhayaḥ iti vrīhīṇām bhūyastvena bādhā āpatteḥ tathā ca caturaḥ muṣṭīn iti atra parimita dravya viśeṣaṇasya api muṣṭi parimāṇasya api parimāṇasya api parimāṇasya api parimāṇasya api parimāṇas

original: catuṣṭvaṃ prati viśeṣyasya bādhāpekṣayā viśeṣaṇasya catuṣṭvasyaiva bādho nyāyya iti pūrvapakṣe; saṅkhyāviśiṣṭasyāpi parimitadravya evānvayaḥ | anyathā ekadeśānvayāpatteḥ | na ca bādho; muṣṭiparimitatvāvacchedenānvayāt | svato’saṅkhyātānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ deśādyupādhinaiva saṅkhyeyatāyāḥ saṃbhavāt |
analyzed: catuṣṭvam prati viśeṣyasya bādha apekṣayā viśeṣaṇasya catuṣṭvasya eva bādhaḥ nyāyyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe saṅkhyā viśiṣṭasya api parimita dravye eva anvayaḥ anyathā eka deśa anvaya āpatteḥ na ca bādhaḥ muṣṭi parimita tva avacchedena anvayāt svatosaṅkhyātānām taṇḍulānām deśa ādi upādhinā eva saṅkhyeya tāyāḥ saṃbhavāt

original: muṣṭiparimitatvasya copādhitvasaṃbhavāt tadavacchedenaiva catuṣṭvasyānvayopapatteḥ | mahāśūraḥ ityādau mahattvasya śūratvadvāreva muṣṭiparimāṇadvārā vānvayaḥ | tathā ca parimeyadravyaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ catuṣṭvasyopapannam |
analyzed: muṣṭi parimita tvasya ca upādhi tva saṃbhavāt tad avacchedena eva catuṣṭvasya anvaya upapatteḥ mahā śūraḥ ityādau mahat tvasya śūra tva dvārā iva muṣṭi parimāṇa dvārā vā anvayaḥ tathā ca parimeya dravya viśeṣaṇa tvam catuṣṭvasya upapannam

original: ataścatuṣṭvasya muṣṭiparimāṇasya ca ubhayoreva dravyaviśeṣaṇatve’pi prathamaśrutacatuṣṭvābādhanenānantaraśrutamuṣṭiparimāṇasyaiva bādha iti saṅkhyāmuṣṭyadhikaraṇavirodho’pi nāsti | ata iyamucitā anyā tvanucitetyuktam ||
analyzed: atas catuṣṭvasya muṣṭi parimāṇasya ca ubhayoḥ eva dravya viśeṣaṇa tve pi prathama śruta catuṣṭva ābādhanena anantara śruta muṣṭi parimāṇasya eva bādhaḥ iti saṅkhyā muṣṭi adhikaraṇa virodhaḥ api nā asti atas iyam ucitā anyā tu anucitā iti uktam

original: kiṃ ca krayasamuccayaṃ vadatām krayaṇeṣu tu vikalpaḥ syādekārthatvāt iti dvādaśādhikaraṇavirodhaḥ | tatra dravyasamuccayasyaiva pratīteḥ | na ca krayaṇāni krayā iti vaktuṃ yuktam | tathā sati krayeṣvityeva nyāsāpatteḥ | karaṇādhikaraṇayośca iti krayaṇaśabdasya karaṇalyuḍantatvasvārasyāt | ata eva iyaṃ gauḥ somakrayaṇī iti mantravarṇānurūpyamiti |
analyzed: kim ca krayasamuccayam vadatām krayaṇeṣu tu vikalpaḥ syāt ekārtha tvāt iti dvādaśa adhikaraṇa virodhaḥ tatra dravya samuccayasya eva pratīteḥ na ca krayaṇāni krayāḥ iti vaktum yuktam tathā sati krayeṣu iti eva nyāsa āpatteḥ karaṇa adhikaraṇayoḥ ca iti krayaṇa śabdasya karaṇa lyuṭ anta tva svārasyāt atas eva iyam gauḥ soma krayaṇī iti mantra varṇa anurūpyam iti

original: ata eva tadadhikaraṇabhāṣye’pi dravyasamuccaya evādhikaraṇasiddhāntatayoktaḥ | na ca nirguṇakrayamātravidhāyakavākyāntarābhāvena tattadvākyānāmeva krayavidhāyakatvāvaśyaṃbhāvena utpattiśiṣṭatattadvākyasthaguṇāvarodhena guṇāntarāniveśāt guṇāt krayabhedāvaśyaṃbhāvena ekārthatvasya krayeṣveva paryavasānamiti vācyam |
analyzed: atas eva tad adhikaraṇa bhāṣye api dravya samuccayaḥ eva adhikaraṇa siddhāntatayā uktaḥ na ca nirguṇa kraya mātra vidhāyaka vākya antara abhāvena tad tad vākyānām eva kraya vidhāyaka tva avaśyaṃbhāvena utpatti śiṣṭa tad tad vākya stha guṇa avarodhena guṇa antara aniveśāt guṇāt kraya bheda avaśyaṃbhāvena ekārtha tvasya krayeṣu eva paryavasānam iti vācyam

original: taṃ vai daśabhiḥ krīṇāti iti vākyasya krayotpādakatvopapatteḥ | na ca vaiśabdena vidhitvabhaṅgaḥ | vidhistu dhāraṇe’pūrvatvāt ityadhikaraṇoktanyāyenārthāprāptivaśādeva vidhitvasiddheḥ | gavā krīṇāti ityādiṣvapi hi liṅādyaśravaṇenārthāprāptivaśādeva vidhitvasya vaktavyatvāt | krayāṇāmapi bhede gauravācca | daśabhirityaṃśastvanuvādaḥ |

original: naivaṃ daśabhirityādivākyaṃ vidhyantaraśeṣatayā śrutamitīdamekaṃ vaiṣamyam | vasantādivākye vidhiśravaṇam | naivaṃ gavādivākye vidhiśravaṇamitīdamaparam | pramāṇāntaraprāptādhānānuvādena brāhmaṇādikartṛkatve nimitte vasantādikālavidhāne kālasyānupādeyatvātprāpte’pi karmaṇyupādeyatvaṃ kāle tu vidheyatvamiti vaiyadhikaraṇyāpattiḥ vasantādivākye |

original: viśeṣaṇāviṣayakabodhajanakatvamātram | evaṃ cātra lakṣaṇāśabdasyāsvarasyaparatvaṃ vaktavyam | lakṣaṇāśabdamukhyārthasyāpi saṃbhave so’pi grāhya eveti, lakṣaṇā caikyavācā mityetadyādavabhāskarasaṃgrāhakam |
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa a viṣayaka bodha janaka tva mātram evam ca atra lakṣaṇā śabdasya asvarasya paratvam vaktavyam lakṣaṇā śabda mukhya arthasya api saṃbhave saḥ api grāhyaḥ eva iti lakṣaṇā ca aikya vācām miti etat yādava bhāskara saṃgrāhakam

original: tatra yādavamate sanmātrabrahmapariṇāmajīveśvaravācipadayorghaṭaśarāvapadayoriva sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannamityanyatarasya upādānasanmātrabrahmalakṣakatvamāśrayaṇīyam | bhāskarapakṣe’pi aupādhikabhedābhedābhyupagamāt jīveśvaravācipadayorghaṭākāśapaṭākāśapadayoriva tadanupapannamiti anyatarasyānupahitalakṣakatvamāvaśyakam |
analyzed: tatra yādava mate sanmātra brahma pariṇāma jīva īśvara vāci padayoḥ ghaṭa śarāva padayoḥ iva sāmānādhikaraṇyam anupapannam iti anyatarasya upādāna sanmātra brahma lakṣaka tvam āśrayaṇīyam bhāskara pakṣe pi aupādhika bheda abheda abhyupagamāt jīva īśvara vāci padayoḥ ghaṭa ākāśa paṭa ākāśa padayoḥ iva tat anupapannam iti anyatarasya anupahita lakṣaka tvam āvaśyakam

original: (śaṃkarapakṣe ca viśeṣaṇāṃśaprahāṇādasvārasyam | ) ato lakṣaṇā caikyavācā mityatra yādavabhāskarayoḥ saṃgrahaḥ |
analyzed: śaṃkara pakṣe ca viśeṣaṇa aṃśa prahāṇāt asvārasyam atas lakṣaṇā ca aikya vācā m iti atra yādava bhāskarayoḥ saṃgrahaḥ

original: (pratyakṣāt nyādinā) boddhānāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ spaṣṭam | padārthānāṃ sthityutpattyoḥ sarvalokapratyakṣasiddhayostairapalāpāt | doṣādīnāṃ mithyātve’pi bhramāṅgīkāraśca pratyakṣaviruddhaḥ | cinmātrasya satyatvam anyasyāsatyatvaṃ ca śaṃkarayogācārayoraviśiṣṭam | sāṅkhyaśaṃkarayośca nirvikārasvaprakāśaikarasacinmātrasya svavyatiriktasākṣitvamaviśiṣṭam |
analyzed: pratyakṣāt nyādinā boddhānām dūṣaṇam spaṣṭam padārthānām sthiti utpattyoḥ sarva loka pratyakṣa siddhayoḥ taiḥ apalāpāt doṣa ādīnām mithyātve api bhrama aṅgīkāraḥ ca pratyakṣa viruddhaḥ cit mātrasya satya tvam anyasya asatya tvam ca śaṃkara yoga ācārayoḥ aviśiṣṭam sāṅkhya śaṃkarayoḥ ca nirvikāra sva prakāśa ekarasa cit mātrasya sva vyatirikta sākṣi tvam aviśiṣṭam

original: ata eva vipratiṣedhāccāsamañjasam iti sūtre bhagavatā bhāṣyakṛtā śaṃkarapakṣe sāṅkhyapakṣadūṣaṇamatidiṣṭam | teṣāmapyuktarītyāvidyāsākṣitvādhyāsādyasaṃbhavādasāmañjasyamevetyataḥ śaṃkarapakṣadūṣaṇena sarvaṃ dūṣitaṃ bhavatīti sa evātra spaṣṭaṃ dūṣyate | taduktam sāṃkhyasaugatacārvākasaṃkarācchāṅkarodayaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva vipratiṣedhāt ca asamañjasam iti sūtre bhagavatā bhāṣyakṛtā śaṃkara pakṣe sāṅkhya pakṣa dūṣaṇam atidiṣṭam teṣām api ukta rītyā avidyā sākṣi tva adhyāsa ādi asaṃbhavāt asāmañjasyam eva iti atas śaṃkara pakṣa dūṣaṇena sarvam dūṣitam bhavati iti saḥ eva atra spaṣṭam dūṣyate tat uktam sāṃkhya saugata cārvāka saṃkarāt śāṅkara udayaḥ

original: dūṣaṇānyapi tānyatra bhūyastadadhikāni ca || iti ||
analyzed: dūṣaṇāni api tāni atra bhūyas tad adhikāni ca iti

original: ādāviti - māyāvāde brahmabhramahetubhūtānirvacanīyānupapannaikaveṣāvidyāṅgīkārapakṣe śaṃkaramata ityarthaḥ | ādau - prathamam | vakṣyamāṇadoṣāpekṣayā prādhānyaṃ sūcitam | bhedasya śrutaya iti vigrahaḥ | tatpratipādakatvaṃ, tadvyāpyadvitvādipratipādakatvaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | tāsāṃ, anṛtaviṣayatā - mithyābhidheyakatā |
analyzed: ādau iti māyāvāde brahma bhrama hetu bhūta anirvacanīya anupapanna eka veṣa avidyā aṅgīkāra pakṣe śaṃkara mate iti arthaḥ ādau prathamam vakṣyamāṇa doṣa apekṣayā prādhānyam sūcitam bhedasya śrutayaḥ iti vigrahaḥ tad pratipādaka tvam tad vyāpya dvitva ādi pratipādaka tvam ca ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ tāsām anṛta viṣaya tā mithyā abhidheyakatā

original: śaradaḥ kṛtārthatā itivat puṃvadbhāvaḥ | idaṃ rajatamityādivākyavat asadarthakatvaṃ pradhānadoṣa iti bhāvaḥ | tattvāvedakatvalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ hīyeteti hṛdayam |
analyzed: śaradaḥ kṛtārtha tā iti vat puṃvat bhāvaḥ idam rajatam ityādi vākya vat asat arthakatvam pradhāna doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tattva āvedaka tva lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam hīyeta iti hṛdayam

original: atra bhedaśrutiśabdena nānāvidhadravyadevatādeśakāletikartavyatāphalādhikāriprāyaścittādyupaskṛtoccāvacayāgadānahomādyātmakakarmavidhiparaḥ kṛtsno’pi pūrvabhāgaḥ, uttarabhāge’pi - cetanācetanatatsṛṣṭyāditatphalasukhaduḥkhataddhetuśabdasparśāditadubhayaniyantṛ -
analyzed: atra bheda śruti śabdena nānāvidha dravya devatā deśa kāla itikartavya tā phala adhikāri prāyaścitta ādi upaskṛta uccāvaca yāga dāna homa ādi ātmaka karma vidhi paraḥ kṛtsnaḥ api pūrva bhāgaḥ uttara bhāge api cetana acetana tad sṛṣṭi ādi tad phala sukha duḥkha tad hetu śabda sparśa ādi tad ubhaya niyantṛ

original: īśvaraguṇavigrahatatprāptyupāyavidyāviśeṣatatphalagativiśeṣāditatpūrvakaparipūrṇabrahmānubhavatatpūrvakatatparicaryātadupapādakadivyamahiṣīpariccha
analyzed: hi

original: dādiparasahasrabhedapratipādakasandarbhāśca vivakṣitāḥ | ekyavācām
analyzed: da ādi para sahasra bheda pratipādaka sandarbhāḥ ca vivakṣitāḥ ekya vācām

original: abhedapratipādakasāmānādhikaraṇyanirdeśayuktatattvamasyādivākyānām | lakṣaṇā - viśeṣaṇāṃśatyāgaḥ | cakāraḥ padāntaravaiyarthyasamuccayaparaḥ | śaktigrahānusāreṇa pravṛttinimittadharmaprakārakopasthitiḥ prathamabhāvinī |
analyzed: abheda pratipādaka sāmānādhikaraṇya nirdeśa yukta tattvam asi ādi vākyānām lakṣaṇā viśeṣaṇa aṃśa tyāgaḥ cakāraḥ pada antara vaiyarthya samuccaya paraḥ śaktigraha anusāreṇa pravṛtti nimitta dharma prakāraka upasthitiḥ prathama bhāvinī

original: anantaraṃ taduktajātiguṇādyanyonyaikyāpattyādikutarkajanitakṣobheṇa, viśeṣaṇāṃśatyāgena viśeṣyasvarūpamātrabodha iti, vilaṃbitatvasāmyādviśeṣaṇāviṣayakaviśeṣyamātraviṣayakajñānajanakatvena lakṣaṇāśabdaprayogaḥ | prayojanaṃ tūktameva ||
analyzed: anantaram tad ukta jāti guṇa ādi anyonya aikya āpatti ādi kutarka janita kṣobheṇa viśeṣaṇa aṃśa tyāgena viśeṣya svarūpa mātra bodhaḥ iti vilaṃbita tva sāmyāt viśeṣaṇa a viṣayaka viśeṣya mātra viṣayaka jñāna janaka tvena lakṣaṇā śabda prayogaḥ prayojanam tu uktam eva

original: tadubhayetyādi - tāsāmubhayīnāṃ - bhedaśrutīnāmabhedaśrutīnāṃ ca ghaṭanāyāṃ bhedābhedayorviṣayabhedapradarśanena virodhaśamanapūrvakaṃ prāmāṇyopapādane, ( tarkaparāṇāṃ ) tātparyavatīnām | vācāṃ - yasyātmā śarīram ityādiśrutīnām | sarvanāmno vṛttimātra iti tadubhayeti puṃvadbhāvaḥ | vastvabhiprāyeṇedamuktam |
analyzed: tad ubhaya ityādi tāsām ubhayīnām bheda śrutīnām abheda śrutīnām ca ghaṭanāyām bheda abhedayoḥ viṣaya bheda pradarśanena virodha śamana pūrvakam prāmāṇya upapādane tarka parāṇām tātparyavatīnām vācām yasya ātmā śarīram ityādi śrutīnām sarvanāmnaḥ vṛtti mātre iti tat ubhaya iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ vastu abhiprāyeṇa idam uktam

original: bhedaśrutibhirjīveśvarabhedāvagamāt, abhedaśrutibhiśca tayorabhedāvagamāt, bhedābhedayośca virodhādanyatarabādhanaṃ vinānupapattau yasyātmā śarīram ityādibhiścidacitorbrahmaśarīratvāvagamāt, śarīrasya ca jātiguṇayordravyaṃ pratīva śarīriṇaṃ pratyapṛthaksiddhaprakārataikasvabhāvatayā prakāravāciśabdānāṃ prakāriparyantaśaktatvāt tattvamasi ityādau
analyzed: bheda śrutibhiḥ jīva īśvara bheda avagamāt abheda śrutibhiḥ ca tayoḥ abheda avagamāt bheda abhedayoḥ ca virodhāt anyatara bādhanam vinā anupapattau yasya ātmā śarīram ityādibhiḥ cit acitoḥ brahma śarīra tva avagamāt śarīrasya ca jāti guṇayoḥ dravyam prati iva śarīriṇam prati apṛthak siddha prakāra tā eka svabhāva tayā prakāra vāci śabdānām prakāri paryanta śakta tvāt tat tvam asi ityādau

original: śvetaketuśarīrakasya sārvajñyādiviśiṣṭasya caikyaṃ samānavibhaktyā bodhyate yathā nīlamutpalamityādau nīlatvaviśiṣṭasya utpalatvaviśiṣṭasya ceti | bhedaśrutibhiśca prakāraprakāriṇormitho bhedaḥ pradipādyate | ato bhedābhedaśrutyorna virodha ityayamartho ghaṭakaśrutibhiravagamyata iti vastusthitimanurudhya tadubhayaghaṭanātatparāṇāmi tyuktam |
analyzed: śvetaketu śarīrakasya sārvajñya ādi viśiṣṭasya ca aikyam samāna vibhaktyā bodhyate yathā nīlam utpalam ityādau nīla tva viśiṣṭasya utpala tva viśiṣṭasya ca iti bheda śrutibhiḥ ca prakāra prakāriṇoḥ mithas bhedaḥ pradipādyate atas bheda abheda śrutyoḥ na virodhaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ ghaṭaka śrutibhiḥ avagamyate iti vastu sthitim anurudhya tad ubhaya ghaṭana a tatparāṇām iti uktam

original: na tu ghaṭakatvaṃ parābhyupetamiti mantavyam ||
analyzed: na tu ghaṭaka tvam para abhyupetam iti mantavyam

original: dūreṇaiva prahāṇam - atyantaparityāgaḥ | yasyātmā śarīram ityādīnāmapi bhedaśrutitvāttatprayuktamaprāmāṇyamekaṃ, jagadbrahṇaṇorvyāvahārikakāryakāraṇabhāvābhyupagamavat tathāvidhaśarīraśarīribhāvābhyupagamābhāvāttadaṃśe’pyaprāmāṇyaṃ dvitīyaṃ, bhedaśrutīnāmasatyaviṣayakatvādabhedaśrutīnāṃ coktarītyā svarūpamātropasthāpakatvādbhedābhedayorabhāvena
analyzed: dūreṇa eva prahāṇam atyanta parityāgaḥ yasya ātmā śarīram ityādīnām api bheda śruti tvāt tad prayuktam aprāmāṇyam ekam jagat brahṇaṇoḥ vyāvahārika kārya kāraṇa bhāva abhyupagama vat tathāvidha śarīra śarīri bhāva abhyupagama abhāvāt tad aṃśepi aprāmāṇyam dvitīyam bheda śrutīnām asatya viṣayaka tvāt abheda śrutīnām ca ukta rītyā svarūpa mātra upasthāpaka tvāt bheda abhedayoḥ abhāvena

original: virodhasyāprasaktyā tacchamanāya ghaṭakānapekṣaṇāddhaṭakatvenāpyaprāmāṇyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ, tadidaṃ dūreṇaiva prahāṇami tyanena vivakṣitam | dūreṇa prahāṇe prahāṇahānayorarthasiddhatvāt | kiṃ ca tadubhayetyanena aikyavācāṃ sāmānyena parāmarśādanantaraṃ yogyatayā viśeṣaniścayasiddhiḥ | tatraikyaśrutiranekavidhā | kācitsamānavibhaktinirdeśenābhedabodhikā |
analyzed: virodhasya aprasaktyā tad śamanāya ghaṭaka anapekṣaṇāt dhaṭaka tvena api aprāmāṇyam tṛtīyam tat idam dūreṇa eva prahāṇam i ti anena vivakṣitam dūreṇa prahāṇe prahāṇa hānayoḥ artha siddha tvāt kim ca tad ubhaya iti anena aikya vācām sāmānyena parāmarśāt anantaram yogyatayā viśeṣa niścaya siddhiḥ tatra aikya śrutiḥ anekavidhā kācid samāna vibhakti nirdeśena abheda bodhikā

original: yathā - tattvamasi brahmadāśā ityādikā | kācicca
analyzed: yathā tattvam asi brahma dāśāḥ iti ādikā kācid ca

original: sajātīyadvitīyarāhityātmakaikatvabodhikā | yathā ekaśśāstā advitīyam ityādikā | kācittu bhedaniṣedhikā | yathā - yatra tvasya sarvam neha nānāsti ityādikā | trividhāyā apyaikyavācastātparyaṃ ghaṭakaśrutyā bodhyate | tatra viśeṣaṇadvayāśrayavastvabhedastvabhedaśrutyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sajātīya dvitīya rāhitya ātmaka ekatva bodhikā yathā ekaḥ śāstā advitīyam ityādikā kācid tu bheda niṣedhikā yathā yatra tu asya sarvam na iha nānā asti ityādikā trividhāyāḥ api aikya vācaḥ tātparyam ghaṭaka śrutyā bodhyate tatra viśeṣaṇa dvaya āśraya vastu abhedaḥ tu abheda śruti arthaḥ

original: śarīratayā cidacidviśiṣṭatvena sajātīyavastvantaraṃ nāstīti sajātīyadvitīyaśūnyatvātmakaikatvaśrutyarthaḥ | bhagavatprakāratayā vinā svaniṣṭhaṃ kiṃcidapi nāstīti bhedaniṣedhaśrutyartha iti trividhaikyaśrutitātparyaṃ yasyātmā śarīram ityādiśrutyā bodhyate |
analyzed: śarīratayā cit acit viśiṣṭa tvena sajātīya vastu antaram na asti iti sajātīya dvitīya śūnyatva ātmaka ekatva śruti arthaḥ bhagavat prakāratayā vinā sva niṣṭham kiṃcid api na asti iti bheda niṣedha śruti arthaḥ iti trividha aikya śruti tātparyam yasya ātmā śarīram ityādi śrutyā bodhyate

original: sarvasyā apyaikyaśruterbhedaśrutyā saha virodhena ghaṭakaśrutyā vinā parasparānupamardena prāmāṇyāsiddheḥ | tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorviśeṣaṇānāṃ mitho bhedaḥ prathamadvitīyayorbhedaśrutyarthaḥ | tṛtīye tvabrahmātmakatvaniṣedhe’pi svarūpāniṣedhāttadbheda eva bhedaśrutyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sarvasyāḥ api aikya śruteḥ bheda śrutyā saha virodhena ghaṭaka śrutyā vinā paraspara anupamardena prāmāṇya asiddheḥ tatra viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ viśeṣaṇānām mithas bhedaḥ prathama dvitīyayoḥ bheda śruti arthaḥ tṛtīye tu a brahma ātmaka tva niṣedhe api svarūpa a niṣedhāt tad bhedaḥ eva bheda śruti arthaḥ

original: ato jagadbrahmaṇoḥ śarīraśarīritayā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavodhakaghaṭakaśrutibhirbhedaśrutyabhedaśrutyoḥ virodhasamādhānena prāmāṇyamupapādyata iti tadubhayaghaṭanetyādyuktam ||
analyzed: atas jagat brahmaṇoḥ śarīra śarīri tayā viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva vodhaka ghaṭaka śrutibhiḥ bheda śruti abheda śrutyoḥ virodha samādhānena prāmāṇyam upapādyate iti tad ubhaya ghaṭana ityādi uktam

original: pratyakṣaṃ - indriyajanyaṃ, ādi padenānumānaṃ gṛhyate tathāvidhasya, pramāṇasya, svarasagatiḥ - saviśeṣavastubodhakatvasvārasyaṃ, tasyāḥ, hatiḥ - vyāghātaḥ, tyāga ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pratyakṣam indriya janyam ādi padena anumānam gṛhyate tathāvidhasya pramāṇasya sva rasa gatiḥ sa viśeṣa vastu bodhaka tva svārasyam tasyāḥ hatiḥ vyāghātaḥ tyāgaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: pratyakṣasya, sanmātra (viṣayakā) bhyupagamāt, anumānena nirviśeṣavastupakṣīkaraṇena nityatvādisādhanāt, prapañcamithyātvānumānena dharmigrāhakapratyakṣabādhābhyupagamācca pratyakṣādipramāṇasvārasyahānirityarthaḥ | tarketyādi | tarkonāma vyāpyāropeṇa vyāpakāropaḥ |
analyzed: pratyakṣasya sat mātra viṣayaka abhyupagamāt anumānena nirviśeṣa vastu pakṣīkaraṇena nitya tva ādi sādhanāt prapañca mithyātva anumānena dharmi grāhaka pratyakṣa bādhā abhyupagamāt ca pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa svārasya hāniḥ iti arthaḥ tarka ityādi tarkaḥ nāma vyāpya āropeṇa vyāpaka āropaḥ

original: tarkayāmyāpādayāmītyādyanubhavasākṣiko vyāptigrahādidvārā pramāṇānugrāhako jñānaviśeṣaḥ | tasyāpi saviśeṣaviṣayatvāt nirviśeṣavastuvādināṃ tadanādaraḥ spaṣṭaḥ | pratyakṣasya sanmātragrāhitve sarvapratītīnāmaviśeṣaprasaṅgāt pravṛttinivṛttivyavasthāvirahaprasaṅgaḥ |

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ - acitsaṃsṛṣṭātmabahutvapratītirlokasiddhā | pariśuddhātmasvarūpabahutvasya tu lokasiddhatvābhāvāt tatra śāsrasya tātparyaṃ saṃbhavatyeva | śrutau hi nityānāṃ bahūnāṃ cetanānāmiti saṃbandhādviśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyamiti rītyā nityatvaviśiṣṭasya bahutvalābhānnityatve bahutvāvacchedakatā labhyate |
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ acit saṃsṛṣṭa ātma bahutva pratītiḥ loka siddhā pariśuddha ātma svarūpa bahutvasya tu loka siddha tva abhāvāt tatra śāsrasya tātparyam saṃbhavati eva śrutau hi nityānām bahūnām cetanānām iti saṃbandhāt viśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyam iti rītyā nitya tva viśiṣṭasya bahutva lābhāt nitya tve bahutva avacchedaka tā labhyate

original: aupādhikākārasyānityatvānniṣkṛṣṭasvarūpasyaiva nityatvāttadavacchedenātmabahutvabodhane sati pariśuddhātmasvarūpabahutvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavatīti tatra śāsratātparyaṃ saṃbhavatyeveti | na ca śrutau nityānāṃ nityaḥ cetanānāṃ cetana iti saṃbandhaḥ sānnidhyāditi vācyam |
analyzed: aupādhika ākārasya anitya tvāt niṣkṛṣṭa svarūpasya eva nitya tvāt tad avacchedena ātma bahutva bodhane sati pariśuddha ātma sva rūpa bahutvam siddham bhavati iti tatra śāsra tātparyam saṃbhavati eva iti na ca śrutau nityānām nityaḥ cetanānām cetanaḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ sānnidhyāt iti vācyam

original: saṃbhavati sābhānādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasyānucitatvāt eko bahunāmityatra vairūpyāpatteśca tadayogāt | sānnidhyaṃ tu nityānāṃ kāmavidhānaṃ nityasyocitamityaucityavyañjanopakṣīṇamiti na sāmānādhikaraṇyabādhakam | sannidhiśca durbalapramāṇatvānna śrutirūpaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bādhitumalam |
analyzed: saṃbhavati sābhānādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasya anucita tvāt ekaḥ bahunām iti atra vairūpya āpatteḥ ca tad ayogāt sānnidhyam tu nityānām kāma vidhānam nityasya ucitam iti aucitya vyañjana upakṣīṇam iti na sāmānādhikaraṇya bādhakam sannidhiḥ ca durbala pramāṇa tvāt na śruti rūpam sāmānādhikaraṇyam bādhitum alam

original: śrutau nityānāṃ bahūnāmityatra viśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyamiti rītyaiva bodha iti sūcanāyaiva śloke nityatvātmabahutvamiti tṛtīyāsamāsagarbhaḥ sandarbhaḥ svīkṛtaḥ na tu nityātmabahutvamiti karmadhārayagarbhaḥ | yadvā nityatvaṃ cātmabahutvaṃ ca nityatvātmabahutvamiti samāhāradvandvaḥ |
analyzed: śrutau nityānām bahūnām iti atra viśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyam iti rītyā eva bodhaḥ iti sūcanāya eva śloke nitya tva ātma bahutvam iti tṛtīyā samāsa garbhaḥ sandarbhaḥ svīkṛtaḥ na tu nitya ātma bahutvam iti karmadhāraya garbhaḥ yat vā nitya tvam ca ātma bahutvam ca nitya tva ātma bahutvam iti samāhāra dvandvaḥ

original: tasya ca samūhārthakatvāt samūhasya caikakālāvacchedenaikadeśasthānekavastvātmakatvānnityatvabahutvayorātmanyekakālāvacchinnavṛttikatvasiddhyā pariśuddhātmasvarūpabahutvalābhaḥ | śrutau ca nityānāṃ bahūnāmiti sāmānādhikaraṇyopagamāt |
analyzed: tasya ca samūha arthaka tvāt samūhasya ca eka kāla avacchedena eka deśa stha aneka vastu ātmaka tvāt nitya tva bahu tvayoḥ ātmani eka kāla avacchinna vṛttika tva siddhyā pariśuddha ātma svarūpa bahutva lābhaḥ śrutau ca nityānām bahūnām iti sāmānādhikaraṇya upagamāt

original: tatra ca kālaikyamapi bhāsata iti tāntrikābhyupagamānnityatvabahutvayorātmasvekakālāvacchinnavṛttikatvalābhācchrati -
analyzed: tatra ca kāla aikyam api bhāsate iti tāntrika abhyupagamāt nitya tva bahu tvayoḥ ātmasu eka kāla avacchinna vṛttika tva lābhāt śrati

original: gatasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śloke samāhāradvandvaprayogeṇa vivṛtam | taduktaṃ sudarśanabhaṭṭapādaiḥ - nityatvasamānādhikaraṇabahutve’bhihite pariśuddhātmasvarūpabahutvaṃ hyuktaṃ bhavati iti | ataḥ pṛthaktvaniveśitvanayādātmabahutvamātma bhedalambhakamiti hṛdayam ||
analyzed: gata sāmānādhikaraṇyam śloke samāhāra dvandva prayogeṇa vivṛtam tat uktam sudarśana bhaṭṭa pādaiḥ nitya tva samāna adhikaraṇa bahutva ibhihite pariśuddha ātma svarūpa bahutvam hi uktam bhavati iti atas pṛthaktva niveśi tva nayāt ātma bahutvam ātma bheda lambhakam iti hṛdayam

original: mūktāvapi bhedaśravaṇānniṣkṛṣṭātmanāṃ mitho bheda ityāha - pratyaktavenetyādinā | pratyaktavena - ahaṃbuddhibodhyatvena | parāktayā - idaṃbuddhibodhyatvena svaparayoḥ muktānāṃ svasya cānyasya ca mitho bhedaḥ sphuṭaḥ śrutiṣu spaṣṭa ityarthaḥ | pratyakatvaparākatvarūpaviruddhadharmādhyāsānmokṣadaśāyāmātmabhedhaḥ, śrutisiddha iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: mūktau api bheda śravaṇāt niṣkṛṣṭa ātmanām mithas bhedaḥ iti āha pratyaktavena ityādinā pratyaktavena aham buddhi bodhya tvena parāktayā idam buddhi bodhya tvena sva parayoḥ muktānām svasya ca anyasya ca mithas bhedaḥ sphuṭaḥ śrutiṣu spaṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ pratyaka tva parāka tva rūpa viruddha dharma adhyāsāt mokṣa daśāyām ātma bhedhaḥ śruti siddhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: śrutiṣu muktānāmahamidaṃvyavahāraḥ tatra tatra draṣṭavyaḥ | (yadvā svaparayorityantaṃ saṃsāradaśāyāṃ bhedasiddhiparam) muktāviti mokṣadaśāyāṃ tatsiddhiparam | idaṃ ca bhedaśrutīnāmanṛtaviṣayatānirasanaṃ bhedaniṣedhārthaṃ bhedānuvādarūpāṇi bhedaśravaṇāni iti pakṣanirāsasyāpyupalakṣaṇam || 51 ||
analyzed: śrutiṣu muktānām aham idam vyavahāraḥ tatra tatra draṣṭavyaḥ yat vā sva parayoḥ ityantam saṃsāra daśāyām bheda siddhi param muktau iti mokṣa daśāyām tad siddhi param idam ca bheda śrutīnām anṛta viṣaya tā nirasanam bheda niṣedha artham bheda anuvāda rūpāṇi bheda śravaṇāni iti pakṣa nirāsasya api upalakṣaṇam 51

original: ādau bhedaśrutīnāmanṛtaviṣayatā ityuktaparābhyupagamo vistareṇa dūṣitaḥ | atha lakṣaṇā caikyavācām ityuktaṃ tatpakṣaṃ vistareṇa dūṣayati -
analyzed: ādau bheda śrutīnām anṛta viṣaya tā iti ukta para abhyupagamaḥ vistareṇa dūṣitaḥ atha lakṣaṇā ca aikya vācām iti uktam tad pakṣam vistareṇa dūṣayati

original: sāmānādhikaraṇyabhāgiṣu padastomeṣu sarveṣu kiṃ
analyzed: sāmānādhikaraṇya bhāgiṣu pada stomeṣu sarveṣu kim

original: pratyāyyaṃ vyatiricyate pratipadaṃ vaktavyamadvaitinā |
analyzed: pratyāyyam vyatiricyate pratipadam vaktavyam advaitinā

original: yadvā neti na cedanarthakatayā nekātiriktaṃ padaṃ
analyzed: yat vā na iti na ced anarthaka tayā na eka atiriktam padam

original: paṭhyeta prativādinastvitarathā yuktiḥ svamāsīdati || 52 ||
analyzed: paṭhyeta prativādinaḥ tu itarathā yuktiḥ svam āsīdati 52

original: vyā - parairhi samānādhikaraṇavākyasyākhaṇḍārthatvamuktam | tathā hi - sāmānādhikaraṇyasyaikārthaparatvavyutpatteraikārthyasyaca padānāṃ viśeṣaṇamātraparatve viśiṣṭaparatve cāsiddheḥ svarūpapātraikyaparatvaṃ satyādisamānādhikaraṇapadānāmiti | tadidaṃ nirasyati - sāmānādhikaraṇyetyādinā | sarveṣu - vyadhikaraṇeṣu
analyzed: paraiḥ hi samāna adhikaraṇa vākyasya akhaṇḍa artha tvam uktam tathā hi sāmānādhikaraṇyasya eka artha paratva vyutpatteḥ aikārthyasya ca padānām viśeṣaṇa mātra paratve viśiṣṭa paratve ca asiddheḥ svarūpa pātra aikya paratvam satya ādi samāna adhikaraṇa padānām iti tat idam nirasyati sāmānādhikaraṇya ityādinā sarveṣu vyadhikaraṇeṣu

original: samānādhikaraṇeṣu ca | padastomeṣu - vākyeṣu madhye | sāmānādhikaraṇyabhāgiṣu - samānādhikaraṇeṣu padeṣu, samānamekamadhikaraṇaṃ vācyaṃ teṣāṃ tathoktāni samānādhikaraṇāni, teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ, tatra bhāgaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tadvatsvityarthaḥ karaṇasyaivādhikaraṇatvavivakṣayā saptamī | pratyāyyaṃ bodhyam | pratipadaṃ - tattatpadeṣu |
analyzed: samāna adhikaraṇeṣu ca pada stomeṣu vākyeṣu madhye sāmānādhikaraṇya bhāgiṣu samāna adhikaraṇeṣu padeṣu samānam ekam adhikaraṇam vācyam teṣām tathā uktāni samāna adhikaraṇāni teṣām bhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam tatra bhāgaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tadvatsu iti arthaḥ karaṇasya eva adhikaraṇa tva vivakṣayā saptamī pratyāyyam bodhyam pratipadam tat tat padeṣu

original: vyatiricyate bhinnaṃ bhavati | yadvā - athavā | neti - na vyatiricyata iti praśne | advaitinā - nirviśeṣavastvabhyupagamavatā mṛṣāvādinā | kiṃ vaktavyaṃ - kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepārthakaḥ | uktakalpayoḥ naiko’pi kalpo vaktuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ | samānādhikaraṇapadeṣu kiṃcitpadabodhyasya taditarapadabodhyādviśeṣo’sti vā na veti praśne
analyzed: vyatiricyate bhinnam bhavati yat vā athavā na iti na vyatiricyate iti praśne advaitinā nirviśeṣa vastu abhyupagamavatā mṛṣāvādinā kim vaktavyam kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepa arthakaḥ ukta kalpayoḥ na ekaḥ api kalpaḥ vaktum śakyate iti arthaḥ samāna adhikaraṇa padeṣu kiṃcid pada bodhyasya tad itara pada bodhyāt viśeṣaḥ usti vā na vā iti praśne

original: mṛṣāvādinā kiṃcidapyuttaraṃ vaktuṃ śakyamityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha - na cedityādi | buddhisthatvāt dvitīyaṃ śiraḥ prathamaṃ dūṣyate | na cetpratyāyyaṃ - na vyatiricyate cedityarthaḥ | ekātiriktaṃ - vivakṣitatattadekaikapadātiriktam | padam anarthakatayā padāntarābodhitārthabodhanarūpaprayojanaviraheṇa hetunā |
analyzed: mṛṣāvādinā kiṃcid api uttaram vaktum śakyam iti arthaḥ kutas iti atra āha na ced ityādi buddhi stha tvāt dvitīyam śiraḥ prathamam dūṣyate na ced pratyāyyam na vyatiricyate ced iti arthaḥ eka atiriktam vivakṣita tad tad eka eka pada atiriktam padam anarthaka tayā pada antara ābodhita artha bodhana rūpa prayojana viraheṇa hetunā

original: na paṭhyeta - nādhīyītetyarthaḥ uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ tathā ca paṭhyamānasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅga iti hṛdayam ||
analyzed: na paṭhyeta na adhīyīta iti arthaḥ ukta arthānām aprayogaḥ iti nyāyāt iti bhāvaḥ tathā ca paṭhyamānasya vaiyarthya prasaṅgaḥ iti hṛdayam

original: idamupalakṣaṇaṃ - padānāṃ paryāyatvaprasaṅgaḥ | pravṛttinimittabhedābhāvena sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniprasaṅgaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyapratyāyyasya aikyasya svarūpātireke sakhaṇḍatvaprasaṅgaḥ | anatireke tasya pratipadikāvagatasvarūpāvirodhānna viśeṣaṇatyāga ityapi bodhyam |
analyzed: idam upalakṣaṇam padānām paryāya tva prasaṅgaḥ pravṛtti nimitta bheda abhāvena sāmānādhikaraṇya lakṣaṇa hāni prasaṅgaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya pratyāyyasya aikyasya svarūpa atireke sakhaṇḍa tva prasaṅgaḥ anatireke tasya pratipadikā avagata sva rūpa avirodhāt na viśeṣaṇa tyāgaḥ iti api bodhyam

original: sarveṣu padastomeṣvityanena sarveṣveva vākyeṣu padānāṃ vyutpattisiddhārthasaṃsargaviśeṣamātraṃ pratyāyyamiti samānādhikaraṇapadeṣu kevalaṃ vyutpattisiddhapravattinimittaprahāṇaṃ nocitam | samānavibhaktyavagatamaikyaṃ tu prātipadikāvagataviśeṣaṇasaṃbandhāvirodhena pradhānabhūtāviśeṣyaikya paramityayamarthaḥ sūcitaḥ ||
analyzed: sarveṣu pada stomeṣu iti anena sarveṣu eva vākyeṣu padānām vyutpatti siddha artha saṃsarga viśeṣa mātram pratyāyyam iti samāna adhikaraṇa padeṣu kevalam vyutpatti siddha pravatti nimitta prahāṇam na ucitam samāna vibhakti avagatam aikyam tu prātipadika avagata viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha avirodhena pradhāna bhūta a viśeṣya aikya param iti ayam arthaḥ sūcitaḥ

original: prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati - itarathetyādinā | itarathā - pratyāyyaṃ pratipadaṃ bhinnaṃ cet satyādipadānāṃ tattatpadārthavirodhivyāvṛttimātraparatve virodhivyāvṛttyavacchinnasvarūpaparatve cetyarthaḥ prativādino yuktiḥ asmatprativādino’khaṇḍavākyārthasādhakatvenābhimataḥ samānavibhaktyavagataikyāsiddhirūpo hetuḥ | svam - prativādinaḥ svīyaṃ pakṣam |
analyzed: prathamam śiraḥ dūṣayati itarathā ityādinā itarathā pratyāyyam pratipadam bhinnam ced satya ādi padānām tad tad padārtha virodhi vyāvṛtti mātra paratve virodhi vyāvṛtti avacchinna svarūpa paratve ca iti arthaḥ prativādinaḥ yuktiḥ asmat prativādinā ukhaṇḍa vākya artha sādhaka tvena abhimataḥ samāna vibhakti avagata aikya asiddhi rūpaḥ hetuḥ svam prativādinaḥ svīyam pakṣam

original: āsīdati - vyāghatakabhāvena prāpnotītyarthaḥ | satyādipadānāṃ virodhivyāvṛttimātraparatve pratiyogibhedena vyāvṛttibhedādaikyāsiddhiḥ, vyāvṛttyavacchinnasvarūpaparatve ca vyāvṛttīnā mupalakṣaṇatve padāntaravaiyarthyam, viśeṣaṇatve tvekārthatvāsiddhiriti dūṣaṇaṃ prativādinaḥ svapakṣe’pyāpatatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: āsīdati vyāghataka bhāvena prāpnoti iti arthaḥ satya ādi padānām virodhi vyāvṛtti mātra paratve pratiyogi bhedena vyāvṛtti bhedāt aikya asiddhiḥ vyāvṛtti avacchinna svarūpa paratve ca vyāvṛttīnām upalakṣaṇa tve pada antara vaiyarthyam viśeṣaṇa tve tu ekārtha tva asiddhiḥ iti dūṣaṇam prativādinaḥ sva pakṣe api āpatati iti bhāvaḥ

original: viśeṣaṇabhūtārthabhede’pi viśeṣyabhūtapradhānārthaikārthyasiddhiriti ca pakṣadvaye’pi samānam | paraṃ tu siddhānte padānāṃ mukhyatā, pakṣāntare tu tattadvirodhivyāvṛtti lakṣakatvamiti viśeṣa iti tuśabdārthaḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa bhūta artha bhede pi viśeṣya bhūta pradhāna artha aikārthya siddhiḥ iti ca pakṣa dvaye pi samānam param tu siddhānte padānām mukhya tā pakṣa antare tu tat tat virodhi vyāvṛtti lakṣaka tvam iti viśeṣaḥ iti tuśabda arthaḥ

original: itthaṃ ślokatrayeṇa, ādau bhedaśrutīnāmanṛtaviṣayatā lakṣaṇā caikyavācām ityuktaparābhyupagamadvayaṃ vistareṇa dūṣitam | dūreṇaiva prahāṇaṃ tadubhayaghaṭanātatparāṇāṃ ca vācām ityetattu, ghaṭakaśrutīnāmapi bhedaśrutitvena bhedaśrutyanṛtaviṣayatādūṣaṇenaiva dūṣitamiti pṛthaṅ na dūṣitam |
analyzed: ittham śloka trayeṇa ādau bheda śrutīnām anṛta viṣaya tā lakṣaṇā ca aikya vācām iti ukta para abhyupagama dvayam vistareṇa dūṣitam dūreṇa eva prahāṇam tad ubhaya ghaṭana a tatparāṇām ca vācām iti etat tu ghaṭaka śrutīnām api bheda śruti tvena bheda śruti anṛta viṣaya tā dūṣaṇena eva dūṣitam iti pṛthak na dūṣitam

original: dūreṇaiva ityādinā pṛthaguddeśasūcitam yasyātmā śarīram ityādiṣu śarīrādiśabdānāṃ
analyzed: dūreṇa eva ityādinā pṛthak uddeśa sūcitam yasya ātmā śarīram ityādiṣu śarīra ādi śabdānām

original: tādadhīnyalakṣakatāyāḥ parābhimatatvena tadaṃśe lakṣaṇāpyāpatatītyevaṃrūpamadhikadūṣaṇaṃ tu dūreṇaiva prahāṇam ityatraivoktamiti na tatra vistarāpekṣā | ato’tra nirdeśakrameṇa pratyakṣādi pramāṇasvārasyahānim idārnī viśadayati -
analyzed: tādadhīnya lakṣaka tāyāḥ para abhimata tvena tad aṃśe lakṣaṇā api āpatati iti evaṃrūpam adhika dūṣaṇam tu dūreṇa eva prahāṇam iti atra eva uktam iti na tatra vistara apekṣā nirdeśa krameṇa pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa svārasya hānim viśadayati

original: dṛśyatvādanṛtaṃ vigītamiti yaddaṣṭāntayanto jaguḥ
analyzed: dṛśya tvāt anṛtam vigītam iti yat daṣṭa antayantaḥ jaguḥ

original: śuktyāropitarūpyamatra katicittatredamācakṣmahe |
analyzed: śukti āropita rūpyam atra katicid tatra idam ācakṣmahe

original: dharmigrāhakamānadhikakṛtamidaṃ sopādhikatvaṃ punaḥ
analyzed: dharmi grāhakam ānadhika kṛtam idam sopādhika tvam punar

original: saitraṃ vyaktamabhaṅguraṃ vyabhicaraliṅgaṃ ca bhaṅgāya vaḥ || 53 ||
analyzed: saitram vyaktam abhaṅguram vyabhicara liṅgam ca bhaṅgāya vaḥ

original: parairitthamuktam - vigītaḥ prapañco mithyā dṛśyatvāt śuktirūpyavat ityanumānena prapañcamithyātvasiddhiḥ | svābhāvādhikaraṇe pratīyamānatvaṃ, svasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ, jñānanivartyatvaṃ vā mithyātvamiha sādhyadharmaḥ | jñānaviṣayatvarupaddaśyatvaṃ hetuḥ |
analyzed: paraiḥ ittham uktam vigītaḥ prapañcaḥ mithyā dṛśya tvāt śukti rūpya vat iti anumānena prapañca mithyātva siddhiḥ sva abhāva adhikaraṇe pratīyamāna tvam sva samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogitvam jñāna nivartya tvam vā mithyātvam iha sādhya dharmaḥ hetuḥ

original: dravyasamavetapratyakṣe saṃyuktasamavāyasyāvaśyakatvena tadabhāvena rajatatvānyathākhyāterasaṃbhavādanirvacanīyaṃ sākṣibhāsyaṃ śuktāvapūrvaṃ rajatamutpadyate | tacca dravyaṃ dṛṅnivatrtye ceti tadeva vyāptiniścayabhūmitayā ddaṣṭānta iti | tadidamanuvadati - ddaśyatvādi tyādinā | atra katicit mṛṣāvādina ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dravya samaveta pratyakṣe saṃyukta samavāyasya āvaśyaka tvena tad abhāvena rajata tva anyathā khyāteḥ asaṃbhavāt anirvacanīyam sākṣi bhāsyam śuktau apūrvam rajatam utpadyate tat ca dravyam ca iti tat eva vyāpti niścaya bhūmi tayā ddaṣṭānte iti tat idam anuvadati tyādinā atra katicid mṛṣāvādinaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: śuktyāropitarūpyam - śuktiviśeṣyakabhramaprakārabhūtaṃ rajatam; yadvā rajatakāraṇatayā klṛptasāmagryabhāvena,
analyzed: śukti āropita rūpyam śukti viśeṣyaka bhrama prakāra bhūtam rajatam yat vā rajata kāraṇatayā klṛpta sāmagrya bhāvena

original: pārśvasthānupalambhena ca tatrāsaṃbhāvitotpattikameva kevalaṃ svīyakusṛṣṭyā śuktāvutpannatayā kathitaṃ rajatam | ddaṣṭāntayantaḥ santaḥ - vyāptiniścayabhūmibhūtadṛṣṭāntamācakṣāṇāḥ santaḥ | ddaṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalyarūpasiddhāntyabhimatadūṣaṇasphoraṇāya śuktyāropitetyuktam | utpattayarthādrohateḥ ṇijantāt karmaṇi ktaḥ |
analyzed: pārśva stha anupalambhena ca tatra asaṃbhāvita utpattikam eva kevalam svīya kusṛṣṭyā śuktau utpannatayā kathitam rajatam ddaṣṭāntayantaḥ santaḥ vyāpti niścaya bhūmi bhūta dṛṣṭāntam ācakṣāṇāḥ santaḥ ddaṣṭāntasya sādhya vaikalya rūpa siddhānti abhimata dūṣaṇa sphoraṇāya śukti āropitā iti uktam utpatta yarthāt rohateḥ ṇic antāt karmaṇi ktaḥ

original: atra ca dṛṣṭāntayanta ityatra tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe iti sūtreṇākhyānārthako ṇic | jñānapratyāsattyupagamāt, pañjīkaraṇasiddharajatākyavasattvopagamādvā rajatānyathākhyāteḥ, yathārthakhyātervo upagamāt rajatagrahopapatteśca na tatra rajatītpattyapekṣeti hṛdayam | vigītaṃ vivādādhyāsitam | jagaditi śeṣaḥ | uttaraśloke jagata ityukteḥ |
analyzed: atra ca dṛṣṭāntayantaḥ iti atra tat karoti tat ācaṣṭe iti sūtreṇa ākhyāna arthakaḥ jñāna pratyāsatti upagamāt vā rajata anyathā khyāteḥ upagamāt rajata graha upapatteḥ ca na tatra rajatī itpatti apekṣā iti hṛdayam vigītam vivāda adhyāsitam jagat iti śeṣaḥ uttara śloke jagataḥ iti ukteḥ

original: ayaṃ pakṣanirdeśaḥ | anṛtaṃ - jñānanivatrtyatvarūpamithyātvavat | idaṃ sādhyasamarpakam | ddaśyatvāt jñānaviṣayatvāt | iyaṃ hetūktiḥ | iti yat vimataṃ jaganmithyā ddaśyatvāt śuktirūpyavat ityākārakaṃ yadanumānam | jaguḥ avadan | śiśupaśuprāyapuruṣarañcakatvāt gānatvoktiḥ |
analyzed: ayam pakṣa nirdeśaḥ anṛtam jñāna nivatrtya tva rūpa mithyātva vat idam sādhya samarpakam ddaśya tvāt jñāna viṣaya tvāt iyam hetu uktiḥ iti yat vimatam jagat mithyā ddaśya tvāt śukti rūpya vat iti ākārakam yat anumānam jaguḥ avadan śiśu paśu prāya puruṣa rañcaka tvāt gāna tva uktiḥ

original: tasya vaidikasadaḥ śikhāmaṇeragrataḥ kvaparavādisaṃbhavaḥ iti pūrvoktadiśā jaguriti parokṣanirdeśaḥ | tatredamācakṣmahe - tasminnanumāne kālatyayāpadeśasopādhikatvavyāghātātmakadūṣaṇatrayamidam
analyzed: tasya vaidika sadaḥ śikhāmaṇeḥ agratas kva para vādi saṃbhavaḥ iti pūrva ukta diśā jaguḥ iti parokṣa nirdeśaḥ tatra idam ācakṣmahe tasmin anumāne kāla tyaya apadeśa sopādhika tva vyāghāta ātmaka dūṣaṇa trayam idam

original: uparitanasārghaślokena sūtrakārahṛdayānusāriṇo vayaṃ vadāma ityarthaḥ | tatrāsya ślokasyottarārghena prathamaṃ kālātyayāpadeśaṃ sopādhikatvaṃ cāha - dharmigrāhaketyādinā | idaṃ - jagatpakṣakadṛśyatvahetukamithyātvānumānam |
analyzed: uparitana sārgha ślokena sūtrakāra hṛdaya anusāriṇaḥ vayam vadāmaḥ iti arthaḥ tatra asya ślokasya uttarārghena prathamam kāla atyaya apadeśam sopādhika tvam ca āha dharmi grāhaka ityādinā idam jagat pakṣaka dṛśyatva hetuka mithyātva anumānam

original: dharmigrāhakamānena mithyātvarūpasādhyadharmaṃ prati dharmibhūtaprapañcagrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa prapañcasatyatvagrāhakeṇa, dhikkṛta - sādhyābhāvagrahaṇādbādhitam | ata idamanumānaṃ duṣṭamityarthaḥ | tadāhuḥ sudarśanabhaṭṭapādāḥ - tatrāśrayaḥ pratīto vā na vā ? na cedāśrayāsiddhiḥ |
analyzed: dharmi grāhaka mānena mithyātva rūpa sādhya dharmam prati dharmi bhūta prapañca grāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa prapañca satya tva grāhakeṇa dhikkṛta sādhya abhāva grahaṇāt bādhitam atas idam anumānam duṣṭam iti arthaḥ tat āhuḥ sudarśana bhaṭṭa pādāḥ tatra āśrayaḥ pratītaḥ vā na vā na ced āśraya asiddhiḥ

original: ( pratyakṣādipramāṇaiḥ satyatveneti tasya mithyātvasādhanaṃ dharmigrāhakapramāṇabadhitam iti | tathā caṇḍamārūte’pyuktaṃ - prapañcaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ svaprakāśaṃ svataḥ pramāṇaṃ ca |
analyzed: pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇaiḥ satya tvena iti tasya mithyātva sādhanam dharmi grāhaka pramāṇa badhitam iti tathā caṇḍamārūte pi uktam prapañca viṣayam jñānam sva prakāśam svatas pramāṇam ca

original: ato ghaṭādiviṣayakatvapramātvagrāhiṇāpratyakṣeṇa pramāviṣayatvaṃ ghaṭādau gṛhītamiti uṣṇatvapratyakṣeṇānuṣṇatvānāmānasyeva mithyātvānumānasyāpi bādhaḥ iti sopādhikatvamityādi - (punaśaśabdastu śabdārthakaḥ | cakāro viśeṣaṇatrayasamuccayaparaḥ) sautraṃ - vaidharmayācca na svapnādivat iti sūtroktam |
analyzed: atas ghaṭa ādi viṣayaka tva pramā tva grāhiṇā apratyakṣeṇa pramā viṣaya tvam ghaṭa ādau gṛhītam iti uṣṇatva pratyakṣeṇa anuṣṇatva anāmānasya iva mithyātva anumānasya api bādhaḥ iti sopādhikatvam ityādi punar śa śabdaḥ tu śabda arthakaḥ cakāraḥ viśeṣaṇa traya samuccaya paraḥ sautram vaidharmayāt ca na svapna ādi vat iti sūtra uktam

original: abhaṅguraṃ - abhagnaṃ, pakṣāvṛttitvasādhyasamavyāptyoḥ sattvenāpratyākhyepādhitvakam | vyabhicarat sādhyābhāvavadvṛtti, liṅgaṃ dṛśyatvāditi heturyena tattathoktam | jñāpyatvaṃ vigrahavākyasthātṛtīyārthaḥ | hetuvyabhicārajñāpakamityarthaḥ | upādhervyabhicāronnāyakatvādevamuktam | sopādhikatvaṃ pratipannopādhau bādhitatvarūpopādhimattā |
analyzed: abhaṅguram abhagnam pakṣa avṛtti tva sādhyasama vyāptyoḥ sattvena apratyākhyepādhitvakam vyabhicarat sādhya abhāvavat vṛtti liṅgam dṛśya tvāt iti hetuḥ yena tat tathā uktam jñāpya tvam vigraha vākya sthā tṛtīyā arthaḥ hetu vyabhicāra jñāpakam iti arthaḥ upādheḥ vyabhicāra unnāyaka tvāt evam uktam sopādhika tvam pratipanna upādhau bādhita tva rūpa upādhimat tā

original: puna śśabdo vākyālaṅkāraḥ | cakāraḥ pūrvoktadoṣasamuccāyakaḥ | vaḥ - vādināṃ yuṣmākam | bhaṅgāya - parājayahetuḥ | kālātyayāpadeśasya sākṣātsopādhikatvasya cānaikāntikadvārā vādiparājayāvahatvāditi bhāvaḥ | athavā kālātyayāpadiṣṭaṃ dṛśyatvaṃ ca abhaṅguraṃ sautraṃ tasya sopādhikatvaṃ ca, punaśśabdaścaśabdārthakaḥ;
analyzed: punar śabdaḥ vākya alaṅkāraḥ cakāraḥ pūrva ukta doṣa samuccāyakaḥ vaḥ vādinām yuṣmākam bhaṅgāya parājaya hetuḥ kāla atyaya apadeśasya sākṣāt sopādhika tvasya ca anaikāntika dvārā vādi parājaya āvaha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ athavā kāla atyaya apadiṣṭam dṛśya tvam ca abhaṅguram sautram tasya sopādhika tvam ca punar śabdaḥ caśabda arthakaḥ

original: brahmaṇyanaikāntikaṃ ddaśyatvāditi liṅgaṃ ca vaḥ parājayaheturiti yojanā | śrutissṛtisvārasyāt brahmaṇi ddaśyatvaṃ vartata ititthamuktam | tadāhuḥ - ddaśyatvaṃ ca brahmaṇi vyabhicāri iti | liṅgamiti sāmānyoktyā vyāvartamānatvāderapi dūṣaṇaṃ siddham tadidaṃ sopādhikatvaṃ bhaṭṭasudarśanapādairvistareṇoktama | tattu tatraivānusandheyam |
analyzed: brahmaṇi anaikāntikam ddaśya tvāt iti liṅgam ca vaḥ parājaya hetuḥ iti yojanā śruti ssṛti svārasyāt brahmaṇi ddaśya tvam vartate iti ittham uktam tat āhuḥ ca brahmaṇi vyabhicāri iti liṅgam iti sāmānya uktyā vyāvartamāna tva ādeḥ api dūṣaṇam siddham tat idam sopādhika tvam bhaṭṭa sudarśana pādaiḥ vistareṇa uktam tat tu tatra eva anusandheyam

original: vyaktami tyanena bālānāmapi idaṃ sopādhikatvaṃ sphuṭamiti vādinaḥ prayogākauśalatiśayāviṣkaraṇam || 53 ||
analyzed: vyaktam iti anena bālānām api idam sopādhika tvam sphuṭam iti vādinaḥ prayoga akauśala tiśaya āviṣkaraṇam

original: atha vyāghātamāha -
analyzed: atha vyāghātam āha

original: mithyātvaṃ bhrāntisiddhaṃ yadi khalu jagataḥ pādhyate siddhasādhyo
analyzed: mithyātvam bhrānti siddham yadi khalu jagataḥ pādhyate siddha sādhyaḥ

original: hetuḥ satyaḥ prapañco bhavati hi yadi vā satyamadvaitahāniḥ
analyzed: hetuḥ satyaḥ prapañcaḥ bhavati hi yadi vā satyam advaita hāniḥ

original: sādhyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ yadi bhavati tadā siddhasādhyatvameva
analyzed: sādhyam brahma svarūpam yadi bhavati tadā siddha sādhya tvam eva

original: syādevaṃ ca prapañcavyudasanasaraṇirdūrataste nirastā || 54 ||
analyzed: syāt evam ca prapañca vyudasana saraṇiḥ dūratas te nirastā

original: atra yattaditi padadvayamadhyāharthavyam | tathā ca jagato yanmithyātvaṃ sādhyate tadbhrāntisiddhaṃ yadīti yojanā | bhrāntisiddhaṃ bhrāntiprakārabhūtaṃ, mithyābhūtamiti yāvat | jagataḥ siṣāghayiṣitasya mithyātvasya mithyātvaṃ cedityarthaḥ | hetuḥ - ddaśyatvādikaḥ | siddhasādhyaḥ - siddhaṃ mānāntarāvagataṃ sādhyaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: atra yat tat iti pada dvayam adhyāharthavyam tathā ca jagataḥ yat mithyātvam sādhyate tat bhrānti siddham yadi iti yojanā bhrānti siddham bhrānti prakāra bhūtam mithyā bhūtam iti yāvat jagataḥ siṣāghayiṣitasya mithyātvasya mithyātvam ced iti arthaḥ hetuḥ ddaśya tva ādikaḥ siddhasādhyaḥ siddham māna antara avagatam sādhyam yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: atra syādityapakarṣaḥ | atra yathāśrute hetoḥ siddhasādhanatvaṃ doṣa iti pratīyate | tattu nāsti | taduktaṃ caṇḍamārute vastuto mithyātvasya mithyātve’pi tena rūpeṇa mithyātvasyāsādhyatvāt siddhasādhanāsaṃbhavādato’rthāntarameva iti | mithyātvasya mithyātve mithyābhūtasyāropitapītimnaḥ śvaityene parāmārthikasatyatvenāvirodhādarthāntaram iti ca |
analyzed: atra syāt iti apakarṣaḥ atra yathāśrute hetoḥ siddhasādhana tvam doṣaḥ iti pratīyate tat tu na asti tat uktam caṇḍamārute vastutas mithyātvasya mithyātve pi tena rūpeṇa mithyātvasya asādhya tvāt siddhasādhana asaṃbhavāt atas ṛthāntaram eva iti mithyātvasya mithyātve mithyābhūtasya āropita pītimnaḥ parāmārthika satya tvena avirodhāt arthāntaram iti ca

original: ato’tra siddhasādhyo heturityasyārthāntaraṃ syādityarthaḥ | tatphalitamāha - satyaḥ prapañco bhavatīti | āropitamithyātvasya pāramārthikasatyatvena virodhābhāvānna prapañcasatyatvahānirityarthaḥ | yadi
analyzed: atas utra siddha sādhyaḥ hetuḥ iti asya arthāntaram syāt iti arthaḥ tad phalitam āha satyaḥ prapañcaḥ bhavati iti āropita mithyātvasya pāramārthika satya tvena virodha abhāvāt na prapañca satya tva hāniḥ iti arthaḥ yadi

original: vetyādi | tat mithyātvaṃ satyaṃ yadītyarthaḥ | advaitahānirityatra tadā tasya brahmasvarūpātireka ityadiḥ | siṣādhayiṣitasya mithyātvasya satyatve tasya brahmasvarūpātireke ca sati brahmaṇaḥ satyena tena sadvitīyatvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | satyasyaiva tasya brahmasvarūpānatirekamāśaṅkya nirākaroti - sādhyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ yadi bhavatīti |
analyzed: vā ityādi tat mithyātvam satyam yadi iti arthaḥ advaita hāniḥ iti atra tadā tasya brahma svarūpa atirekaḥ iti adiḥ siṣādhayiṣitasya mithyātvasya satya tve tasya brahma svarūpa atireke ca sati brahmaṇaḥ satyena tena sadvitīya tva prasaṅgaḥ iti arthaḥ satyasya eva tasya brahma svarūpa anatirekam āśaṅkya nirākaroti sādhyam brahma svarūpam yadi bhavati iti

original: brahmasvarūpānatireke hi nādvaitahāniḥ, na vā jagataḥ satyatvamiti śaṅkāśayaḥ | siddhasādhyatvameva syāt - arthāntarameva syāt | brahmasvarūpasyāsmābhiraṅgīkārādityarthaḥ | evakāreṇa pūrvoktadoṣa evāpatatīti sūcyate | tataḥ phalitamāha - evaṃ ceti | evam - uktarītyā te prapaṃcavyudasanasaraṇiḥ tvaduktajaganmithyātvānumānaprakiyā | dūrato nirastā |
analyzed: brahma svarūpa anatireke hi na advaita hāniḥ na vā jagataḥ satya tvam iti śaṅkā āśayaḥ siddha sādhya tvam eva syāt artha antaram eva syāt brahma svarūpasya asmābhiḥ aṅgīkārāt iti arthaḥ eva kāreṇa pūrva ukta doṣaḥ eva āpatati iti sūcyate tatas phalitam āha evam ca iti evam ukta rītyā te prapaṃca vyudasana saraṇiḥ tvad ukta jagat mithyātva anumāna prakiyā dūratas nirastā

original: sādhyadharmapāramārthyāpāramārthyāvikalpādinā vyāghātaprasaṃjanāt dūṣitetyarthaḥ | mādhyamikoktajñānabādhyatvasya bhavatā bādhyatvābhyupagamānneyamapramāṇi kadharmaparamparāpādanena dūṣaṇarūpanityasameti sūcanāya caśabdaprayogaḥ | tadidamāhurbhaṭṭasudarśanapādā - sādhyadharmasya pāramārthyāpāramārthyavikalpe kṛte pāramārthyaṃ cedadvaitahāniḥ |
analyzed: sādhya dharma pāramārthya apāramārthya avikalpa ādinā vyāghāta prasaṃjanāt dūṣitā iti arthaḥ mādhyamika ukta jñāna bādhya tvasya bhavatā bādhya tva abhyupagamāt na iyam apramāṇi ka dharma paramparā āpādanena dūṣaṇa rūpa nityasamā iti sūcanāya caśabda prayogaḥ tat idam āhuḥ bhaṭṭa sudarśana pādāḥ sādhya dharmasya pāramārthya apāramārthya vikalpe kṛte pāramārthyam ced advaita hāniḥ

original: ddaśyatvahetoranaikāntyaṃ ca; paramārthe’pi tasya vṛtteḥ | apāramārthye prapañcasatyatā | bādhyakabādhe bādhyasvarūpābādhaḥ iti nyāyāt ityādinā || 54 ||
analyzed: tva hetoḥ anaikāntyam ca paramārthe api tasya vṛtteḥ apāramārthye prapañca satya tā bādhyaka bādhe bādhya svarūpa ābādhaḥ iti nyāyāt ityādinā

original: nanu vaidharmyācca na svapnādivat iti sūtrasya yogācārokte jāgaritapratyayo nirālambanaḥ vedanatvāt, svapnapratyayavat ityanumāne sopādhikatvapradarśanaparatvāt kathaṃ mṛṣāvādyuktamithyātvānumāne sopādhikatvapradarśanaparatoktiriti cet ? atrāhuḥ - mṛṣāvādināṃ cogācārāṇāṃ cārthamithyātvābhyupagamasyāviśeṣānna doṣa iti |
analyzed: nanu vaidharmyāt ca na svapna ādi vat iti sūtrasya yoga ācāra ukte jāgarita pratyayaḥ nirālambanaḥ vedana tvāt svapna pratyaya vat iti anumāne sopādhikatva pradarśana paratvāt katham mṛṣāvādi ukta mithyātva anumāne sopādhikatva pradarśana para tā uktiḥ iti ced atra āhuḥ mṛṣāvādinām ca ūga ācārāṇām ca artha mithyātva abhyupagamasya aviśeṣāt na doṣaḥ iti

original: taduktaṃ bhaṭṭasudarśanapādaiḥ pratītatve sati bādarhatvasya ubhayābhimatatvācca
analyzed: tat uktam bhaṭṭa sudarśana pādaiḥ pratīta tve sati bādarha tvasya ubhaya abhimata tvāt ca

original: iti kāraṇadoṣabādhapratyayayoranirvācyapakṣe’pyupādhitvopapatteraviśiṣṭatvāt iti ca | tathā caṇḍamārute’pyuktam - jāgaritapratyayo nirālambanaḥ vedanatvāt svāpnapratyayavat iti bauddhānumānam vaidharmyācca na svapnādivat iti, sūtrabhāṣye bhagavatā dūṣitam | māyinā prapañco mithyā ddagviṣayatvāt śuktirajatasvāpnādyarthādivat ityuktam |

original: sā - anubhūtiḥ | ayaṃ pakṣanirdeśaḥ | svasiddhiḥ - svenaiva siddhiḥ vyavahārānuguṇyaṃ yasyāstathoktā | svayaṃprakāśatve sati, (jñānāntaraviṣayatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ) avadhāraṇagarbhatvāduktārthasiddhiḥ, tacca vedyatve parajñeyeti ca pūrvaparānusārādāśritam | ayaṃ ca sādhyānirdeśaḥ | dhītvāt anubhūtitvāt | hetunirdeśo’yam |
