original: kumbhavaditi pūrvasmādanuṣajyate | vyatirekadṛṣṭāntaścāyam | ghaṭādau hi jñānāntaraviṣayatvābhāvasvaprakāśatvayorabhāvo’nanubhūtitvaṃ ca dṛṣṭamitīdaṃ vyatirekayanumānam | iti yadāha pūrvokākārakaṃ yadanumānamuktavān, vakti vā | tadasat | tat - anumānam asat - duṣṭaṃ, siddhasādhanakālātyayāpadeśasopādhikatvarūpadoṣayuktamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kumbha vat iti pūrvasmāt anuṣajyate vyatireka dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca ayam ghaṭa ādau hi ca dṛṣṭam iti idam iti yat āha pūrvoka ākārakam yat anumānam uktavān vakti vā tat asat tat anumānam asat duṣṭam siddhasādhana kāla atyaya apadeśa sopādhika tva rūpa doṣa yuktam iti arthaḥ

original: atra ca sādhyaṃ svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ kiṃ svaśrayaṃ prati, utānyaṃ prati | ādye siddhasādhanaṃ, antye bādhaḥ | parajñānasya paraṃ prati jñānamantareṇāprakāśāt | anubhūterjñānāntaraviṣayatvābhāvaśca bādhitaḥ | puruṣāntarajñānānāṃ puruṣāntarīyānumityādiviṣayatvāt | anyathā laukikavaidikasakalavyavahāravirodhāpatteḥ |
analyzed: atra ca sādhyam svayaṃprakāśatvam kim sva śrayam prati uta anyam prati ādye siddhasādhanam antye bādhaḥ para jñānasya param prati jñānam antareṇa aprakāśāt anubhūteḥ jñāna antara viṣaya tva abhāvaḥ ca bādhitaḥ puruṣa antara jñānānām puruṣa antarīya anumiti ādi viṣaya tvāt anyathā laukika vaidika sakala vyavahāra virodha āpatteḥ

original: ghaṭādeścānanubhūtitvamajñānāvirodhitvaprayuktaṃ nānubhāvyatvaprayuktamiti sopādhikaṃ cedam | tadetadāha - svasiddhirityādinā | svādhāraṃ prati - ahaṃ jānāmītyatra jñānāśrayatayā pratītamahamarthaṃ prati | svasiddhiḥ - svayaṃprakāśasvāśrayabhūtāhamarthakartṛkasvakarmakavyavahāre svayameva heturityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ghaṭa ādeḥ ca ananubhūti tvam ajñāna avirodhi tva prayuktam na anubhāvya tva prayuktam iti sa upādhikam ca idam tat etat āha sva siddhiḥ ityādinā sva ādhāram prati aham jānāmi iti atra jñāna āśraya tayā pratītam ahamartham prati sva siddhiḥ svayam prakāśa sva āśraya bhūta ahamartha kartṛka sva karmaka vyavahāre svayam eva hetuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: śeṣitvavācinā pratiśabdenāśrayakartṛkatvalābhaḥ | śeṣatvavācitā ca lakṣaṇetthaṃ bhūtākhyāna bhāgavīpsāsu pratiparyanavaḥ ityukteḥ | ata eva svādhāram ityatra dvitīyā | sādhyatāvacchedakaprakāreṇa mānāntarasiddhiparahiśabdena siddhasādhanatvaṃ sūcyate | na paramityādi;
analyzed: śeṣitva vācinā pratiśabdena āśraya kartṛkatva lābhaḥ śeṣatva vāci tā ca lakṣaṇā ittham bhūta ākhyāna bhāga vīpsāsu prati paryanavaḥ iti ukteḥ atas eva sva ādhāram iti atra dvitīyā sādhya tā avacchedaka prakāreṇa māna antara siddhi para hi śabdena siddhasādhanatvam sūcyate na param ityādi

original: paraṃ naraṃ pratyapi svāśrayapuruṣādanyaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyapi (puruṣāntaraṃ pratyapi) | svasiddhirna bhavati hītyarthaḥ | hiśabdo madhmamaṇinyāyāt pūrvāparānvayī | ataḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭamidamityarthaḥ parejñeyetyādi; seyaṃ - svāśrayaṃ prati svasiddharūpā puruṣāntaraṃ pratyatathāvidhā ca dhīḥ |
analyzed: param naram prati api sva āśraya puruṣāt anyam puruṣam prati api puruṣa antaram prati api sva siddhiḥ na bhavati hi iti arthaḥ hiśabdaḥ madhmamaṇi nyāyāt pūrva apara anvayī atas kāla atyaya apadiṣṭam idam iti arthaḥ pare jñeyā ityādi sā iyam sva āśrayam prati sva siddha rūpā puruṣa antaram prati atathāvidhā ca dhīḥ

original: parajñeyā - parayā - svabhinnānubhūtyā, jñānāntareṇetyarthaḥ | jñeyā viṣayīkāryā, jñānāntaraviṣayatvavatītyarthaḥ | sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puvaṃdbhāvaḥ parā cānubhūtidvayī samānādhikaraṇā vyadhikaraṇā ca | tayā dvividhayāpi vedyatvamanubhūteḥ | tatra
analyzed: para jñeyā parayā sva bhinna anubhūtyā jñāna antareṇa iti arthaḥ jñeyā viṣayīkāryā jñāna antara viṣaya tvavatī iti arthaḥ sarvanāmnaḥ vṛtti mātre parā ca anubhūti dvayī samāna adhikaraṇā vyadhikaraṇā ca tayā dvividhayā api vedya tvam anubhūteḥ tatra

original: tatpuruṣīyātītānāgatānubhūtestatpuruṣīyavartamānānubhūtiviṣayatvādādyayānubhāvyatvaṃ, puruṣāntarajñānānāṃ puruṣāntarānumeyatvadarśanādanyayānubhūtyānubhāvyatvamiti samānādhikaraṇavyadhikaraṇānubhūtidvayasaṃgrahāya parayā jñeyeti vyākhyātam | ato’nubhūterjñānāntaraviṣayatvābhāvo bādhita ityarthaḥ | tadapītyādi; atra dhiya ityanuṣajyate |
analyzed: tatpuruṣīya atīta anāgata anubhūteḥ tatpuruṣīya vartamāna anubhūti viṣaya tvāt ādyayā anubhāvya tvam puruṣa antara jñānānām puruṣa antara anumeya tva darśanāt anyayā anubhūtyā anubhāvya tvam iti samāna adhikaraṇa vyadhikaraṇa anubhūti dvaya saṃgrahāya parayā jñeyā iti vyākhyātam atas anubhūteḥ jñāna antara viṣaya tva abhāvaḥ bādhitaḥ iti arthaḥ tat api ityādi atra dhiyaḥ iti anuṣajyate

original: tadapi - tathāpi, parajñeyatve’pi, jñānāntaraviṣayatve satyapīti yāvat | dhiyaḥ - anubhūteḥ matitvaṃ, na vighaṭate - na virudhyate | anubhūtitvamanubhāvyatvādhikarānubhūtivṛttyabhāvāpratiyogītyarthaḥ | ghaṭāderanubhūtitvābhāvo nānubhāvyatvaprayuktaḥ | kiṃ tu ajñānāvirodhitvaprayuktaḥ | anubhūtistu ajñānavirodhinyeveti sopādhikatvamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: tat api tathā api para jñeya tve pi jñāna antara viṣaya tve sati api iti yāvat dhiyaḥ anubhūteḥ mati tvam na vighaṭate na virudhyate anubhūti tvam anubhāvya tva adhikara anubhūti vṛtti abhāva a pratiyogi iti arthaḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ anubhūti tva abhāvaḥ na anubhāvya tva prayuktaḥ kim tu ajñāna avirodhi tva prayuktaḥ anubhūtiḥ tu ajñāna virodhinī eva iti sopādhika tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: anubhūteranubhūtitvamasādhāraṇadharmaḥ | anubhūtitvaṃ ca vartamānadaśāyāṃ svasattayaiva svāśrayaṃ prati prakāśamānatvam | anubhāvyatvaṃ tu ghaṭādisādhāraṇaṃ, na hyasādhāraṇākāro dharmigrāhakamānanasiddhiḥ sādhāraṇākāre satyapagacchati | tathā sati (ghaṭāderanubhāvyatvena dhaṭatvādiprasaṅgādityanubhāvyatvānanubhāvyatvayoḥ) vyāptiṃ dūṣayati -
analyzed: anubhūteḥ anubhūti tvam asādhāraṇa dharmaḥ anubhūti tvam ca vartamāna daśāyām sva sattayā eva sva āśrayam prati prakāśamāna tvam anubhāvya tvam tu ghaṭa ādi sādhāraṇam na hi asādhāraṇa ākāraḥ dharmi grāhaka mānana siddhiḥ sādhāraṇa ākāre sati apagacchati tathā sati ghaṭa ādeḥ anubhāvya tvena dhaṭa tva ādi prasaṅgāt iti anubhāvya tva ananubhāvya tvayoḥ vyāptim dūṣayati

original: tathā hi pratyakṣaprabhṛtimitivargaprakaṭitaḥ
analyzed: tathā hi pratyakṣa prabhṛti miti varga prakaṭitaḥ

original: svabhāvo bhāvānāmapasarati vedyāsta iti kim |
analyzed: svabhāvaḥ bhāvānām apasarati vedyāḥ te iti kim

original: svabhāvapratyāso yadi bhavati vedyatvavaśataḥ
analyzed: svabhāva pratyāsaḥ yadi bhavati vedya tva vaśataḥ

original: paṭasya jñeyatve ghaṭavadapaṭatvaṃ prasajati || 60 ||
analyzed: paṭasya jñeya tve ghaṭa vat apaṭa tvam prasajati

original: tathā hi - tadapi na matitvaṃ vighaṭate iti yatpūrvamuktaṃ tattathaivetyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha - pratyakṣetyādi | te - bhāvāḥ, padārthāḥ | vedyā iti - jñānaviṣayā iti | itiśabdo hetvarthakaḥ | vedyatvātkāraṇādityarthaḥ | bhāvānāṃ - padārthānām | pratyakṣaprabhṛtimitivargaiḥ - sākṣātkārānumitiśābdātmakapramāsamūhaiḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi tat api na mati tvam vighaṭate iti yat pūrvam uktam tat tathā eva iti arthaḥ kutas iti atra āha pratyakṣa ityādi te bhāvāḥ padārthāḥ vedyāḥ iti jñāna viṣayāḥ iti iti śabdaḥ hetu arthakaḥ vedya tvāt kāraṇāt iti arthaḥ bhāvānām padārthānām pratyakṣa prabhṛti miti vargaiḥ sākṣātkāra anumiti śābda ātmaka pramā samūhaiḥ

original: prakaṭitaḥ - pūrvaṃ sanneva prakāśitaḥ | tena vaijñānikatvavyudāsaḥ | vargaśabdena bahūnāmanyathākaraṇamanucitamiti labhyate | svabhāvaḥ - asādhāraṇadharmaḥ | apasarati kiṃ nāpagacchatītyarthaḥ | padārthānāṃ prameyatvādirūpasādhāraṇadharmo na pramāṇasiddhaḥ tattadasādhāraṇadharmaviruddha ityarthaḥ | tathātve’ti
analyzed: prakaṭitaḥ pūrvam san eva prakāśitaḥ tena vaijñānika tva vyudāsaḥ varga śabdena bahūnām anyathā karaṇam anucitam iti labhyate svabhāvaḥ asādhāraṇa dharmaḥ apasarati kim na apagacchati iti arthaḥ padārthānām prameya tva ādi rūpa sādhāraṇa dharmaḥ na pramāṇa siddhaḥ tad tad asādhāraṇa dharma viruddhaḥ iti arthaḥ tathātva iti

original: prasaṅgamāha - svabhāvetyādinā | dhiya ityādiḥ | dhiyo vedyatvaśataḥ - anubhāvyatva yogāt, jñeyatvarūpasādhāraṇadharmayogādityarthaḥ | svabhāvasya - svāsādhāraṇadharmabhūtānubhūtitvasya, pratyāsaḥ - pratikṣepaḥ
analyzed: prasaṅgam āha svabhāva ityādinā dhiyaḥ iti ādiḥ dhiyaḥ vedya tva śataḥ anubhāvya tva yogāt jñeya tva rūpa sādhāraṇa dharma yogāt iti arthaḥ svabhāvasya sva asādhāraṇa dharma bhūta anubhūti tvasya pratyāsaḥ pratikṣepaḥ

original: asu kṣepaṇe iti paṭhitāt pratipūrvāt bhāve ghaña | bhavati yadi - bhavati cedityarthaḥ | jñeyatvarupasādhāraṇadharmo’nubhūtitvarūpāsādhāraṇadharmābhāvavyāpyaścedityarthaḥ | paṭasya pratyakṣasiddhapaṭatvarupāsādhāraṇadharmavataḥ | jñeyatve sati - sādhāraṇāt prameyatvādityarthaḥ | ghaṭavat - prameyatvadharmayogighaṭavat | apaṭatvaṃ paṭatvābhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kṣepaṇe iti paṭhitāt prati pūrvāt bhāve bhavati yadi bhavati ced iti arthaḥ jñeya tva rupa sādhāraṇa dharmaḥ nubhūti tva rūpa asādhāraṇa dharma abhāva vyāpyaḥ ced iti arthaḥ paṭasya pratyakṣa siddha paṭa tva rupa asādhāraṇa dharmavataḥ jñeya tve sati sādhāraṇāt prameya tvāt iti arthaḥ ghaṭa vat prameya tva dharma yogi ghaṭa vat apaṭa tvam paṭa tva abhāvaḥ

original: arthābhāve’vyayībhāvaḥ | prasajati - āpadyate | jñeyatvasya ghaṭe paṭatvābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyamātreṇa paṭe’pi tatsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratyakṣaviruddhamityarthaḥ | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ - dhūmānumitasya parvatīyavahnerjñeyatvāt parvatīyavahnitvābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | kalpyāpūrvasya vāde tasya jñeyatvādapūrvatvābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: artha abhāve avyayībhāvaḥ prasajati āpadyate jñeya tvasya ghaṭe paṭa tva abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇya mātreṇa paṭe api tad sāmānādhikaraṇyam pratyakṣa viruddham iti arthaḥ idam upalakṣaṇam dhūma anumitasya parvatīya vahneḥ jñeya tvāt parvatīya vahni tva abhāva prasaṅgaḥ kalpya apūrvasya vāde tasya jñeya tvāt apūrva tva abhāva prasaṅgaḥ

original: śabdaikavedyasya svargasya prameyatvāt svargatvābhāvaprasaṅgaścetyapi bodhyam | pratyakṣaprabhṛtimitivargetyuktatvāt | evaṃ ca ghaṭādāvanubhāvyatvasyānubhūtitvābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyamātreṇa svaprakāśāyāmanubhūtāvapi anubhāvyatvenānubhūtitvābhāvaḥ pratyakṣabādhita iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: śabda eka vedyasya svargasya prameya tvāt svarga tva abhāva prasaṅgaḥ ca iti api bodhyam pratyakṣa prabhṛti miti varga iti ukta tvāt evam ca ghaṭa ādau anubhāvya tvasya anubhūti tva abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇya mātreṇa sva prakāśāyām anubhūtau api anubhāvya tvena anubhūti tva abhāvaḥ pratyakṣa bādhitaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: ghaṭādau tvajñānāvirodhitvamevānubhūtitvābhāvaprayojakaṃ, nānubhāvyatvam | tadidaṃ bhāṣitaṃ bhagavatā eva tarhyajñānāvirodhitvamevānanubhūtitvanibandhanaṃ, nānubhāvyatvamityā sthīyatām iti | ato’nubhāvyatvānanubhūtitvayorna vyāptiriti hṛdayam || 60 ||
analyzed: ghaṭa ādau tu ajñāna avirodhi tvam eva anubhūti tva abhāva prayojakam na anubhāvya tvam tat idam bhāṣitam bhagavatā eva tarhi ajñāna avirodhi tvam eva ananubhūti tva nibandhanam na anubhāvya tvam iti ā sthīyatām iti atas anubhāvya tva ananubhūti tvayoḥ na vyāptiḥ iti hṛdayam 60

original: pratyakṣādipramāṇasvarasagatihatiḥ ityatrādiśabdavivakṣitānumānāsvārasyamuktaṃ dṛśyatvādanṛtam ityādinā | atra tadbrādhaśca bhūyān ityuktaṃ vivṛṇoti - prakāśa ityādi
analyzed: pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa sva rasa gati hatiḥ iti atra ādi śabda vivakṣita anumāna asvārasyam uktam dṛśya tvāt anṛtam ityādinā atra tad brādhaḥ ca bhūyān iti uktam vivṛṇoti prakāśaḥ ityādi

original: prakāśaḥ kumbhādau jāḍimavati tadgocaramitistirodhiścaitasyā viratirajaḍe brahmaṇi punaḥ |
analyzed: prakāśaḥ kumbha ādau jāḍimavati tad gocara mitiḥ tirodhiḥ ca etasyāḥ viratiḥ ajaḍe brahmaṇi punar

original: svarūpaṃ cinmātraṃ sphuraṇamapidhiśca svanidhanaṃ
analyzed: svarūpam cit mātram sphuraṇam apidhiḥ ca sva nidhanam

original: jaḍaṃ vā brahma syādapidhividhuraṃ vāpyaparathā || 61 ||
analyzed: jaḍam vā brahma syāt apidhi vidhuram vā api aparathā

original: brahmasvarūpasya nityatvanirviśeṣatvasvaprakāśatvāni, bhāvarūpājñānena tirodhānaṃ, jñānena tannivṛttiśca mṛṣāvādibhirabhyupagatāni | tatrānyonyaṃ dharmāṇāṃ vyāhatirucyati -
analyzed: brahma svarūpasya nitya tva nirviśeṣa tva sva prakāśa tvāni bhāva rūpa ajñānena tirodhānam jñānena tad nivṛttiḥ ca mṛṣāvādibhiḥ abhyupagatāni tatra anyonyam dharmāṇām vyāhatiḥ ucyati

original: prakāśaḥ kumbhādāvityādinā | jāḍimavati - jaḍatvavati, niyataparaprakāśyatvavati | kumbhādau - ghaṭādau | prakāśaḥ - bhāti prakāśate iti vyavahāraviṣayo dharmaḥ | tadgocaramitiḥ - tadviṣayakajñānaṃ bhavati | kumbhādau tirodhiśca ghaṭādiniṣṭhaṃ tirohitatvaṃ tu, na prakāśata iti vyavahāraviṣayabhūtaṃ tirohitatvaṃ | etasyāḥ - ghaṭādigocarabuddheḥ |
analyzed: prakāśaḥ kumbha ādau ityādinā jāḍimavati jaḍa tvavati niyata para prakāśya tvavati kumbha ādau ghaṭa ādau prakāśaḥ bhāti prakāśate iti vyavahāra viṣayaḥ dharmaḥ tad gocara mitiḥ tad viṣayaka jñānam bhavati kumbha ādau tirodhiḥ ca ghaṭa ādi niṣṭham tirohita tvam tu na prakāśate iti vyavahāra viṣaya bhūtam tirohita tvam etasyāḥ ghaṭa ādi gocara buddheḥ

original: viratiḥ - abhāvo bhavatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ prakāśatirodhānasvarūpaṃ darśitam | atra ca ghaṭādisvarūpātiriktatvāttadabhāvarupaṃ tattirodhānaṃ na tatsvarūpanāśātmakamiti vakṣyamāṇārthavaiṣamyamuktaṃ bhavati | astvevaṃ tataḥ kimityatrāha - ajaḍa ityādi | ajaḍesvaprakāśe | brahmaṇi punaḥ - brahmaṇi viṣaye tu |
analyzed: viratiḥ abhāvaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ evam prāmāṇikam ghaṭa ādīnām prakāśa tirodhāna svarūpam darśitam atra ca ghaṭa ādi svarūpa atirikta tvāt tad abhāva rupam tat tirodhānam na tad svarūpa nāśa ātmakam iti vakṣyamāṇa artha vaiṣamyam uktam bhavati astu evam tatas kim iti atra āha ajaḍe ityādi ajaḍe svaprakāśe brahmaṇi punar brahmaṇi viṣaye tu

original: cideva cinmātraṃ - svarūpātiriktaprakāśādidharmaśūnyam | svarūpaṃ - dharmisvarūpam | sphuraṇaṃ - prakāśa, bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | apidhiśca apidhānaṃ ca, tirodhānaṃ tvityarthaḥ | apipūrvakāddadhāteḥ upasarge ghoḥ kipratyayaḥ | svanidhanaṃ - svarūpanāśa eva, atra syāditi śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: cit eva cit mātram svarūpa atirikta prakāśa ādi dharma śūnyam svarūpam dharmi svarūpam sphuraṇam prakāśa bhavati iti śeṣaḥ apidhiḥ ca apidhānam ca tirodhānam tu iti arthaḥ api pūrvakāt dadhāteḥ upasarge ghoḥ kipratyayaḥ sva nidhanam svarūpa nāśaḥ eva atra syāt iti śeṣaḥ

original: prakāśasya svarūparūpatvāttirodhānaṃ tannāśa eva syāditi nityatvādīnāṃ mitho vyāghāta iti bhāvaḥ | prakāśaikasvarūpasya prakāśatirodhānaṃ prakāśanāśa eva iti ca bhagavatā bhāṣitam | jaṅaṃ vetyādi | aparathā - brahmaṇaḥsvarūpātiriktajñānaviṣayatvābhyupagame;
analyzed: prakāśasya svarūpa rūpa tvāt tirodhānam tad nāśaḥ eva syāt iti nitya tva ādīnām mithas vyāghātaḥ iti bhāvaḥ prakāśa eka svarūpasya prakāśa tirodhānam prakāśa nāśaḥ eva iti ca bhagavatā bhāṣitam jaṅam vā ityādi aparathā brahmaṇaḥ svarūpa atirikta jñāna viṣaya tva abhyupagame

original: svarūpātiriktaprakāśasya nityasphuraṇābhyupagame ca, krameṇa brahma jaḍaṃ vā syāt, apidhividhuraṃ vā syāt - ghaṭādivat jaḍatvaprasaṅgo vā, tiroghānābhāvaprasaṅgo vā brahmaṇa iti bhāvaḥ | tirodhānasya nivartakānupapattinivṛttyanupapattyoḥ, api śabdena sūcanam | atra ca jñānarūpaṃ paraṃ brahma ityādikamanusandheyam |
analyzed: svarūpa atirikta prakāśasya nitya sphuraṇa abhyupagame ca krameṇa brahma jaḍam vā syāt apidhi vidhuram vā syāt ghaṭa ādi vat jaḍa tva prasaṅgaḥ vā tiroghāna abhāva prasaṅgaḥ vā brahmaṇaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tirodhānasya nivartaka anupapatti nivṛtti anupapattyoḥ api śabdena sūcanam atra ca jñāna rūpam param brahma iti ādikam anusandheyam

original: tiraśśabdasyānupasargatve’pi bāhulakaḥ kipratyaya iti vā, sarvadhātubhya in iti inpratyayasya bāhulakaṃ kitvamiti vā dhātunirdeśe ikpratyayaḥ | dadhāteścārthalakṣakatvamiti vā samādheyam | tirodhipadasādhutvamityāhuḥ | prayuktaṃ ca bhagavadyāmunapādaiḥ - svayāthātmyaṃ prakṛtyāsya tirodhiḥśaraṇāgatiḥ iti || 61 ||
analyzed: tiras śabdasya an upasarga tve pi bāhulakaḥ kipratyayaḥ iti vā sarva dhātubhyaḥ in iti in pratyayasya bāhulakam ki tvam iti vā dhātu nirdeśe ik pratyayaḥ dadhāteḥ ca artha lakṣaka tvam iti vā samādheyam tirodhi pada sādhu tvam iti āhuḥ prayuktam ca bhagavat yāmuna pādaiḥ sva yāthātmyam prakṛtyā asya tirodhiḥ śaraṇa āgatiḥ iti

original: ācchādanaṃ vikṣepaśceti kṛtyadvayamavidyāyā brahmaṇi mṛṣāvādibhiruktam | tatrācchādanāṃśaḥ pūrvatra dūṣitaḥ | vikṣepāṃśo’tra dūṣyate | vikṣepāścādhyāsaḥ | sa cātadūpāropaḥ | tasyātra svarūpanivṛttyorasiddhirucyate -
analyzed: ācchādanam vikṣepaḥ ca iti kṛtya dvayam avidyāyāḥ brahmaṇi mṛṣāvādibhiḥ uktam tatra ācchādana aṃśaḥ pūrvatra dūṣitaḥ vikṣepa aṃśaḥ utra dūṣyate vikṣepāḥ ca adhyāsaḥ sa ca a tad ūpa āropaḥ tasya atra svarūpa nivṛttyoḥ asiddhiḥ ucyate

original: purovartidravyasphuraṇamapi rūpyabhramasahaṃ
analyzed: purovarti dravya sphuraṇam api rūpya bhrama saham

original: na śuktitvasphūrtirbhramavihataye yā prabhavati |
analyzed: na śukti tva sphūrtiḥ bhrama vihataye yā prabhavati

original: yadi brahma prāgvanna khalu jagadadhyāsaviratiḥ
analyzed: yadi brahma prāgvat na khalu jagat adhyāsa viratiḥ

original: kva sidhyedadhyāso yadi bhavati śuktitvasadṛśam || 62 ||
analyzed: kva sidhyet adhyāsaḥ yadi bhavati śukti tva sadṛśam

original: puro vartata iti purovartti | supyajatau iti ṇiniḥ | purovartinaḥ dravyasya śuktyādidravyasya, sphuraṇaṃ idaṃtva śuktitvā)dinā grahaṇam | rūpyabhramasahaṃ - rajatabhramāvirodhi | pratyuta tadupayogītyarthaḥ | api śabdastu sphuraṇabhramayoḥ samānaviśeṣyakatvaprayuktavirodhasūcakaḥ | sa ca virodhasphuraṇasyāsādhāraṇadharmāviṣayakatvena parihṛtaḥ |
analyzed: puras vartate iti purovartti iti ṇiniḥ purovartinaḥ dravyasya śukti ādi dravyasya sphuraṇam idaṃtva śukti tva ādinā grahaṇam rūpya bhrama saham rajata bhrama avirodhi pratyuta tad upayogi iti arthaḥ api śabdaḥ tu sphuraṇa bhramayoḥ samāna viśeṣyaka tva prayukta virodha sūcakaḥ sa ca virodha sphuraṇasya asādhāraṇa dharma aviṣayaka tvena parihṛtaḥ

original: na śuktitvetyādi | śuktitvasphūrtiḥ - śuktyasādhāraṇaśuktitvasphuraṇam | na rūpyabhramasahaṃ - rajatabhramavirodhītyarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha - bhrameti | yā - śuktitvasphūrtiḥ | bhramavihataye - rajatabhramanivṛttaye, anutpādāya prabhavati - śaktetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: na śukti tva ityādi śukti tva sphūrtiḥ śukti asādhāraṇa śukti tva sphuraṇam na rūpya bhrama saham rajata bhrama virodhi iti arthaḥ kutas iti atra āha bhrama iti yā śukti tva sphūrtiḥ bhrama vihataye rajata bhrama nivṛttaye anutpādāya prabhavati śaktā iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca sādhāraṇākāragraho bhramotpādakaḥ, asādhāraṇākāragrahastu tadvirodhīti sarva siddhamityarthaḥ | tayordvayorapi brahmaviṣayakatve’niṣṭamāha - yadītyādinā | brahma - svaprakāśaikarasaṃ brahma | prāgvadyadi - pūrvārdhe prathamopāttapurovartidravyasphuraṇasadṛśaṃ cedbhramahetudharmigraharūpaṃ cet |
analyzed: tathā ca sādhāraṇa ākāra grahaḥ bhrama utpādakaḥ asādhāraṇa ākāra grahaḥ tu tad virodhi iti sarva siddham iti arthaḥ tayoḥ dvayoḥ api brahma viṣayaka tvena iṣṭam āha yadi ityādinā brahma sva prakāśa ekarasam brahma prāgvat yadi pūrva ardhe prathama upātta purovarti dravya sphuraṇa sadṛśam ced bhrama hetu dharmi graha rūpam ced

original: tadā jagadadhyāsaviratiḥ na khalu prapañcabhramanivṛttirna syāt | bhramahetujñānasya tadanivartakatvādityarthaḥ | tathā cānirmokṣaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | brahma śuktitvasadṛśaṃ yadi bhavati - asādhāraṇadharmabhūtaśuktitvagrahatulyaṃ cet , bhramavirodhigraharūpaṃ cet | adhyāsaḥ - prapañcabhramaḥ kva sidhyet pratibandhakasattvānnotpadyetetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tadā jagat adhyāsa viratiḥ na khalu prapañca bhrama nivṛttiḥ na syāt bhrama hetu jñānasya tad anivartaka tvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ brahma śuktitva sadṛśam yadi bhavati asādhāraṇa dharma bhūta śuktitva graha tulyam ced bhrama virodhi graha rūpam ced adhyāsaḥ prapañca bhramaḥ kva sidhyet pratibandhaka sattvāt na utpadyeta iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca pratyakṣavirodha ityarthaḥ | brahmasvarūpaṃ na svarūpato’dhyāsavirodhi, kiṃ tvaparokṣavṛttyavacchinnamityetattu na saṃbhavati | viṣayabhedābhāvāt | brahmasvarupāviṣayīkṛtāparokṣavṛttyavacchinnatadviṣayīkṛtaḥ kaścidākāro’sti vā na vā ādye brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣatvam, antye svarūpasyaiva nivartakatvamityādikaṃ tu vedāntavijayādiṣu draṣṭavyam ||
analyzed: tathā ca pratyakṣa virodhaḥ iti arthaḥ brahma svarūpam na svarūpatā udhyāsa virodhi kim tu aparokṣa vṛtti avacchinnam iti etat tu na saṃbhavati viṣaya bheda abhāvāt kaścid ākāraḥ asti vā na vā ādye brahmaṇaḥ sa viśeṣa tvam antye svarūpasya eva nivartaka tvam iti ādikam tu vedāntavijaya ādiṣu draṣṭavyam

original: brahmaṇi acetanādhyāsaḥ cetanādhyāsaśceti adhyāsadvayaṃ tanmate svīkṛtam | tatra ghaṭapaṭādhyāso’cetanādhyāsaḥ
analyzed: brahmaṇi acetana adhyāsaḥ cetanā adhyāsaḥ ca iti adhyāsa dvayam tad mate svīkṛtam tatra ghaṭa paṭa adhyāsa ucetana adhyāsaḥ

original: | kartṛtvamoktṛtvādiyūktapuruṣādhyāsastu cetanādhyāsaḥ | tatrācidadhyāsaḥ na khalu jagadadhyāsaviratiḥ iti pūrvatra dūṣitaḥ | atra tu kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādiyuktajīvādhyāsānupapattistannivṛttyanupapattiścocyate -
analyzed: kartṛ tva moktṛ tva ādi yūkta puruṣa adhyāsaḥ tu cetanā adhyāsaḥ tatra acit adhyāsaḥ na khalu jagat adhyāsa viratiḥ iti pūrvatra dūṣitaḥ atra tu kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva ādi yukta jīva adhyāsa anupapattiḥ tad nivṛtti anupapattiḥ ca ucyate

original: idaṃ māyāvāde vividhamuditaṃ dūṣaṇamiha
analyzed: idam māyā vāde vividham uditam dūṣaṇam iha

original: svayaṃjyotirbrahma vyapagataviśeṣaṃ yadi katham |
analyzed: svayam jyotiḥ brahma vyapagata viśeṣam yadi katham

original: mate tasminnaramaddṛśi tu saviśeṣaḥ puruṣa ityatadrūpāropastaduparatirityādi ghaṭate || 63 ||
analyzed: mate tasmin aramat dṛśi tu sa viśeṣaḥ puruṣaḥ iti a tad rūpa āropaḥ tad uparatiḥ ityādi ghaṭate 63

original: vyā - iha mate - māyāvādapakṣe brahma, svayaṃjyotiḥ vyapagataviśeṣaṃ yadi - nirviśeṣasvaprakāśarūpaṃ cet | tadā asmaddṛśi tasmin - asmatpratyaye nirviśeṣasvaprakāśasvarūpe brahmaṇi | asmatpratyayagocare viṣayiṇi iti hi taduktiḥ | tuśabdo’dhiṣṭhānatvopayuktadharmaśūnyatvadyotakaḥ | saviśeṣaḥ -; viṣayatayā kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādidharmayuktaḥ |
analyzed: iha mate māyā vāda pakṣe brahma svayaṃjyotiḥ vyapagata viśeṣam yadi nirviśeṣa sva prakāśa rūpam ced tadā asmad dṛśi tasmin asmad pratyaye nirviśeṣa sva prakāśa svarūpe brahmaṇi asmad pratyaya gocare viṣayiṇi iti hi tad uktiḥ tuśabdaḥ udhiṣṭhāna tva upayukta dharma śūnyatva dyotakaḥ sa viśeṣaḥ viṣayatayā kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva ādi dharma yuktaḥ

original: puruṣa ityatadrūpāropaḥ - puruṣa iti yadatadrūpaṃ puruṣatvarūpaṃ yadadhiṣṭhānabhūtabrahmasvarūpāvṛttirūpadharmaḥ tasyāropo’dhyāsaḥ | taduparatiḥ - tannivṛttiḥ | ityādi - tatprabhṛti pūrvoktaṃ sarvam | kathaṃ ghaṭate - kathamupapadyate |
analyzed: puruṣaḥ iti a tad rūpa āropaḥ puruṣaḥ iti yat a tad rūpam puruṣa tva rūpam yad adhiṣṭhāna bhūta brahma svarūpa āvṛtti rūpa dharmaḥ tasya āropaḥ dhyāsaḥ tad uparatiḥ tad nivṛttiḥ ityādi tad prabhṛti pūrva uktam sarvam katham ghaṭate katham upapadyate

original: brahmaṇo nirviśeṣatvena sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇadharmadvayābhāvāt, svaprakāśaikasvarūpatvena tayoḥ sphūrtyasphūrtyorabhāvācca na bhramasaṃbhavaḥ | saṃbhave vā na tannivṛttiḥ; tadavirodhinastannivartakatvāyogāt | na ca vaiśadyasyādhyāsanivartakatvaṃ yuktam | tasya jaḍatvenānivartakatvāt | jñānamevājñānanivartakamiti yuṣmābhirupagamāt |
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ nirviśeṣa tvena sādhāraṇa asādhāraṇa dharma dvaya abhāvāt sva prakāśa eka svarūpa tvena tayoḥ sphūrti asphūrtyoḥ abhāvāt ca na bhrama saṃbhavaḥ saṃbhave vā na tad nivṛttiḥ tad avirodhinaḥ tad nivartaka tva ayogāt na ca vaiśadyasya adhyāsa nivartaka tvam yuktam tasya jaḍa tvena anivartaka tvāt jñānam eva ajñāna nivartakam iti yuṣmābhiḥ upagamāt

original: tanmātraviṣayakajñāsyaiva nivartakatve ca tasyānāditvādanādinivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ | svamātrasākṣijñānasya ca nivartakatve tasyotpādyatvaprasaṅgaḥ | svamātrasākṣitvasya cotpādyatve tasyaiva nivartakatvaprasaṅgaḥ | svamātrasākṣitvasya nivartakatāvacchedakatvamapyayuktam |
analyzed: tanmātra viṣayaka jñā asya eva nivartaka tve ca tasya anādi tvāt anādi nivṛtti prasaṅgaḥ sva mātra sākṣi jñānasya ca nivartaka tve tasya utpādya tva prasaṅgaḥ sva mātra sākṣi tvasya ca utpādya tve tasya eva nivartaka tva prasaṅgaḥ sva mātra sākṣi tvasya nivartaka tā avacchedaka tvam api ayuktam

original: śuktyādijñānasyādhiṣṭhānātiriktaviṣayasyāpi nivartakatvadarśanādikaṃ caṇḍamārutādāvanusandheyam ||
analyzed: śukti ādi jñānasya adhiṣṭhāna atirikta viṣayasya api nivartaka tva darśana ādikam caṇḍa māruta ādau anusandheyam

original: tasminnasmaddṛśi tvityasyaivaṃ vārthaḥ | tuśabdaścakārārthakaḥ | tasmin nirviśeṣasvaprakāśe brahmaṇi | asmaddṛśi ca asmatpratītiviṣaye ahaṃkārākhyadravye ca | saviśeṣaḥ - kartṛtvādiviṣayakaḥ | puruṣa ityatadrūpāropaḥ jīvādhyāsa ityādyayaṃ bhāvaḥ | na tāvadantaḥ karaṇe citpratibimbāt kartṛtvādiyuktajīvasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: tasmin asmad dṛśi tu iti asya evam vā arthaḥ tuśabdaḥ cakāra arthakaḥ tasmin nirviśeṣa sva prakāśe brahmaṇi asmad dṛśi ca asmad pratīti viṣaye ahaṃkāra ākhya dravye ca sa viśeṣaḥ kartṛ tva ādi viṣayakaḥ puruṣaḥ iti a tad rūpa āropaḥ jīva adhyāsaḥ ityādi ayam bhāvaḥ na tāvat antar karaṇe cit pratibimbāt kartṛ tva ādi yukta jīva siddhiḥ

original: cito nirviśeṣatvena tatra kartṛtvādyabhāvāt nīrūpatvena pratibimbāsaṃbhavācca | nāpi citsvarūpe’ntaḥkaraṇapratibimbāt kartṛtvādiviśiṣṭajīvasiddhiḥ | antaḥkaraṇasyācetanatvena (kartṛ) kartṛtvādyabhāvāt | na ca jñātṛtvakartṛtvādiśūnyasya jñānasyāntaḥkaraṇe pratibimbājjīvasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: citaḥ nirviśeṣa tvena tatra kartṛ tva ādi abhāvāt nīrūpa tvena pratibimba asaṃbhavāt ca nā api cit svarūpe ntaḥkaraṇa pratibimbāt kartṛ tva ādi viśiṣṭa jīva siddhiḥ antaḥkaraṇasya acetana tvena kartṛ kartṛ tva ādi abhāvāt na ca jñātṛ tva kartṛ tva ādi śūnyasya jñānasya antaḥkaraṇe pratibimbāt jīva siddhiḥ

original: jñānasyācākṣuṣatvena pratibimbāsaṃbhavāditi atadrūpāropaḥ taduparatirityādi ghaṭata itīdaṃ vividhaṃ māyāvāde dūṣaṇamuditam uktamiti māyāvāda ityupakrāntavistaro nigamitaḥ || 63 ||
analyzed: jñānasya acākṣuṣa tvena pratibimba asaṃbhavāt iti a tad rūpa āropaḥ tad uparatiḥ ityādi ghaṭate iti idam vividham māyā vāde dūṣaṇam uditam uktam iti māyā vādaḥ iti upakrānta vistaraḥ nigamitaḥ

original: avaṃ - nanu bhavatpakṣe kṣetrajñānāṃ nityaṃ sphuraṇamasti tathā ca teṣāṃ svarūpatirodhānena vinā na dehātmabhrama iti tulyānupapattirityatrāha -
analyzed: nanu bhavat pakṣe kṣetrajñānām nityam sphuraṇam asti tathā ca teṣām svarūpa tirodhānena vinā na deha ātma bhramaḥ iti tulya anupapattiḥ iti atra āha

original: adhiṣṭhāne puṃsi svayamahamiti sphurjati vapuḥ -
analyzed: adhiṣṭhāne puṃsi svayam aham iti sphurjati vapuḥ

original: prakārādhyāropaḥ paśurahamahaṃ mānuṣa iti |
analyzed: prakāra adhyāropaḥ paśuḥ aham aham mānuṣaḥ iti

original: aṇutvādau dehavyatikaravidūre ca vihite
analyzed: aṇu tva ādau deha vyatikara vidūre ca vihite

original: tirodhiḥ sakoco nanu bhavati tadgocaradhiyaḥ || 64 ||
analyzed: tirodhiḥ sa kocaḥ nanu bhavati tad gocara dhiyaḥ

original: puṃsi - kṣetrajñātmani | adhiṣṭhāne viśeṣye, jīvātmarūpe bhramaghamiṃṇi | ahamiti svayaṃ sphurjati - ahamiti svataḥprakāśamāne satītyarthaḥ | ṭuosphūrjā vajranirghoṣa iti paṭhitāt laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ | svayaṃprakāśatvaprayuktātmasphuraṇasyātyantadārḍhyadyotanāya vajranirghoṣatvavyapadeśaḥ |
analyzed: puṃsi kṣetrajña ātmani adhiṣṭhāne viśeṣye jīvātma rūpe bhrama ghamiṃṇi aham iti svayam sphurjati aham iti svatas prakāśamāne sati iti arthaḥ vajra nirghoṣaḥ iti paṭhitāt laṭaḥ svayaṃprakāśa tva prayukta ātma sphuraṇasya atyanta dārḍhya dyotanāya vajra nirghoṣa tva vyapadeśaḥ

original: etenātmano jaḍatvaṃ nirastam atra ca bhramāpekṣitādhiṣṭhānasphūrtirūktā | bhramavirodhidharmāsphūrtimāha - aṇutvetyādinā | dehavyatikaraḥ - dehātmanoritaretaratādātmyabhramaḥ, vidūro nirvartyo yasya tathokte |

original: ""so’ntarādantaraṃ prāviśat"" ityuktatvena prahṇādavāmadevādivat svaśarīrakaparamātmana eva svaprayuktāhamādipadajanyabodhaviśeṣyatvā(tsvo)ktapāramyaṃ tatraiva bhaviṣyatīti buddhyā rudro ""nānyaḥ kaścit" ityādikamuktavānityarthaḥ | āhetyuvācetyarthakamavyayam | bravītyarthakaṃ laḍantaṃ vā | pṛcchati - kathamudbhavatīti | atra viṣṇurityanuṣajyate |

original: bhasmadravyavidhānaṃ cetyevamādi kathamupapadyata iti praśnārthaḥ | tasyottaraṃ - nīyatāmiti; "tataḥ" ityasyāvadhiparatvābhāvena hetuparatayā, ""tasmin yadantaḥ"" ityasya ""etāṃśca satyān kāmān"" ityuktaguṇāṣṭakaparatayā, rudrādināmanirvacanasyoparitanavidyāṅgabhūtapraṇavaviṣayatayā, bhasmavidhānasya paśupatiśarīrakabhagavadupāsanāṅgatayā ca

original: | kiṃcit - ekam | yat hṛtpadme hṛdayapuṇḍarīke | upāsyaṃ syādityagāyi - anveṣṭavyatayā vihitam | gāyateḥ karmaṇi luṅi ciṇ | "tadanveṣṭavyam"iti śrutau tavyapratyayānusāreṇāstikriyāyā liṅntapadādhyāhāra ucita iti pradarśanāya syādityuktam | evaṃ "athayadidam"ityādivākye śaṅkāhetubhiḥ saha paraśaṅkitārthasya dharmī nirdiṣṭaḥ | atha tasya dharmiṇaḥ

original: tatratyapraśnaprativacanavivaraṇaṃ ca mahācāryaiḥ kṛtam - "taṃ cet brūyuryadidamasmin brahmapure daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ veśma daharo’sminnantarākāśaḥ kiṃ tadatra vidyate yadanveṣṭavyaṃ yadvāva vijijñāsitavyam"iti codyagarbha evāyaṃ praśnaḥ | anyathā yadidamityādyanuvādavaiyarthyāt | ataḥ sūkṣmatvāddaharākāśe kiṃ vartitumarhatīti praśnābhiprāyaḥ |

original: evaṃ sati kimiti svaramataḥ pratīyamānadharmipraśnarūpatāpyujjīvitā | "yāvān vā ayamākāśastāvāneṣo’ntarhṛdaya ākāśaḥ"iti hetvasiddhyā codyasya pārihāra uktaḥ | tāvānityuktyā paricchedaśaṅkāyām

original: "ubhe asmin dyāvāpṛthivī"ityādinā sarvādhāratvoktyā pūrvavākyasyāparicchede tātparyaṃ vyañjitam | evaṃ codye niraste "asmin kāmāḥ samāhitāḥ"iti praśnasyottaramuktam | anantaram "ātmāpahatapāpmā"ityādinā kāmān vavṛtya "atha ya ihātmānamanuvidya vrajantyetāṃśca satyān kāmān" iti satyapadena dyāvāpṛthivyādayo vyāvartitāḥ"iti ||

original: tadidaṃ pariṣkṛtamadvaitavidyāvijayavyākhyāyāṃ vīrarādhavagurubhiḥ - "nityasiddhaṃ cāpahatapāpmatvaṃ vyadhikaraṇānavacchinnaviṣayatāsaṃbandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākaḥ pāpmābhāvaḥ | tasya cāvirbhāvatirobhāvau pratiyogisāmānādhikaraṇyatadasāmānādhikaraṇye | athavā apahatapāpmatvaṃ pāpakāraṇasamavadhānakālīnapāpānutpādaprayojakībhūtadharmaḥ |
analyzed: tat idam pariṣkṛtam advaitavidyāvijaya vyākhyāyām vīra rādhava gurubhiḥ nitya siddham ca apahata pāpma tvam vyadhikaraṇa anavacchinna viṣayatā saṃbandha avacchinna pratiyogitākaḥ pāpma abhāvaḥ tasya ca āvirbhāva tirobhāvau pratiyogi sāmānādhikaraṇya tad asāmānādhikaraṇye athavā apahata pāpma tvam pāpa kāraṇa samavadhāna kālīna pāpa anutpāda prayojakībhūta dharmaḥ

original: tasyāvirbhāvaḥ prayojakatāvacchedakadharmavaiśiṣṭyam | niruktānutpādaprayojakaṃ hi caramadehaviyogaprākkālāvacchinneśvarīyabandhasaṃkalpaviṣayatābhāvaviśiṣṭātmatvam | anyathā muktāvaśloṣānupapatteḥ | na ca vidyayā tadupapattiḥ | tasyāḥ prāmādikāghāśleṣamātraprayojakatvāt | nityeśvara sādhāraṇyācca |
analyzed: tasya āvirbhāvaḥ prayojakatā avacchedaka dharma vaiśiṣṭyam nirukta anutpāda prayojakam hi carama deha viyoga prāk kāla avacchinna īśvarīya bandha saṃkalpa viṣayatā bhāva viśiṣṭa ātmatvam anyathā muktau aśloṣa anupapatteḥ na ca vidyayā tad upapattiḥ tasyāḥ prāmādika agha āśleṣa mātra prayojaka tvāt nitya īśvara sādhāraṇyāt ca

original: niruktānutpādasya cācetane bhāvānna viśeṣyavaiyarthyam | satyasaṃkalpatvaṃ ca svaviṣayotpāde prayatnāntarānapekṣapariṇāmayogyadravyāśrayatvam | tacca dravyaṃ saṅkalpajñānameva tasya cāvirbhāvastādṛśāvasthāvaiśiṣṭyam"iti ||

analyzed: puruṣaḥ eva śiva śabda abhidheyaḥ iti anantaram eva vadati mahān prabhuḥ vai puruṣaḥ sattvasya eṣa pravartakaḥ iti atra etad padena śiva śabdaḥ abhihitaḥ pratyabhijñāpitaḥ iti tat tātparyadīpikā sarva ānana śiraḥ grīvaḥ iti atra

analyzed: śvetāśvatara śrutiḥ yat śiva padam agre upariṣṭāt vakti prayuṅkte na sat na ca asat śās iva kevalaḥ iti upariṣṭāt yat śiva padam nirdiśati harau prayuktam śāśvatam śivam sarvaḥ śarvaḥ śivaḥ ityādiṣu sarva saṃhāra kartari bhagavati prayuktam viśva kāraṇa param jagat kāraṇa viṣayam tat śiva padam

original: agre ityatrāpi saṃbadhyate | agre - sṛṣṭeḥ prākkāle | jāgrati ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekam ityuktarītyā svainaiva dhāraṇasāmarthyena brahmeśānādivadapralīnatayā tiṣṭhati | tatraiva hariśabdanirdiṣṭe bhagavatyeva |

original: yuktaṃ bodhakatvātmakasaṃbandharūpayogārhaṃ, yadā tama ityādyukta jagacchūnyatve’pi maṅgalarūpatvaṃ vyañjayituṃ tatraiva prayogārhaṃ, kāraṇatvaśaṅkitadoṣavyāvartanāya vā, tatraiva prayogārhamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yuktam bodhaka tva ātmaka saṃbandha rūpa yoga arham yadā tamaḥ ityādi ukta jagat śūnyatve pi maṅgala rūpatvam vyañjayitum tatra eva prayoga arham kāraṇatva śaṅkita doṣa vyāvartanāya vā tatra eva prayoga arham iti arthaḥ

original: asya śivaśabdasya, kāraṇaviṣayatvādbhagavata eva mahopaniṣadādau kāraṇatvavidhānāt, śivaśabdasya cānyatra bhagavati dṛṣṭaprayogatvāt, prasiddhaśivasya ca saṃhāryatvaśravaṇādbhagavataśca tadabhāvāt, māṅgalyarūpatādivyañjanasya cātrāvaśyakatvāddevatāntararūḍhyā vināpi

original: śivaśabdaprayogabāhulyādayaṃ śivaśabdo bhagavatpara iti bhāvaḥ | nanu śivaśabdaśaktidvayānugrahāya rudrapara evāyaṃ śivaśabda ityatrāha - sādhāraṇyetyādi | hi yasmāt | aupaniṣadā bhāgāḥ mahopaniṣadādyupaniṣadgatapradeśaviśeṣāḥ |
analyzed: śiva śabda prayoga bāhulyāt ayam śiva śabdaḥ bhagavat paraḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu śiva śabda śakti dvaya anugrahāya rudra paraḥ eva ayam śiva śabdaḥ iti atra āha sādhāraṇya ityādi hi yasmāt aupaniṣadāḥ bhāgāḥ mahopaniṣad ādi upaniṣad gata pradeśa viśeṣāḥ

original: tadākāṅkṣiṇaḥ santaḥ - kāraṇatvaśaṅkitadoṣavyāvartanāya,, sarvaśūnyatve’pi maṅgalatvabodhanāya vā sādhāraṇaṃ tacchivapadamākāṅkṣamāṇāḥ santaḥ |
analyzed: tad ākāṅkṣiṇaḥ santaḥ kāraṇatva śaṅkita doṣa vyāvartanāya sarva śūnyatve pi maṅgala tva bodhanāya vā sādhāraṇam tat śiva padam ākāṅkṣamāṇāḥ santaḥ

original: sādhāraṇyavidūraiḥ yogena yodarūḍhyā vā vyaktyantaravācitvarahitaiḥ viṣṇustadāsīt sarvavyāpī sa bhagavān eko ha vai nārāyaṇa āsīt ityādivākyagatai rviṣṇubhagavannārāyaṇādyairāhvayairnāmabhiḥ, puruṣādināmnāmādyaśabdena parigrahaḥ | enaṃ śrutisthaśivaśabdaviṣayatayā pūrvārdhe mayopāttamimaṃ bhagavantaṃ kāraṇamāhuḥ - jagatkāraṇaṃ vidadhati |
analyzed: sādhāraṇya vidūraiḥ yogena vā vyakti antara vācitva rahitaiḥ viṣṇuḥ tadā āsīt sarvavyāpī sa bhagavān ekaḥ ha vai nārāyaṇaḥ āsīt ityādi vākya gataiḥ viṣṇu bhagavat nārāyaṇa ādyaiḥ āhvayaiḥ nāmabhiḥ puruṣa ādi nāmnām ādya śabdena parigrahaḥ enam śruti stha śiva śabda viṣaya tayā pūrva ardhe mayā upāttam imam bhagavantam kāraṇam āhuḥ jagat kāraṇam vidadhati

original: tasmāttacchivapadaṃ tatraiva yuktamityarthaḥ | na tu nārāyaṇādīnāṃ nāmnām anyatra saṃbhavaḥ | anyanāmnāṃ gatirviṣṇureka eva prakīrtitaḥ iti vacanena,
analyzed: tasmāt tat śiva padam tatra eva yuktam iti arthaḥ na tu nārāyaṇa ādīnām nāmnām anyatra saṃbhavaḥ anya nāmnām gatiḥ viṣṇuḥ ekaḥ eva prakīrtitaḥ iti vacanena

original: bhagavāniti śabdo’yam ityādinā, nārāyaṇatvena ca sādhāraṇyavidūratvaṃ viṣṇavādināmnāmavagatam | atra ca śivaśabde rūḍhidvayānugrahe nārāyaṇaśabde lakṣaṇā syāt | śivaśabde viśeṣarūḍhiṃ parityajya sāmānyarūḍhimātrāṅgīkāre tu na kutrāpi lakṣaṇeti viśeṣarūḍhirnānugrāhyā | api ca bahirājyanayānna viśeṣarūḍhiḥ śivaśabdasya |
analyzed: bhagavān iti śabdaḥ yam ityādinā nārāyaṇa tvena ca sādhāraṇya vidūra tvam viṣṇava ādi nāmnām avagatam atra ca śiva śabde rūḍhi dvaya anugrahe nārāyaṇa śabde lakṣaṇā syāt śiva śabde viśeṣa rūḍhim parityajya sāmānya rūḍhi mātra aṅgīkāre tu na kutra api lakṣaṇā iti viśeṣa rūḍhiḥ na anugrāhyā api ca bahis ājya nayāt na viśeṣa rūḍhiḥ śiva śabdasya

original: na caivaṃ sati puruṣaśabde’pi viśeṣarūḍirna syāditi vācyam | tatsaṃjñakatvapramāṇabalena puruṣaśabde viśeṣarūḍhisvīkārāt | nārāyaṇaśabdasya lakṣaṇāprasaṅgādeva īśādiśabdeṣu yaudikeṣvapi vṛttidvayāgraho nirastaḥ | nārāyaṇaśabdasya bhagavato’nyatra yogāṅgīkāre tu ṇatvābhāvaḥ suprasiddhaḥ |
analyzed: na ca evam sati puruṣa śabde api viśeṣa rūḍiḥ na syāt iti vācyam tad saṃjñaka tva pramāṇa balena puruṣa śabde viśeṣa rūḍhi svīkārāt nārāyaṇa śabdasya lakṣaṇā prasaṅgāt eva īśa ādi śabdeṣu yaudikeṣu api vṛtti dvaya āgrahaḥ nirastaḥ nārāyaṇa śabdasya bhagavataḥ nyatra yoga aṅgīkāre tu ṇatva abhāvaḥ su prasiddhaḥ

original: yathākathaṃcit yena kenacidvyutpattiviśeṣeṇa aṇ kyaṅluṭsukṛteṣu ? ityādinā tadupapādane tu manusmṛtyādiprasiddhayogatyāga iti bhāvaḥ | prakārāntareṇa navyotprekṣitaṇatvopapattinirāsaścāsmatkṛtaṇatvatattvaprapañce’nusandheyaḥ |
analyzed: yathā kathaṃcid yena kenacid vyutpatti viśeṣeṇa ityādinā tad upapādane tu manu smṛti ādi prasiddha yoga tyāgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ prakāra antareṇa navya utprekṣita ṇa tva upapatti nirāsaḥ ca asmat kṛta ṇa tva tattva prapañca inusandheyaḥ

original: mahācāryairasya vākyasyārtho’nugṛhītaḥ - yadā tamaḥ tamaḥ pare deva ekībhavati iti avibhaktāvasthaṃ tamaḥ na divādi ca, samastakāryavidhuro bhagavāneva - tattadā - akṣaramiti bhagavataḥ svarūpato vikārābhāvo vidhīyate atra ca śivaśabdena bhagavannirdeśaḥ sarvaśūnyatve’pi maṅgalarūpatvaṃ vyañjayitum | astu vā śivaśabdasyaiva vidhāyakatvam |
analyzed: mahā ācāryaiḥ asya vākyasya arthaḥ anugṛhītaḥ yadā tamaḥ tamaḥ pare devaḥ ekībhavati iti avibhakta avastham tamaḥ na divā ādi ca samasta kārya vidhuraḥ bhagavān eva tat tadā akṣaram iti bhagavataḥ svarūpataḥ vikāra abhāvaḥ vidhīyate atra ca śiva śabdena bhagavat nirdeśaḥ sarva śūnyatve pi maṅgala rūpatvam vyañjayitum astu vā śiva śabdasya eva vidhāyaka tvam

original: athāpi śivaśabdena bhagavata eva kāraṇatayā vidhiḥ syāt | nārāyaṇakāraṇatvavidhyanusārāt | na ca vaiparītyaṃ śaṅkyam | śivādiśabdānāṃ bhagavadabhidhānatvādrūḍhyantaranimajjanasāmānyataravadrūḍhimattvādbhagavati dṛṣṭaprayogatvācceti || 78||
analyzed: atha api śiva śabdena bhagavataḥ eva kāraṇatayā vidhiḥ syāt nārāyaṇa kāraṇatva vidhi anusārāt na ca vaiparītyam śaṅkyam śiva ādi śabdānām bhagavat abhidhāna tvāt rūḍhi antara nimajjana sāmānya tara vat rūḍhimat tvāt bhagavati dṛṣṭa prayoga tvāt ca iti

original: yacchvetāśvatara ityādiślokadvayoktaṃ vivṛṇoti - ( yadagra ityādi)

original: yadagre jāgarti śrutiśivapadaṃ brahma paramaṃ

original: jagaddhetuḥ śvetāśvatarānegamānte sa bhagavān |
analyzed: jagat hetuḥ śvetāśvatara anegama ante sa bhagavān

original: prayukto yattasmin yajuṣi śivaśabdaḥ śrutiśirasyatatsādhāraṇyaṃ na samagaṇi nārāyaṇagiraḥ || 79 ||
analyzed: prayuktaḥ yat tasmin yajuṣi śiva śabdaḥ śrutiśirasi a tad sādhāraṇyam na sama gaṇi nārāyaṇa giraḥ

original: śvetāśvataranigamānte - śvetāśvataropaniṣadi | agre śrutaśivapadam tasmāt sarvagataḥ śivaḥ śiva eva kevalaḥ ityuparitanakhaṇḍayoḥ śivaśabdābhihitam | jagaddhetuḥ - jagatkāraṇabhūtam | yatparamaṃ brahma jāgarti kiṃ kāraṇaṃ brahma udgītametat paramaṃ nu brahma iti vākyayorupakramagatayoḥ pratīyate | saḥ - śvetāśvatare śivaśabdābhihitaṃ brahma |
analyzed: śvetāśvatara nigama ante śvetāśvatara upaniṣadi agre śruta śiva padam tasmāt sarva gataḥ śivaḥ śivaḥ eva kevalaḥ iti uparitana khaṇḍayoḥ śiva śabda abhihitam jagat hetuḥ jagat kāraṇa bhūtam yat paramam brahma jāgarti kim kāraṇam brahma udgītam etat paramam nu brahma iti vākyayoḥ upakrama gatayoḥ pratīyate saḥ śvetāśvatare śiva śabda abhihitam brahma

original: bhagavān sarvavyāpī sa bhagavān puruṣa iti cintyam tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣam ityupakramopasaṃhāramadhyeṣu puruṣabhagavadādiśabdanirdiṣṭo nārāyaṇa eva | vidheyaprādhānyāt sa iti pulliṅgatā | kuta ityatrāha - prayukta ityādi | yat - yasmāt | yajuṣi śrutiśirasi taittirīyake śivaśabdaḥ, tasmin bhagavati |
analyzed: bhagavān sarvavyāpī sa bhagavān puruṣaḥ iti cintyam tam āhuḥ agryam puruṣam iti upakrama upasaṃhāra madhyeṣu puruṣa bhagavat ādi śabda nirdiṣṭaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ eva vidheya prādhānyāt saḥ iti pulliṅgatā kutas iti atra āha prayuktaḥ ityādi yat yasmāt yajuṣi śrutiśirasi taittirīyake śiva śabdaḥ tasmin bhagavati

original: śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam iti prayuktaḥ tataḥ śvetāśvatarasthaśivaśabdābhihito’pi bhagavānevetyarthaḥ | nanu taittirīyakasya kathaṃ bhagavatparatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tiṣṭhantu samudraśāyitvalakṣmīpatitvādiliṅgāni, nārāyaṇaśabdaśrutireva taittirīyakasya bhagavatparatvasādhane paryāptetyāha - atatsādhāraṇyamityādinā | nārāyaṇagiraḥ nārāyaṇaśabdasya |
analyzed: śāśvatam śivam acyutam iti prayuktaḥ tatas śvetāśvatara stha śiva śabda abhihitaḥ api bhagavān eva iti arthaḥ nanu taittirīyakasya katham bhagavat paratvam iti śaṅkāyām tiṣṭhantu samudraśāyi tva lakṣmīpati tva ādi liṅgāni nārāyaṇa śabda śrutiḥ eva taittirīyakasya bhagavat paratva sādhane paryāptā iti āha atatsādhāraṇyam ityādinā nārāyaṇa giraḥ nārāyaṇa śabdasya

original: atatsādhāraṇyaṃ (mateṣu) bhagavadvyatirikteṣu brahmarudrādiṣu sādhāraṇyaṃ bhagavadvṛttitve sati vṛttimattvarūpaṃ sāmānyaśabdatvam | na samagaṇi - nābodhi | atra śrutismṛtivyākaraṇairityādiḥ |
analyzed: atatsādhāraṇyam mateṣu bhagavat vyatirikteṣu brahma rudra ādiṣu sādhāraṇyam bhagavat vṛtti tve sati vṛttimat tva rūpam sāmānya śabda tvam na atra śruti smṛti vyākaraṇaiḥ ityādiḥ

original: mahopaniṣadādyaikārthyānnārāyaṇaśabdasya bahulamabhyāsācca taittirīyaṃ bhagavatparamiti, tatratyaśivaśabdābhidheyo bhagavāneveti, tadaikārthyācchvetāśvatarasthaśabdābhidheyo’pi sa evetyarthaḥ | tadidamuktaṃ mahācāryacaraṇaiḥ - kāraṇaviṣayanārāyaṇaśabdasyeyaṃ niruktiḥ, prakaraṇāt | kāraṇagocaranārāyaṇaśabdasyaiva ca tvayā rudraparatvamiṣyate |
analyzed: mahopaniṣad ādi aikārthyāt nārāyaṇa śabdasya bahulam abhyāsāt ca taittirīyam bhagavat param iti tatratya śiva śabda abhidheyaḥ bhagavān eva iti tad aikārthyāt śvetāśvatara stha śabda abhidheyaḥ api saḥ eva iti arthaḥ tat idam uktam mahā ācārya caraṇaiḥ kāraṇa viṣaya nārāyaṇa śabdasya iyam niruktiḥ prakaraṇāt kāraṇa gocara nārāyaṇa śabdasya eva ca tvayā rudra paratvam iṣyate

original: atastainaiva yogena tatra pravṛtte
analyzed: atas taina eva yogena tatra pravṛtte

original: ṇatvānupapattiranivāryā | na ca tannirukteścaturmukhaparatvaṃ śaṅkārham | aṇḍotpattyanantarotpannasya mahadāditattvakāraṇatvāsaṃbhavāt | mānavavacanavyākhyānaṃ ca vedāntavijaye draṣṭavyam iti || 79 ||
analyzed: ṇatva anupapattiḥ anivāryā na ca tad nirukteḥ caturmukha paratvam śaṅkā arham aṇḍa utpatti anantara utpannasya mahat ādi tattva kāraṇatva asaṃbhavāt mānava vacana vyākhyānam ca vedāntavijaye draṣṭavyam iti

original: itham prastutya ityādicatuḥślokyā śvetāśvataropaniṣado bhagavatparatvamupapāditam | atha yaddevairanuyuktaḥ ityādyekādaśaślokyā atharvaśiraso bhagavatparatvamupapādayati - ( yaddhevairityādi)
analyzed: prastutya ityādi catur ślokyā śvetāśvatara upaniṣadaḥ bhagavat para tvam upapāditam atha yat devaiḥ anuyuktaḥ ityādi ekādaśa ślokyā atharvaśirasaḥ bhagavat para tvam upapādayati yat hevaiḥ ityādi

original: mū yaddevairanuyukta uttaramuśan rudro vivṛtyātmani

original: atra rudravapuṣaḥ puruṣottamasyetyanena "tamīśānaṃ puruṣaṃ devamīḍhyam""buddhyā saṃcintya sthāpayitvā tu rudre"ityanayorvākyayorarthaḥ smāritaḥ || 90 ||

original: evamekādaśabhiḥ ślokairatharvaśiraso bhagavatparatvamupapāditam | athātharvaśikhāyā bhagavatparatvamupapādyate | tatra "straṣṭhṛsṛjyādibhāvaḥ śrautastvatrāpi tulyaḥ"ityatra tuśabdābhipretaṃ bhagavadutpatteravatāratvaṃ vivriyate - ( ātharvaṇyāmityādi)
analyzed: evam ekādaśabhiḥ ślokaiḥ atharvaśirasaḥ bhagavat para tvam upapāditam atha atharvaśikhāyāḥ bhagavat para tvam upapādyate tatra straṣṭhṛ sṛji ādi bhāvaḥ śrautaḥ tu atra api tulyaḥ iti atra tuśabda abhipretam bhagavat utpatteḥ avatāra tvam vivriyate ātharvaṇyām ityādi

original: ātharvaṇyāṃ śikhāyāmagaṇi bhagavato yā janiḥ kāraṇaikadhyeyatvedaṃparāyāṃ jagadupakṛtaye so’yamicchāvatāraḥ |
analyzed: ātharvaṇyām śikhāyām agaṇi bhagavataḥ yā janiḥ kāraṇa eka dhyeya tva idaṃparāyām jagat upakṛtaye saḥ uyam icchāvatāraḥ

original: yadviṣṇoḥ kāraṇaikapravaṇaphaṇitibhiḥ kāraṇatvopadeśaḥ
analyzed: yat viṣṇoḥ kāraṇa eka pravaṇa phaṇitibhiḥ kāraṇa tva upadeśaḥ

original: spaṣṭo dṛṣṭaprayogaḥ suravajanakatayā śambhuśabdo’pi tasmin || 91 ||
analyzed: spaṣṭaḥ dṛṣṭa prayogaḥ surava janaka tayā śambhu śabdaḥ api tasmin

original: atharvaśikhāyāṃ paippalādo’ṅgirāḥ sanatkumāraścātharvāṇamūcuḥ bhagavān
analyzed: atharvaśikhāyām paippalādaḥ uṅgirāḥ sanatkumāraḥ ca atharvāṇam ūcuḥ bhagavān

original: kimādau prayuktā dhyānaṃ dhyāyitavyaṃ kiṃ taddhyānaṃ ko vā dhyātā kaśca dhyeya iti śrūyate | atrādyaḥ praśno dhyānamātraviṣayaḥ ;
analyzed: kimādau prayuktāḥ dhyānam dhyāyitavyam kim tat dhyānam kaḥ vā dhyātā kaḥ ca dhyeyaḥ iti śrūyate atra ādyaḥ praśnaḥ dhyāna mātra viṣayaḥ

original: dvitīyo dhyānābhimānidevatāpraśnaḥ; tṛtīyo dhyātrabhimānidevatāpraśnaḥ; turīyaḥ saviśeṣaṇadhyeyapraśnaḥ | tatrādyapraśnasyottaram omityetadakṣaram ādau prayuktaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyāyitavyamiti; dvitīyasyoktaraṃ sarvakaraṇāni ca manasi saṃpratiṣṭhāpya dhyānaṃ viṣṇuriti;
analyzed: dvitīyaḥ dhyāna abhimāni devatā praśnaḥ tṛtīyaḥ dhyātṛ abhimāni devatā praśnaḥ turīyaḥ sa viśeṣaṇa dhyeya praśnaḥ tatra ādya praśnasya uttaram om iti etat akṣaram ādau prayuktam dhyānam dhyāyitavyam iti dvitīyasya uktaram sarva karaṇāni ca manasi saṃpratiṣṭhāpya dhyānam viṣṇuḥ iti

original: tṛtīyasyottaraṃ manasi saha karaṇaiḥ saṃpratiṣṭhāpya dhyātā rudra iti turīyasyottaramīśānaṃ pradhyāyitavyaṃ sarvamidaṃ brahma viṣṇurudrendrāste sarve saṃprasūyante | sarvāṇi cendriyāṇi saha bhūtairna kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ dhyātā dhātā kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ sarvaiśvaryasaṃpannaḥ sarveśvaraḥ śaṃbhurākāśamadhye dhyeya iti ||
analyzed: tṛtīyasya uttaram manasi saha karaṇaiḥ saṃpratiṣṭhāpya dhyātā rudraḥ iti turīyasya uttaram īśānam pradhyāyitavyam sarvam idam brahma viṣṇu rudra indrāḥ te sarve saṃprasūyante sarvāṇi ca indriyāṇi saha bhūtaiḥ na kāraṇam kāraṇānām dhyātā dhātā kāraṇam tu dhyeyaḥ sarva aiśvarya saṃpannaḥ sarva īśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ ākāśa madhye dhyeyaḥ iti

original: atra mahācāryāḥ - "caturthapraśnasyottaramāha - "īśānaṃ pradhyāyitavyam"iti | "kaśca dhyeyaḥ"iti praśnasārūpyāt pūrvapraśnottaravadidameva caturthapraśnottaram | na tu dhyāyīteśānamiti | praśnavairūpyāt pūrvapraśnottaravairupyācca | īśāna iti pulliṅganirdeśaḥkṛtaḥ | īśitavyaviśeṣānirdeśāt sarveśānaṃ vastu dhyātavyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atra mahācāryāḥ caturtha praśnasya uttaram āha īśānam pradhyāyitavyam iti kaḥ ca dhyeyaḥ iti praśna sārūpyāt pūrva praśna uttara vat idam eva caturtha praśna uttaram na tu dhyāyīta īśānam iti praśna vairūpyāt pūrva praśna uttara vairupyāt ca īśānaḥ iti pulliṅga nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ īśitavya viśeṣa anirdeśāt sarva īśānam vastu dhyātavyam iti arthaḥ

original: pradhāneṣu prādhānyamupāsyasya vaktuṃ brahmādīnāṃ prādhānyamāha - "sarvamidaṃ brahma viṣṇurudrendrāḥ"iti idaṃpramāṇasiddhaṃ sarvamapi brahmaviṣṇurudrendrāḥ rājā rāṣṭramitivannirvāhyanirvāhakabhāvanibandhanaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam | te sarve saṃprasūyanta iti vākyāntaram | evaṃ sati tacchabdasya prayojanalābhaḥ |
analyzed: pradhāneṣu prādhānyam upāsyasya vaktum brahma ādīnām prādhānyam āha sarvam idam brahma viṣṇu rudra indrāḥ iti idam pramāṇa siddham sarvam api brahma viṣṇu rudra indrāḥ rājā rāṣṭram iti vat nirvāhya nirvāhaka bhāva nibandhanam sāmānādhikaraṇyam te sarve saṃprasūyante iti vākya antaram evam sati tad śabdasya prayojana lābhaḥ

original: bhagavataḥ prādhānyaṃ vyañjayitum idamuttaravākye caiṣu bhagavataḥ prasūtyabhāvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāttadvatteṣu tadanyasyāpi kasyacittadāśaṅkā mā bhūditi sarva ityuktam | evaṃ satyeva hyasya prayojanalābhaḥ | na ca sarvamidaṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrendrā ityuktarāśidvayaparāmarśitayā te sarva ityasya prayojanalābhaḥ |
analyzed: bhagavataḥ prādhānyam vyañjayitum idam uttara vākye ca eṣu bhagavataḥ prasūti abhāvasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt tadvat teṣu tad anyasya api kasyacid tad āśaṅkā mā bhūt iti sarve iti uktam evam sati eva hi asya prayojana lābhaḥ na ca sarvam idam brahma viṣṇu rudra indrāḥ iti ukta rāśi dvaya parāmarśi tayā te sarve iti asya prayojana lābhaḥ

original: cakārābhāvena te sarva iti samudāyaparāmarśasyāpekṣitatvāditi vācyam | napuṃsakaśeṣāpatterindriyādisahapāṭhāttatulyā parāyattā prasūtirbrahmāderiti svarasato’vagamyate | bhagavataḥ prasūtiṃ niṣedhati - "na kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ dhyātā dhātā"iti kāraṇānāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye kāraṇaṃ dhyātā dhātā na prasūyata iti vipariṇāmo’nuṣaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: cakāra abhāvena te sarve iti samudāya parāmarśasya apekṣita tvāt iti vācyam napuṃsaka śeṣa āpatteḥ indriya ādi sahapāṭhāt tad tulyā para āyattā prasūtiḥ brahma ādeḥ iti svarasataḥ vagamyate bhagavataḥ prasūtim niṣedhati na kāraṇam kāraṇānām dhyātā dhātā iti kāraṇānām trayāṇām madhye kāraṇam dhyātā dhātā na prasūyate iti vipariṇāmaḥ anuṣaṅgaḥ

original: vipariṇāmenānuṣaṅgaḥ parapakṣe’pi samānaḥ | kāraṇaṃ dhyāteti kāraṇāvasthāyā dhyātṛtvena prasiddha ityavagamyate | tathā prasiddhaśca "bhagavāneva nārāyaṇo’kāmayata" "so’nyaṃ kāmaṃ manasā dhyāyīta"iti dhātṛśabdaśca "aṇoraṇīyān" ityatra bhagavatparatayā śaṅkalikhitoparbṛṃhite prasiddhaḥ | sahastrānāmasu ca "anādinidhano dhātā"iti ||
analyzed: vipariṇāmena anuṣaṅgaḥ para pakṣe api samānaḥ kāraṇam dhyātā iti kāraṇa avasthāyāḥ dhyātṛ tvena prasiddhaḥ iti avagamyate tathā prasiddhaḥ ca bhagavān eva nārāyaṇaḥ ukāmayata saḥ anyam kāmam manasā dhyāyīta eti dhātṛ śabdaḥ ca aṇoḥ aṇīyān iti atra bhagavat para tayā śaṅkalikhita uparbṛṃhite prasiddhaḥ sahastrā nāmasu ca an ādi nidhanaḥ dhātā iti

original: kāraṇamiti śeṣaṣaṣṭhyevāstu | arthāttu nirdhāraṇalābhaḥ | athavā, mā bhūdarthānnirdhāraṇalābhaḥ | viṣṇorapi saṃprasūtireva pratipādyatām | sā ca prasūtiḥ, "ajāyamāno bahudhā vijāyate | tasya dhīrāḥ parijānanti yonim""na sā karmanimittajā""jananaṃ svacchayaiva ca"ityādipratipannā svadhīnā na tu brahmarudrādivat karmādhīnā |
analyzed: kāraṇam iti śeṣa ṣaṣṭhī eva astu arthāt tu nirdhāraṇa lābhaḥ athavā mā bhūt arthāt nirdhāraṇa lābhaḥ viṣṇoḥ api saṃprasūtiḥ eva pratipādyatām sā ca prasūtiḥ ajāyamānaḥ bahudhā vijāyate tasya dhīrāḥ parijānanti sā karma nimitta jā jananam svacchayā eva caitya ādi pratipannā svadhīnā na tu brahma rudra ādi vat karma adhīnā

original: yadvā nātra vipariṇāmaḥ kāryaḥ | nāpi dhātṛśabdasya prasiddhārthatyāgaḥ | dhyātā caturmukho dhyātā rudraśca kāraṇānāṃ kāraṇamityarthaḥ | viṣṇureva kāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ | dhyātā rudra iti prāgabhidhānāt dhātṛdevatā rudro dhyātetyabhidhīyate | yadvā nātra kasyāpyutpattiḥ pratipādyate | saṃprasūyanta iti "ṣūñ preraṇe" iti dhātoḥ karmaṇi lakāre rūpam |
analyzed: yat vā na atra vipariṇāmaḥ kāryaḥ na api dhātṛ śabdasya prasiddha artha tyāgaḥ dhyātā caturmukhaḥ dhyātā rudraḥ ca kāraṇānām kāraṇam iti arthaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva kāraṇam iti bhāvaḥ dhyātā rudraḥ iti prāk abhidhānāt dhātṛ devatā rudraḥ dhyātā iti abhidhīyate yat vā na atra kasya api utpattiḥ pratipādyate saṃprasūyante iti preraṇe iti dhātoḥ karmaṇi lakāre rūpam

original: na tu "ṣañ prāṇiprasave" ityasya" "ṣūñ prāṇigarbhavimocane" ityasya vā tasya prāṇaviṣayatayā sarvāṇi cendriyāṇi saha bhūtairityatrānuṣaṅgiṇo’pyanvayāyogāt | jāyanta ityadhyāhāraprasaṅgāt | īśānaṃ pradhyāyita vyamiti pūrvavākye asaṃkocalabdhasarveśvaratvasya sākṣādupapādakatayā preraṇārthasyaiva dhātoratra grāhyatvācca |
analyzed: na tu prāṇi prasave ityasya prāṇi garbha vimocane iti asya vā tasya prāṇa viṣaya tayā sarvāṇi ca indriyāṇi saha bhūtaiḥ iti atra anuṣaṅgiṇā upi anvaya ayogāt jāyante iti adhyāhāra prasaṅgāt īśānam pūrva vākye asaṃkoca labdha sarva īśvara tvasya sākṣāt upapādaka tayā preraṇa arthasya eva dhātoḥ atra grāhya tvāt ca

original: paramakāraṇabhūto dhyātā dhātā tu na kenacit preryata iti na kāramityādivākyasyārthaḥ | "kaśca dhyeyaḥ"ityatra dhyeyaviśeṣaṇasyāpi vivakṣitatvāt dhyātavyasya hṛdayādhikaraṇaṃ vidadhāti | ""kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ sarvaiśvaryasaṃpannaḥ sarvaiśvaraḥ śaṃbhurākāśamadhye"iti | sarvaiśvaryasaṃpanna ityatra sarvaṃ ca tadaiśvarye ceti karmadhārayaḥ |
analyzed: parama kāraṇa bhūtaḥ dhyātā dhātā tu na kenacid preryate iti na kāram ityādi vākyasya arthaḥ kaḥ ca dhyeyaḥ iti atra dhyeya viśeṣaṇasya api vivakṣita tvāt dhyātavyasya hṛdaya adhikaraṇam vidadhāti kāraṇam tu dhyeyaḥ sarva aiśvarya saṃpannaḥ sarva aiśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ ākāśam adhye iti sarva aiśvarya saṃpannaḥ iti atra sarvam ca tat aiśvarye ca iti karmadhārayaḥ

original: na tu sarvaiśvaraśabdāt ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāt ṣyañ | ādivṛddhiprasaṅgāt | sarvaprakāramīśvaramīśānaṃ vivakṣitam | asti ca niyamane prakārabhedaḥ | yayāntaḥ praviśya niyamanaṃ rājāderiva bahiḥ sthitvā niyamanaṃ dhāraṇapravṛttyādiviṣayaṃ ca sadvāramadvārakaṃ ca | idaṃ ca sarvaprakārakamaiśvaryaṃ na katipayaviṣayamityucyate sarveśvara iti |
analyzed: na tu sarva aiśvara śabdāt ṣaṣṭhī samāsāt ādi vṛddhi prasaṅgāt sarva prakāram īśvaram īśānam vivakṣitam asti ca niyamane prakāra bhedaḥ yayā antar praviśya niyamanam rāja ādeḥ iva bahis sthitvā niyamanam dhāraṇa pravṛtti ādi viṣayam ca sa dvāram advārakam ca idam ca sarva prakārakam aiśvaryam na katipaya viṣayam iti ucyate sarveśvaraḥ iti

original: evaṃ ca sarvaiśvaryasaṃpannasarveśvaraśabdayoraikārthyabhramāt sarvaiśvaraśabde tacchabdavācyalakṣaṇāmāśritya paunaruktyaparihāraḥ kenacit kṛto nirastaḥ | vastuvṛttamuktam tathātve’pi siddhānte na doṣaḥ sarvaiśvaraśabdasya devatāntare rūḍhyasiddheḥ | ihaiva kalpanāyāṃ bhagavatyovāstu |
analyzed: evam ca sarva aiśvarya saṃpanna sarva īśvara śabdayoḥ aikārthya bhramāt sarva aiśvara śabde tad śabda vācya lakṣaṇām āśritya paunaruktya parihāraḥ kenacid kṛtaḥ nirastaḥ vastu vṛttam uktam tathātve pi siddhānte na doṣaḥ sarva aiśvara śabdasya devatā antare rūḍhi asiddheḥ iha eva kalpanāyām

original: atra ca sarvāṇīndriyāṇīti pṛthagindriyagrahaṇamindriyapreraṇarūpam hṛṣīkeśaśabdārthaṃ nārāyaṇatvaliṅgamupasthāpayitum | yadvā "kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ"iti caturthapraśnasyottaram; upoddhātarītyā tadupapādanāya "īśānāṃ pradhyāyitavyam"iti sarveśitureva mokṣapradānasāmarthyattasyaivopāsyatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | "kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ"ityatra kāraṇapadaṃ
analyzed: atra ca sarvāṇi indriyāṇi iti pṛthak indriya grahaṇam indriya preraṇa rūpam hṛṣīkeśa śabda artham nārāyaṇa tva liṅgam upasthāpayitum yat vā kāraṇam tu dhyeyaḥ iti caturtha praśnasya uttaram upoddhāta rītyā tad upapādanāya īśānām pradhyāyitavyam iti sarva īśituḥ eva mokṣa pradāna sāmarthya ttasya eva upāsya tvam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ kāraṇam tu dhyeyaḥ iti atra kāraṇa padam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ kāraṇam tu dhyeyaḥ iti atra kāraṇa padam yuktam

original: sarvakāraṇaparaṃ trimūrtikāraṇaparaṃ vā | bhagavata eva trimūrtikāraṇatvaṃ ca, lubālopaniṣadi kāryeṣu sthitipratipādakaparyāyeṣu trimūrtiṣu sthitiśravaṇāt, paiṅgirahasye - "yamavaruṇaviṣṇurudrendrāḥ"iti śravaṇācca prasiddham | tasmādatra subālopaniṣadi
analyzed: sarva kāraṇa param trimūrti kāraṇa param vā bhagavataḥ eva trimūrti kāraṇa tvam ca lubāla upaniṣadi kāryeṣu sthiti pratipādaka paryāyeṣu trimūrtiṣu sthiti śravaṇāt paiṅgirahasye yama varuṇa viṣṇu rudra indrāḥ iti śravaṇāt ca prasiddham tasmāt atra subāla upaniṣadi

original: prasiddhakāraṇatvānuvādena bhagavata eva dhyātavyatvaṃ vidhīyate | śaṃbhuśabdaścābhidhānakośādiṣu bhagavadabhidhānatayā suprasiddhaḥ | śaṃbhurghātṛharīśeṣvityādinā subālopaniṣattāpanīyādiṣu bhagavati sarvaiśvaratvāvagamāt tatsamānādhikṛtaḥ śambhuśabdo bhagavatpara eva | na tu rudra eva svārasyamiti cet - satyam |
analyzed: prasiddha kāraṇatva anuvādena bhagavataḥ eva dhyātavya tvam vidhīyate śaṃbhu śabdaḥ ca abhidhānakośa ādiṣu bhagavat abhidhānatayā su prasiddhaḥ śaṃbhuḥ ghātṛ hari īśeṣu ityādinā subāla upaniṣad tāpanīya ādiṣu bhagavati sarva aiśvara tva avagamāt tad samāna adhikṛtaḥ śambhu śabdaḥ bhagavat paraḥ eva na tu rudre eva svārasyam iti ced satyam

original: tattu trimūrtyantargata eva tatparigrahaścānupapannaḥ | sṛjyatvānapahatapātmatvayoḥ śravaṇāt | parānabhimataśca tatparigrahaḥ | ato bhagavata eva parigraho yuktaḥ | viṣṇoḥ sargaśravaṇe’pi "ajāyamāno bahudhā vijāyate | tasya dhīrāḥ parijānanti yonim"ityavatāratvāvagamānna sa parādhīna iti vyācaravyuḥ ||
analyzed: tat tu trimūrti antargataḥ eva tad parigrahaḥ ca anupapannaḥ sṛjya tva anapahata pātma tvayoḥ śravaṇāt para anabhimataḥ ca tad parigrahaḥ atas bhagavataḥ eva parigrahaḥ yuktaḥ viṣṇoḥ sarga śravaṇe pi ajāyamānaḥ bahudhā vijāyate tasya dhīrāḥ parijānanti yonim iti avatāra tva avagamāt na sa para adhīnaḥ iti

original: tadidamucyate - ātharvaṇyāmityādinā | kāraṇasya yadekaṃ dhyeyatvaṃ tasminnidaṃparāyāṃ tātparyavatyāṃ, puruṣasūktādiprasiddhakāraṇatvānuvādena dhyātavyatāvidhiparāyāmityarthaḥ | ekaśabdaśca dhyeyatāyāṃ tātparyātirekavyañjanārthaḥ |
analyzed: tat idam ucyate ātharvaṇyām ityādinā kāraṇasya yat ekam dhyeya tvam tasmin idaṃparāyām tātparyavatyām puruṣasūkta ādi prasiddha kāraṇatva anuvādena dhyātavya tā vidhi parāyām iti arthaḥ eka śabdaḥ ca dhyeya tāyām tātparya atireka vyañjana arthaḥ

original: tadāhurbhaṭṭasudarśanapādāḥ - "asya prakaraṇasya "kaśca dhyeyaḥ" ityupakramya "kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeya"ityanena kāraṇatvamanūdya dhyeyavidhiparatvāvagamāt puruṣasūktādipratipannasyaiva bhagavato dhyeyatvavidhānaparamidaṃ vākyam"iti | ātharvaṇyāṃ śikhāyām - atharvaśikhāyām |
analyzed: tat āhuḥ bhaṭṭa sudarśana pādāḥ asya prakaraṇasya kaḥ ca dhyeyaḥ iti upakramya kāraṇam tu dhyeyā eti anena kāraṇa tvam anūdya dhyeya vidhi paratva avagamāt puruṣasūkta ādi pratipannasya eva bhagavataḥ dhyeya tva vidhāna param idam vākyam iti ātharvaṇyām śikhāyām atharvaśikhāyām

original: bhagavato yā janiragaṇi - nirdauṣakalyāṇaguṇākarasya nārāyaṇasya yajjanma bodhitam, "sarvamidaṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrendrāste sarve saṃprasūyante"ityanena yā bhagavato’pyutpattirbodhitetyarthaḥ | so’yam - " ajāyamāno bahudhā vijāyate |
analyzed: bhagavataḥ yā janiḥ agaṇi nirdauṣa kalyāṇa guṇa ākarasya nārāyaṇasya yat janma bodhitam sarvam idam brahma viṣṇu rudra indrāḥ te sarve saṃprasūyante iti anena yā bhagavataḥ api utpattiḥ bodhitā iti arthaḥ saḥ yam ajāyamānaḥ bahudhā vijāyate

original: tasya dhīrāḥ parijānanti yonim""yena sūryastapati tejaseddhaḥ"pitā putreṇa "putṛmānyoniyonau"ityādiprāpakavākyaprasiddho dhyeyavidhiparāyāmasyāmitarasṛjyasajātīyatayāvatīrṇasya upāsakasaulabhyaprajñāpanārthamanūditaścodbhavaḥ | jagadupakṛtaye - "jagatāmupakārāya"
analyzed: tasya dhīrāḥ parijānanti sūryaḥ tapati tejasā iddhaḥ pitā putreṇa putṛmān yoni yonau ityādi prāpaka vākya prasiddhaḥ dhyeya vidhi parāyām asyām itara sṛjya sajātīya tayā avatīrṇasya upāsaka saulabhya prajñāpana artham anūditaḥ ca udbhavaḥ jagat upakṛtaye jagatām upakārāya

original: ityuktasādhuparitrāṇādirūpajagadupakāraprayojakaḥ bhagavata icchāvatāraḥ - bhagavataḥ svecchāhetukaḥ prādurbhāva ityarthaḥ | icchāpadena jīvotpattivat karmamūlakatvamasya netyucyate | "saṃbhavāmyātmamāyayā""jananaṃ svecchayaiva ca"ityādikamabhipretya icchāvatāra ityuktam |
analyzed: iti ukta sādhu paritrāṇa ādi rūpa jagat upakāra prayojakaḥ bhagavataḥ icchā avatāraḥ bhagavataḥ sva icchā hetukaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ icchā padena jīva utpatti vat karma mūlaka tvam asya na iti ucyate saṃbhavāmi ātma māyayā ajananam sva icchayā eva caitya ādikam abhipretya icchāvatāraḥ iti uktam

original: vidheyaliṅgānusārāt so’yamiti nirdeśaḥ | dhyeyatvavidhyupayogī cāyaṃ bhagavato janmānuvādaḥ "ajāyamānaḥ"ityādipurovādaprāptāvatārānuvādakaḥ saulabhyajñāpanārtha iti bhāvaḥ | yat - yasmāt ekasmin, pravaṇābhiḥ tātparyavatībhiḥ, phaṇitibhiḥ puruṣasūktasubālopaniṣatpaiṅgirahasyādibhiḥ upaniṣadbhiḥ |
analyzed: vidheya liṅga anusārāt saḥ ayam iti nirdeśaḥ dhyeya tva vidhi upayogī ca ayam bhagavataḥ janma anuvādaḥ ajāyamānaḥ ityādi purovāda prāpta avatāra anuvādakaḥ saulabhya jñāpana arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ yat yasmāt ekasmin pravaṇābhiḥ tātparyavatībhiḥ phaṇitibhiḥ puruṣasūkta subāla upaniṣad paiṅgi rahasya ādibhiḥ upaniṣadbhiḥ

original: viṣṇoḥ kāraṇatvopadeśaḥ - bhagavataḥ kāraṇatvavidhānam | spaṣṭaḥ sphuṭam | vanaṣaṇa saṃbhaktau | saṃbhaktiḥ prārthanam | anena ca tātparyaṃ vivakṣyate |
analyzed: viṣṇoḥ kāraṇatva upadeśaḥ bhagavataḥ kāraṇatva vidhānam spaṣṭaḥ sphuṭam vanaṣaṇa saṃbhaktau saṃbhaktiḥ prārthanam anena ca tātparyam vivakṣyate

original: tasmin kāraṇatvena śrutyukte bhagavati śaṃbhuśabdo’pi sukhajanakatayā śaṃ sukhaṃ bhāvayatīti vyutpattisiddhasukhajanakatvarūpayogārthena dṛṣṭaprayogaḥ "śrṛṇu me vacanaṃ śaṃbho pitāmahapitāmaha"ityādyupabṛhaṇeṣu, "viśvākṣaṃ viśvaśaṃbhuvam"ityādiśrutau ca śrutaprayogo bhavati |
analyzed: tasmin kāraṇa tvena śruti ukte bhagavati śaṃbhu śabdaḥ api sukha janakatayā śam sukham bhāvayati iti vyutpatti siddha sukha janaka tva rūpa yoga arthena dṛṣṭa prayogaḥ śrṛṇu me vacanam śaṃbho pitāmaha pitāmaha etyādi upabṛhaṇeṣu viśvākṣam viśva śaṃbhuvam ityādi śrutau ca śruta prayogaḥ bhavati

original: tasmāt kāraṇaśaṃbhuśabdādinā bhagavantamanūdya tasya dhyeyatvapare’smin bhagavato janmaśravaṇamavatārarūpajanmānuvādakamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt kāraṇa śaṃbhu śabda ādinā bhagavantam anūdya tasya dhyeya tva paresmin bhagavataḥ janma śravaṇam avatāra rūpa janma anuvādakam iti arthaḥ

original: tadidamuktaṃ bhaṭṭasudarśanapādaiḥ - "na ca śaṃbhuḥ kāraṇamiti vākyavṛttiḥ, kiṃ tu kāraṇaṃ śaṃbhurdhyeya iti | anyathā kaśca dhyeya(tva) ityuttaratvāyogāt | śaṃbhuśabdasyāsādhāraṇye’pi ākāśaprāṇādivat paramātmaparatvaṃ nyāyyam | na cāyamasādhāraṇaḥ "śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhūrdruhiṇaḥ"iti nāmapāṭhāt"ityādinā |
analyzed: tat idam uktam bhaṭṭa sudarśana pādaiḥ na ca śaṃbhuḥ kāraṇam iti vākya vṛttiḥ kim tu kāraṇam śaṃbhuḥ dhyeyaḥ iti anyathā kaḥ ca dhyeya tve iti uttaratva ayogāt śaṃbhu śabdasya asādhāraṇye api ākāśa prāṇa ādi vat paramātma paratvam nyāyyam na ca ayam asādhāraṇaḥ śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhūḥ druhiṇaḥ iti nāma pāṭha atitya ādinā

original: (khiprasūlibādvasaṃjñāyāmiti prakaraṇe) "mitadravādibhya upasaṃkhyānam"iti kīrtekena śaṃbhuśabdo ḍhutpratyayāntatayā vyutpādito vaiyākāraṇaiḥ | "mitaṃ dravatīti mitadruḥ | śatadruḥ śaṃbhuḥ, antarbhāvitaṇyartho’tra bhavatiḥ"iti | guṇayoganimittako’pyayaṃ śumbhuśabdaḥ śivaśabdavat |
analyzed: khi prasūli bādva saṃjñāyām iti prakaraṇe mita drava ādibhyaḥ upasaṃkhyānam iti kīrtekena śaṃbhu śabdaḥ ḍhut pratyaya anta tayā vyutpāditaḥ vaiya ākāraṇaiḥ mitam dravati iti mitadruḥ śatadruḥ śaṃbhuḥ bhavatiḥ iti guṇa yoga nimittakaḥ api ayam śumbhu śabdaḥ śiva śabda vat

original: tathā ca prayujyate "svayaṃbhūḥ śaṃbhuraṃbhojalocane tvatpayodharaḥ | nakhena kasya dhanyasya candracūḍo bhaviṣyati ||"iti | viśiṣyaiva ca bhagavatyabhidhānakośena sahaprayogo’sya darśitaḥ | aparyavasānavṛttyā bhagavatparatvamapi saṃbhavati ato bhagavatparaivaiyam atharvaśikheti || 91 ||
analyzed: tathā ca prayujyate svayaṃbhūḥ śaṃbhuḥ aṃbhoja locane tvad payodharaḥ nakhena kasya dhanyasya candracūḍaḥ bhaviṣyati iti viśiṣya eva ca bhagavati abhidhāna kośena saha prayogaḥ usya darśitaḥ aparyavasāna vṛttyā bhagavat para tvam api saṃbhavati atas bhagavat parā eva eyam atharvaśikhā iti

original: śaṃbhuśudasyāparyavasānavṛttyā bhagavatparatvamiti pakṣe tvarthaśirasīvātharvaśikhāyāmapi rudraśarīrakaparamātmopāsanameva vidhīyata (ityatrāha) (ityāha) -
analyzed: bhagavat paratvam iti pakṣe tu arthaśirasi iva atharvaśikhāyām api rudra śarīraka paramātma upāsanam eva vidhīyate iti atra āha iti āha

original: uditamupāsanadvayamatharvaśiraśśikhāyoḥ
analyzed: uditam upāsana dvayam atharvaśiraḥ śikhāyoḥ

original: sphuṭamapunarbhavāya puravairikalevariṇaḥ |
analyzed: sphuṭam apunarbhavāya pura vairi kalevariṇaḥ

original: kamaladṛśaḥ kvacit kvacana kāraṇatattvaparaśrutivihitasya hārdamuṣimadhyajuṣo viduṣaḥ || 92 ||
analyzed: kamala dṛśaḥ kvacid kvacana kāraṇa tattva para śruti vihitasya hārda muṣi madhya juṣaḥ viduṣaḥ

original: atharvaśiraśśikhayo - atharvaśirasi, atharvaśikhāyāṃ ca | apunarbhavāya - mokṣāya uditam uktam, vihitamiti yāvat | upāsanadvayam - "tadetadupāsitavyam""śaṃbhurākāśamadhye dhyeyaḥ"ityuktamupāsanadvayam | kvacit kvacana kāraṇatattvaparaśrutivihitasya |
analyzed: atharvaśiraḥ śikhayaḥ atharvaśirasi atharvaśikhāyām ca apunarbhavāya mokṣāya uditam uktam vihitam iti yāvat upāsana dvayam tat etat upāsitavyam śaṃbhuḥ ākāśa madhye dhyeyaḥ iti uktam upāsana dvayam kvacid kvacana kāraṇa tattva para śruti vihitasya

original: kvacit kvacana - kvacit kvacit nārāyaṇānuvākamahopaniṣastubālopaniṣadādiṣu, kāraṇatattvaparābhiḥ upāsanavidhyādyanyaparatāgandhavidhuratayā kāraṇavastupratipādikābhiḥ, kāraṇayāthātmyapratipādikābhirvā, śrutibhiḥ "sa brahma sa śivaḥ sendraḥ"ityādikābhiḥ, vihitasya tattaccharīrakatayā tattadvidyopāsyatayā bodhitasya |
analyzed: kvacid kvacana kvacid kvacid nārāyaṇa anuvāka mahā upaniṣad tu bāla upaniṣad ādiṣu kāraṇa tattva parābhiḥ upāsana vidhi ādi anya para tā gandha vidhura tayā kāraṇa vastu pratipādikābhiḥ kāraṇa yāthātmya pratipādikābhiḥ vā śrutibhiḥ sa brahma sa śivaḥ sa indraḥ ityādikābhiḥ vihitasya tad tad śarīraka tayā tad tad vidyā upāsya tayā bodhitasya

original: viduṣo hārdasuṣimadhyajuṣaḥ - upāsakahṛdayavivaramadhyagatasya | "randhraṃ śvabhraṃ vapā suṣiḥ"iti kośaḥ | "juṣī prītisevanayoḥ" ityasmāt kvip | puravairikalebariṇaḥ - rudraśarīrakasya | manuṣyādyapekṣayā prāśastyavivakṣayā tu rudrasya karmadhārayādiniḥ prayuktaḥ | "na karmādhārayāt"iti niṣedhastu nātra bhavati |
analyzed: viduṣaḥ hārda suṣi madhya juṣaḥ upāsaka hṛdaya vivara madhya gatasya randhram śvabhram vapā suṣiḥ iti kośaḥ prīti sevanayoḥ iti asmāt kvip pura vairi kalebariṇaḥ rudra śarīrakasya manuṣya ādi apekṣayā prāśastya vivakṣayā tu rudrasya prayuktaḥ na niṣedhaḥ tu na atra bhavati

original: bahuvrīhiṇā samānārthakasya saṃbandhamātravācino matvaryoyasyaiva niṣedho na tu praśaṃsādyarthaviśeṣavivakṣādhīnasyeti vaiyākaraṇairuktatvāt | kamaladṛśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣasyaiti | sphuṭam - rudraśarīraka bhagavadviṣayakamiti spaṣṭam |
analyzed: bahuvrīhiṇā samāna arthakasya saṃbandha mātra vācinaḥ niṣedhaḥ na tu praśaṃsā ādi artha viśeṣa vivakṣā adhīnasya iti vaiyākaraṇaiḥ ukta tvāt kamala dṛśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣasya eti sphuṭam bhagavat viṣayakam iti spaṣṭam

original: atra ca kāraṇasyaiva dhyātavyatvavidhānāt, bhagavata eva ca kāraṇatayā śrutyantarabodhitatvāt, prasiddharudrasya ca sṛdyatvādiśravaṇāt, avatāraśruteścātatparatvāt, bhagavataśca sarvavidyopāsyatvenānanyaparanārāyaṇānuvākasiddhatvāt, "padmakośapratīkāśaṃ hṛdayam"ityādināvagatasya ca hṛdayamadhyopāsyatvasyākṣākāśamadhye dhyeya iti pratyabhijñānāt,
analyzed: atra ca kāraṇasya eva dhyātavya tva vidhānāt bhagavataḥ eva ca kāraṇatayā śruti antara bodhita tvāt prasiddha rudrasya ca sṛdya tva ādi śravaṇāt avatāra śruteḥ ca atatparatvāt bhagavataḥ ca sarva vidyā upāsya tvena ananya para nārāyaṇa anuvāka siddhatvāt padmakośa pratīkāśam hṛdayam ityādinā avagatasya ca hṛdaya madhya upāsya tvasya akṣa ākāśa madhye dhyeyaḥ iti pratyabhijñānāt

original: "sa yaścāyaṃ puruṣe | yaścāsāvāditye | sa ekaḥ"ityādinā puruṣāntarvartinaścādityamaṇḍalāntarvartinaikyāvagamāt, tasya ca puṇḍarīkākṣatvaśravaṇāt bhagavānevātra rudraśarīrakatayopāsya iti sphuṭaṃ pratīyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sa yaḥ ca ayam puruṣe yaḥ ca asau āditye saḥ ekaḥ ityādinā puruṣa antarvartinaḥ ca āditya maṇḍala antarvartinā aikya avagamāt tasya ca puṇḍarīkākṣa tva śravaṇāt bhagavān eva atra rudra śarīrakatayā upāsyaḥ iti sphuṭam pratīyate iti arthaḥ

original: atrātharvaśirograhaṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntārtham; taduktopāsanasya rudrāntaryāmibhagavadviṣayakatvasya pratipāditatvāt | tacca "dhyatā rudraḥ"iti rudrasyaiva dhyātṛtve’pi madhuvidyānyāyena taccharīrakasya paramātmano dhyeyatvaṃ na virudhyata iti sphoraṇāya |
analyzed: atra atharvaśiraḥ grahaṇam dṛṣṭānta artham tad ukta upāsanasya rudra antaryāmi bhagavat viṣayaka tvasya pratipādita tvāt tat ca dhyatā rudraḥ iti rudrasya eva dhyātṛ tve pi madhu vidyā nyāyena tad śarīrakasya paramātmanaḥ dhyeya tvam na virudhyate iti sphoraṇāya

original: atra ca rudraśarīrakaparamātmana eva vedyatve’pi sarvaiśvaryādiguṇabhedādvidyābheda ityabhiprāyeṇa upāsanadvayamityuktam | "etāmadhītya dvijo garbhāvāsādvamukto vimucyate
analyzed: atra ca rudra śarīraka paramātmanaḥ eva vedya tve pi sarva aiśvarya ādi guṇa bhedāt vidyā bhedaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa upāsana dvayam iti uktam etām adhītya dvijaḥ vimucyate

original: "iti vākyasiddhārthābhiprāyeṇāpunarbhavāyetyuktam ||
analyzed: iti vākya siddhārtha abhiprāyeṇa apunarbhavāya iti uktam

original: "viṣṇurātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ |
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ ātmā bhagavataḥ bhavasya amita tejasaḥ

original: tasmāddhanurjyāsaṃsparśaṃ sa viṣehe maheśvaraḥ ||"
analyzed: tasmāt dhanuḥ jyā saṃsparśam sa viṣehe maheśvaraḥ

original: iti vacanasmāraṇena rudrasya bhagavadantaryāmikatvaṃ bahupramāṇasiddhamiti vyañjanāya puravairikalebariṇa ityuktam | "ākāśamadhye dhyeyaḥ" iti puruṣāntaryāmitvāvagamāt tasya cādityamaṇḍalāntarvartinā aikyāvagamāt tasya ca puṇḍarīkākṣatvaṃ śrutamiti bhagavānevātra dhyeyatayā sidhyatītyabhiprāyeṇa kamaladṛśa ityuktam |
analyzed: iti vacana smāraṇena rudrasya bhagavat antaryāmika tvam bahu pramāṇa siddham iti vyañjanāya puravairi kalebariṇaḥ iti uktam ākāśa madhye dhyeyaḥ iti puruṣa antaryāmi tva avagamāt tasya ca āditya maṇḍala antarvartinā aikya avagamāt tasya ca puṇḍarīkākṣa tvam śrutam iti bhagavān eva atra dhyeya tayā sidhyati iti abhiprāyeṇa kamala dṛśaḥ iti uktam

original: hṛdayamadhyagatatvamananyaparanārāyaṇānuvākena bhagavanniṣṭhatayāvagatamiti tasyātra "ākāśamadhye dhyeyaḥ"ityanenoktatvāt bhagavata evātra dhyeyatvaṃ sidhyatītyabhiprāyeṇa viduṣo hārdasuṣimadhyajuṣa ityuktam || 92 ||
analyzed: hṛdaya madhya gata tvam ananya para nārāyaṇa anuvākena bhagavat niṣṭhatayā avagatam iti tasya atra ākāśa madhye dhyeyaḥ iti anena ukta tvāt bhagavataḥ eva atra dhyeya tvam sidhyati iti abhiprāyeṇa viduṣaḥ hārda suṣi madhya juṣaḥ iti uktam

original: "tato yaduttarataram""tasmin yadantaḥ"iti śrutiliṅgābhyāṃ devatāntarasya bhagavadapekṣayotkarṣapratipādanaṃ tayoratatparatvopapādanena nirastam "yatsaṃjñāmūrtikartuḥ""prastutyāmṛtahetum"ityādiślokadvaye | tatprasaṅgāccātharvaśiraśśikhayoratatparatvopapādanena bhagavatparatvamupapāditam "yaddaivaiḥ"ityādibhiḥ |
analyzed: tatas yat uttarataram tasmin yat antar iti śruti liṅgābhyām devatā antarasya bhagavat apekṣayā utkarṣa pratipādanam tayoḥ atatparatva upapādanena nirastam yat saṃjñāmūrti kartuḥ prastutya amṛta hetum ityādi śloka dvaye tad prasaṅgāt ca atharvaśiraḥ śikhayoḥ atatparatva upapādanena bhagavat paratvam upapāditam yat daivaiḥ ityādibhiḥ

original: idānīṃ samākhyayā tadāśaṅkya śrutyādibalavanmānabādhitā samākhyā nārthaniścayakarīti samākhyāvalambinaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ nirasyati tribhiḥ ślokaiḥ ||
analyzed: idānīm samākhyayā tat āśaṅkya śruti ādi balavat māna bādhitā samākhyā na artha niścaya karī iti samākhyā avalambinam pūrvapakṣam nirasyati tribhiḥ ślokaiḥ

original: ayaṃ hi sa pūrvapakṣaḥ; sopapadanirupapadapuruṣaśabdavācyāttathāvidhe(śvara)śabdavācyasya
analyzed: ayam hi sa pūrvapakṣaḥ sa upapada nirupapada puruṣa śabda vācyāt tathāvidha īśvara śabda vācyasya
